## File: README.md

<div align="center">

# db-kit

**The data layer of the MGPL Diagnostics backend.**
One domain model on **MongoDB** or **PostgreSQL**, ACID workflows, Tally-style double-entry books
and a Redis cache toolkit, as an internal API the backend calls. It serves no endpoints of its own.

![checks](https://img.shields.io/badge/checks-194-14264A) ![backends](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB%20%7C%20PostgreSQL-same%20API-C2410C) ![ACID](https://img.shields.io/badge/ACID-both%20databases-E9A23B)

</div>

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  API["backend API<br/>(GraphQL · REST where needed)"] --> AUTH["auth-kit<br/>sessions · roles"]
  API --> DB["db-kit<br/>repositories · workflows · books"]
  AUTH -. users / roles / audit .-> DB
  DB --> M[(MongoDB<br/>Mongoose)]
  DB --> P[(PostgreSQL<br/>Sequelize)]
  DB --> R[(Redis<br/>cache)]
```

## Start

```ts
import { createDb, registerPatient, issueInvoice, trialBalance } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";

const db = await createDb({
  backend: "pg",                                   // or "mongo"
  pg: { url: process.env.DATABASE_URL },           // mongo: { uri: process.env.MONGO_URL }
  redis: process.env.REDIS_URL,                    // optional: cache + cached reads
});

const patient = await registerPatient(db.repos, { orgId, branchId, name: "Asha Patel", sex: "female", ageYears: 29 });
const { invoice } = await issueInvoice(db.repos, {
  orgId, branchId, patientId: patient.id,
  items: [{ code: "CBC", name: "Complete Blood Count", ratePaise: 39900 }],
  payments: [{ amountPaise: 39900, mode: "upi" }],
});
const tb = await trialBalance(db.repos, { orgId });  // tb.totalDebitPaise === tb.totalCreditPaise
```

`createDb` loads only the backend you pick: Mongo users never load Sequelize, and the other way round.
Tables and collections, with their indexes, are created on start (`sync: false` to skip).

## What's inside

### Domain

| Area | Entities |
| --- | --- |
| Organisation | organisations, branches (lab / collection centre) |
| Access | users (roles per branch), roles, audit log. Passwords and sessions live in **auth-kit** |
| Lab | patients (UHID), referring doctors, bookings, samples (barcodes), reports |
| Billing | invoices (GST, discounts, round-off, B2B customer, place of supply), payments and refunds, credit notes |
| Books | account groups, ledgers, vouchers, ledger entries, lock dates |
| Finance | B2B customers, collection-centre partners and agreements, monthly settlements, day-end cash closings, bank statements and lines, GST tax rules. Rules live in [finance-kit](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/finance-kit); see [docs/FINANCE-STORAGE.md](docs/FINANCE-STORAGE.md) |

Ids are **UUID strings on both databases**, so data and code move between them unchanged. Money is
**integer paise** everywhere.

### Workflows

Each workflow runs in a transaction and writes an audit entry:

| Function | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `seedOrganization` | organisation + roles + first branch + owner |
| `registerPatient` | UHID from a gap-free counter (`MGPL-000123`) |
| `createBooking` | booking number per branch per day, one sample barcode per sample type |
| `saveResults` · `transitionReport` | draft → entered → verified → released → amended |
| `issueInvoice` | numbers it in the branch's financial-year series (`MGPL/RPR01/2026-27/000045`), computes totals, takes payments, **posts a Sales voucher** |
| `recordPayment` | payment or refund; locks the invoice; **posts a Receipt / Payment voucher** |
| `cancelInvoice` | only when unpaid; cancels its Sales voucher |

### Tally-style books

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Chart of accounts | Tally's 28 groups (`TALLY_GROUPS`) and lab ledgers (`DEFAULT_LEDGERS`: Cash, UPI, Card, Bank, Patient Receivables, Lab Test Income, Output CGST/SGST/IGST, Discount, Round Off…) via `seedChartOfAccounts` |
| Vouchers | Sales, Receipt, Payment, Journal, Contra, Credit/Debit Note, Purchase, Closing (year end). Numbered per type per financial year; debits must equal credits (`assertBalanced`) |
| Lock dates | per organisation or branch: no voucher on or before the lock date may be posted or cancelled (`PeriodLockedError`, 409). Checked inside the posting transaction, safe under concurrency |
| Automatic posting | invoice → Dr Receivables / Dr Discount / Cr Income / Cr GST / ± Round Off; payment → Dr Cash·UPI·Card / Cr Receivables. Replaceable through a `PostingHook` (`createDb({ posting })`) |
| Reports | `trialBalance` · `ledgerStatement` (running balance) · `cashBook` · `dayBook` · `profitAndLoss` (gross and net) · `balanceSheet` · `outstandingReceivables` (ageing) · `gstSummary` |

### ACID on both databases

| | MongoDB | PostgreSQL |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Atomic workflows | multi-document transactions (snapshot reads, majority writes) | managed transactions |
| No lost updates on payments | the write lock is taken inside the transaction | `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` |
| Retries | `withTransaction` retries transient errors | retries deadlocks and serialization failures (40P01 / 40001) |
| Safety | **refuses** to run without a replica set (`TransactionsUnsupportedError`) | — |

Tests prove each guarantee on both databases: a failed transaction leaves nothing (not even a used counter); of two concurrent overpayments, exactly one succeeds; a second transaction waits for the invoice lock.

### Cache toolkit (`/cache`)

| Technique | Use |
| --- | --- |
| cache-aside + TTL jitter | `cache.getOrSet(key, loader, { ttl })` |
| single-flight | 20 concurrent misses → 1 load per process |
| stampede lock | across servers, one loads and the others wait for its value |
| stale-while-revalidate | `staleTtl`: serve stale instantly, refresh in the background |
| negative caching | `negativeTtl`: remember "not found" |
| tags | `invalidateTags("patient:42")` |
| versioned namespaces | `cache.namespace("catalog").bump()` drops a namespace in O(1) |
| two-tier L1 + Redis | in-process LRU; pub/sub clears every server's L1 on writes |
| cached repositories | `withCache(repos, cache)`: reads by id cached, writes invalidate |
| rate limiters · locks | `slidingWindowLimiter`, `fixedWindowLimiter`, `withLock` |

### Mounting in a backend

```ts
import { mgplDb } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit/fastify";
await app.register(mgplDb, { backend: "mongo", mongo: { uri }, redis: process.env.REDIS_URL }); // → app.db

import { attachDb, dbErrorHandler } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit/express";
app.use(attachDb(db)); /* routes */ app.use(dbErrorHandler());
```

Errors carry `statusCode`:

| Error | Status |
| --- | --- |
| `NotFoundError` | 404 |
| `ConflictError` | 409 |
| `PeriodLockedError` (a `ConflictError`) | 409 |
| `ValidationError` | 400 |
| `UnbalancedVoucherError` | 422 |

## Entry points

| Import | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit` | types, repository interface, workflows, money, numbering, accounting, reports, `createDb` |
| `…/mongo` · `…/pg` | `createMongoRepositories` · `createPgRepositories`, schemas / models |
| `…/cache` | the cache toolkit |
| `…/fastify` · `…/express` | adapters |
| `…/graphql` | **moving to the backend repo.** See [docs/MOVE-GRAPHQL-TO-BACKEND.md](docs/MOVE-GRAPHQL-TO-BACKEND.md) |

Peer dependencies are all optional: install only the ones you use (`mongoose`, or `sequelize` + `pg`
+ `pg-hstore`; `ioredis`; `fastify`).

## Tests

```bash
npm test   # 194 checks
```

The suite starts a real MongoDB (single-node replica set) and a real PostgreSQL in-process, then runs
the same contract suite on both. It covers seeding, numbering, workflows, ACID, the books, the finance
storage (unique keys, row locks, lock dates under concurrency, the posting hook), the cache techniques
and the adapters. Set `REDIS_URL` to run the cache checks against real Redis instead of
`ioredis-mock`.

## Family

| Repo | Role |
| --- | --- |
| **db-kit** | data, workflows, books, cache |
| [auth-kit](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/auth-kit) | passwords, sessions, roles (internal API) |
| [catalog-kit](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/catalog-kit) | tests, ranges, prices, search |
| [report-kit](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit) · [invoice-kit](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit) | A4 PDF + HTML |
| [client](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/client) | headless frontend SDK |

## File: AGENTS.md

# AGENTS.md — @mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit

The data layer for MGPL Diagnostics: one domain model on **MongoDB (Mongoose)** or **PostgreSQL
(Sequelize)** behind the same repository interface, Tally-style double-entry accounting, a Redis cache
toolkit, and Fastify / Express decorators.

> **Pending move:** `src/graphql/` belongs in the backend repo. Read
> [docs/MOVE-GRAPHQL-TO-BACKEND.md](docs/MOVE-GRAPHQL-TO-BACKEND.md) before touching GraphQL code.

## Map

```
src/core/       types, ports (repository interface + errors + PostingHook), services (workflows), money,
                numbering, accounting (groups, ledgers, vouchers, lock dates, auto-posting), reports
src/mongo/      Mongoose schemas + repositories (transactions need a replica set)
src/pg/         Sequelize models + repositories (row locks, retry on 40001/40P01)
src/cache/      cache-aside, single-flight, stampede lock, SWR, negative, tags, namespaces,
                two-tier L1+L2, rate limiters, distributed lock, cached repositories
src/adapters/   fastify (decorates app.db), express (attachDb, dbErrorHandler)
src/graphql/    TO BE MOVED (see the handoff doc)
scripts/test.ts one contract suite on real MongoDB + real PostgreSQL (in-process), plus cache and adapters
```

## Rules

1. **Both backends behave identically.** Change a repository → change it in `mongo/` and `pg/`, then
   `npm test` (the contract suite runs on both).
2. **Money is integer paise.** Every voucher balances (`assertBalanced`). Never post without `postVoucher`.
3. **Multi-record work runs in `repos.transaction()`.** Inside, use the `tx` repositories only.
4. **Sequelize attribute definitions must be fresh objects per column** (factories like `id()`,
   `money()`). Sequelize mutates them; a shared object made every money column write to `subtotal_paise`.
5. **MongoDB unique indexes count `null`.** Use `partialFilterExpression` for optional unique keys.
6. No passwords or auth logic here: users store a `passwordHash` produced by auth-kit.
7. Never commit patient data, credentials, or `.env` files.
8. **Lock dates are checked inside the posting transaction** (`assertPeriodOpen` in `postVoucher` /
   `cancelVoucher`). Never write vouchers or ledger entries around it.
9. **Billing posts through `repos.posting`** (a `PostingHook`, default `defaultPostingHook`). Set it with
   `createDb({ posting })`; finance-kit supplies one. Finance storage is described in
   [docs/FINANCE-STORAGE.md](docs/FINANCE-STORAGE.md); finance rules live in finance-kit, not here.
10. No dates inside JSON arrays (JSONB returns strings): use IST day strings like `"2026-10-14"`.

## Commands

```bash
npm run typecheck
npm test          # starts MongoDB (replica set) + PostgreSQL in-process; REDIS_URL optional
npm run build
```

## File: docs/FINANCE-STORAGE.md

# Finance storage (for finance-kit)

**Audience:** agents and developers working on db-kit or `@mgpl-diagnostics/finance-kit`.

finance-kit holds the money rules (GST, receivables, partner settlements, cash and bank, lock dates,
year-end close, exports). It stores everything through db-kit, so one transaction can cover an
invoice and its voucher on either database. This page lists that storage and the two hooks
finance-kit relies on.

## Entities

Every entity has a UUID `id`, `orgId`, timestamps, and money in integer paise. Each one is a
repository on `Repositories`, on both MongoDB and PostgreSQL.

| Repository | Table / collection | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `taxRules` | `tax_rules` / `taxrules` | SAC/HSN, taxability and GST rate for an item `code` or a whole `category`, from `effectiveFrom` to `effectiveTo` (inclusive, null = open). Values are configuration the lab's CA must check |
| `customers` | `customers` | B2B customers (hospital, insurer, TPA, corporate). Unique `code` per organisation. `creditLimitPaise` (null = no limit), `creditDays`, own Sundry Debtors `ledgerId`. `getForUpdate` locks the row (credit-limit checks) |
| `partners` | `partners` | Collection centres and franchises. Unique `code`. `branchId` = the branch whose invoices count. Own Sundry Creditors `ledgerId`. Optional `tds` override `{ section, rateBp }` |
| `partnerAgreements` | `partner_agreements` | `revenue_share` (`shareBp`) or `fixed_rate` (`rates[]`, `defaultSharePaise`), effective-dated |
| `settlements` | `settlements` | A partner's month: lines, gross, share, deductions, TDS, net, status, voucher ids. `periodKey` (`<partnerId>:<YYYY-MM>`, null once cancelled) is unique, so a month has at most one live settlement. `getForUpdate` |
| `cashClosings` | `cash_closings` | One per branch per IST day (`day: "2026-10-14"`, unique): book vs counted cash, denominations, the short/excess voucher |
| `bankStatements` · `bankLines` | `bank_statements` · `bank_lines` | Imported statements. A line's `dedupKey` is unique per organisation, so importing the same file twice adds nothing. Match fields: `status`, `matchKind`, `voucherIds`, `settlement` (card / UPI batch and MDR fee) |
| `periodLocks` | `period_locks` | One row per scope: `"org"` or a branch id (unique). `lockedUpTo` is an instant; null = nothing locked |
| `creditNotes` | `credit_notes` | GST credit notes against an invoice: lines by invoice item, CGST/SGST/IGST, unique `noteNo`. `listByDate` |

Dates inside nested arrays are IST day strings (`"2026-10-03"`), because PostgreSQL JSONB would hand
them back as strings anyway.

New fields on existing entities:

| Entity | Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Branch` | `stateCode` | GST state code of the branch (falls back to its GSTIN) |
| `Invoice` | `customerId`, `placeOfSupply`, `buyerGstin` | B2B customer, GST place of supply (state code), buyer's GSTIN at the time |
| `Invoice` | `creditedPaise` | sum of credit notes. `duePaise = max(0, total − credited − paid)`; status `credited` when credit notes cover the invoice |
| `InvoiceItem` | `hsnSac`, `taxability` | GST code and treatment of the line, for returns |
| `VoucherType` | `closing` | the year-end voucher; `profitAndLoss` and `gstSummary` leave it out |

New queries: `invoices.listByDate`, `creditNotes.listByDate`, and `excludeVoucherTypes` on
`ledgerEntries.list/totals`.

## Lock dates

`postVoucher` and `cancelVoucher` call `assertPeriodOpen(tx, orgId, branchId, date)` inside their
transaction. It throws `PeriodLockedError` (a `ConflictError`, 409) when the voucher date is on or
before the organisation's or the branch's `lockedUpTo`.

The check holds both lock rows until commit (`periodLocks.hold(orgId, scopes, "share")`), and a lock
change takes them with `"update"`, so a lock moved while a posting is in flight still stops it:

| | PostgreSQL | MongoDB |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Posting | `SELECT … FOR SHARE` (postings don't block each other) | writes the lock document |
| Lock change | `SELECT … FOR UPDATE`: waits for in-flight postings | writes the lock document: concurrent postings conflict and `withTransaction` retries them |

Missing lock rows are created on first use. finance-kit sets lock dates, closes cash days and closes
financial years; the check itself sits next to `postVoucher`, so it moves with the accounting engine.

## Posting hook

The billing workflows (`issueInvoice`, `recordPayment`, `cancelInvoice`) post through a `PostingHook`:

```ts
interface PostingHook {
  invoiceIssued(tx: Repositories, invoice: Invoice, actorId?: string): Promise<void>;
  paymentRecorded(tx: Repositories, payment: Payment, invoiceNo: string, actorId?: string): Promise<void>;
  invoiceCancelled(tx: Repositories, invoiceId: string, actorId?: string): Promise<void>;
}
```

`defaultPostingHook` keeps today's behaviour (`postInvoice` / `postPayment` / `unpostInvoice`). Pass
another one when creating the repositories, so transactions carry it too:

```ts
import { financePosting } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/finance-kit";
const db = await createDb({ backend: "pg", pg: { url }, posting: financePosting });
```

Spreading `{ ...repos, posting }` does **not** reach the `tx` repositories; use the option.
When the accounting engine moves to its own kit (tally-kit), that kit implements this hook and
db-kit no longer imports the engine.

## Upgrading an existing database

db-kit is not published or deployed yet, so a throw-away database can simply be recreated. For a
database you want to keep:

**PostgreSQL** (`sync()` creates new tables but does not add columns to existing ones). Run before
`sync()`:

```sql
ALTER TABLE branches ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS state_code VARCHAR(2);
ALTER TABLE invoices
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS customer_id UUID,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS place_of_supply VARCHAR(2),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS buyer_gstin VARCHAR(15),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS credited_paise INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;
```

then, after `sync()` has created `customers`:

```sql
ALTER TABLE invoices ADD CONSTRAINT invoices_customer_id_fkey
  FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE;
```

**MongoDB:** `sync()` builds the new indexes. Old invoices have no `creditedPaise`; readers treat it
as 0, or set it once: `db.invoices.updateMany({ creditedPaise: { $exists: false } }, { $set: { creditedPaise: 0 } })`.

## File: docs/MOVE-GRAPHQL-TO-BACKEND.md

# Handoff: move the GraphQL layer from db-kit to the backend repo

**Audience:** the AI agent (or developer) doing the move. Follow the checklist top to bottom.
**Status (2026-10-13):** not started. Everything below currently lives in db-kit and passes its tests
(`npm test`: 194 checks; 38 of them are the GraphQL suite).

## Why

db-kit is the **data layer** (models, transactions, Tally accounting, Redis cache). Its only consumer
is the backend. The **API surface** belongs to the backend: one GraphQL endpoint that combines
db-kit, auth-kit, catalog-kit, and report/invoice rendering, plus REST only where needed (PDF
downloads, static assets, health checks, payment webhooks). Keeping GraphQL in db-kit mixes the two
jobs and spreads the schema across packages.

## Target

A new backend repo (working name **`mgpl-diagnostics/api`**). It owns:
- the Yoga server, mounted in Fastify;
- the merged schema and the resolvers;
- the request context, built by auth-kit;
- DataLoader batching and error codes.

## What moves (source → destination in the backend repo)

| db-kit file | Move to | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `src/graphql/type-defs.ts` | `src/graphql/modules/data/type-defs.ts` | SDL for patients, bookings, samples, reports, invoices, payments, accounting |
| `src/graphql/resolvers.ts` | `src/graphql/modules/data/resolvers.ts` | Change imports from `../core/*` to `@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit` |
| `src/graphql/context.ts` | `src/graphql/context.ts` | `DbGraphQLContext` becomes the backend's request context; filled by auth-kit (see below) |
| `src/graphql/loader.ts` | `src/graphql/loader.ts` | Per-request batch loader (no dependency) |
| `src/graphql/index.ts` | `src/graphql/schema.ts` | `createSchema(modules)`, `DB_PERMISSIONS`, module type |
| `scripts/graphql-suite.ts` | `test/graphql-data.test.ts` | Replace the fake `can`/`branchesFor` with auth-kit's real ones |

## What stays in db-kit (do not move)

- `src/core/*`: domain types, repository interface (`ports.ts`), workflows (`services.ts`), money,
  numbering, accounting (`accounting.ts`), reports (`reports.ts`).
- `src/mongo/*`, `src/pg/*`: both backends, including **`getMany(ids)`** on every repository (the
  backend's DataLoaders need it).
- `src/cache/*`: Redis cache toolkit.
- `src/adapters/fastify.ts`, `src/adapters/express.ts`: they only decorate `db`, not an API.
- Error classes in `ports.ts`: `NotFoundError` (404), `ConflictError` (409), `ValidationError` (400),
  and `UnbalancedVoucherError` (422, in `accounting.ts`). The backend maps them to GraphQL codes.

## Checklist: db-kit side

1. Delete `src/graphql/`.
2. In `scripts/test.ts`, remove `import { graphqlSuite } …` and both `await graphqlSuite(…)` calls.
   Delete `scripts/graphql-suite.ts`.
3. In `package.json`:
   - remove the `"./graphql"` export;
   - remove the `graphql` and `@graphql-tools/schema` peer deps and their `peerDependenciesMeta`;
   - remove the `graphql`, `@graphql-tools/schema` and `graphql-yoga` dev deps;
   - drop "a GraphQL module" from the description.
4. In `tsup.config.ts`, remove the `graphql` entry and the two `graphql` externals.
5. `npm install --no-package-lock && npm run typecheck && npm test`. Expect **96 passed, 0 failed**.

## Checklist: backend side

1. Add the deps:
   - `graphql@^16.14`
   - `graphql-yoga@^5.24`
   - `@graphql-tools/schema@^10`
   - `@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit`
   - `@mgpl-diagnostics/auth-kit`
2. Copy the files in the table. Fix the imports, so that everything in `core` comes from
   `@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit`. That covers the services, accounting, reports and errors.
3. Build the context per request from auth-kit (its internal API is designed for this):
   ```ts
   const yoga = createYoga({
     schema: createSchema([dataModule /*, authModule, catalogModule … */]),
     context: async ({ request }) => {
       const token = request.headers.get("authorization")?.replace(/^Bearer /, "") ?? null;
       const auth = await authKit.context(token);   // { viewer, can, branchesFor }
       return { repos: db.repos, ...auth };
     },
   });
   ```
   Use **`db.repos`** (cached reads), not `db.rawRepos`. Workflows open their own transactions on
   the raw repositories.
4. Mount Yoga in Fastify. REST routes live beside it, and only for:
   - PDF and other binary downloads;
   - assets;
   - `/health`;
   - payment webhooks.
5. Seed roles with auth-kit's `SYSTEM_ROLES` (`seedOrganization(repos, { …, roles: SYSTEM_ROLES })`).
   auth-kit's roles must grant every permission in `DB_PERMISSIONS`. In particular, `accounts:read`,
   `accounts:post` and `accounts:manage` are new and are not in the original role presets.
6. Port the GraphQL suite. It must still prove:
   - `UNAUTHENTICATED` without a viewer;
   - `FORBIDDEN` for a missing permission;
   - branch-limited staff see only their branches;
   - discounts need `invoice:discount`;
   - another organisation gets `NOT_FOUND` or `null`;
   - posting into another organisation's ledgers is refused;
   - `CONFLICT` on overpayment;
   - `BAD_USER_INPUT` for an unbalanced voucher or qty 0;
   - 10 invoices with patients load in **1** batched query.

## Rules the resolvers rely on (keep them)

- **Tenant isolation:** never take `orgId` from arguments. Use `viewer.orgId`, and pass every fetched
  entity through `own(ctx, entity)` (it returns null for another organisation's data).
- **Permissions are branch-aware:** `authorize(ctx, permission, entity.branchId)`. Lists use
  `branchScope()` / `branchesFor()`, so branch-limited roles only see their branches.
- **Error codes:** domain errors go through `toGraphQLError()`. Never pass `originalError`. Yoga masks
  any `GraphQLError` that wraps a non-GraphQL error as "Unexpected error" (this bug was hit and fixed).
- **Enum mapping:** a result flag `""` ⇄ `NONE`. Ageing buckets `"0-30"` ⇄ `D0_30` and so on.
- **Limits:** list `limit` is capped at 200.
- **Postgres ids are UUIDs.** Test fixtures must use valid UUIDs for user ids (they are written to
  `audit_log.user_id`).
- **ACID:**
  - Workflows run in `repos.transaction()`.
  - MongoDB needs a replica set; on a standalone server db-kit throws `TransactionsUnsupportedError`.
  - Postgres locks invoices with `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` and retries on deadlock or serialization failure.

## File: llms.txt

# @mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit

> The MGPL Diagnostics backend's internal data API (Node.js ≥ 20), with no HTTP endpoints of its own. One domain model on MongoDB (Mongoose) or PostgreSQL (Sequelize) behind the same repository interface, UUID ids and integer paise. Workflows are ACID on both databases. Books are Tally-style double-entry (28 groups, ledgers, vouchers, automatic posting from invoices and payments, trial balance / P&L / balance sheet / GST). Includes a Redis cache toolkit and Fastify / Express adapters.

Key facts for agents:
- `const db = await createDb({ backend: "pg" | "mongo", pg: { url } | mongo: { uri }, redis? })` → `{ repos, rawRepos, cache, close }`.
- Workflows (all transactional + audited): seedOrganization, registerPatient, createBooking, saveResults/transitionReport, issueInvoice, recordPayment, cancelInvoice; accounting: seedChartOfAccounts, postVoucher, cancelVoucher (both refuse a locked period: PeriodLockedError 409).
- Finance storage for finance-kit: taxRules, customers, partners, partnerAgreements, settlements, cashClosings, bankStatements, bankLines, periodLocks, creditNotes. Billing posts through a PostingHook (`createDb({ posting })`). See docs/FINANCE-STORAGE.md.
- Reports: trialBalance, ledgerStatement, cashBook, dayBook, profitAndLoss, balanceSheet, outstandingReceivables, gstSummary.
- Errors carry statusCode: NotFoundError 404, ConflictError 409, ValidationError 400, UnbalancedVoucherError 422; MongoDB without a replica set → TransactionsUnsupportedError.
- Change a repository in both src/mongo and src/pg; `npm test` runs one contract suite on real MongoDB and PostgreSQL.
- src/graphql is moving to the backend repo: see docs/MOVE-GRAPHQL-TO-BACKEND.md.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): overview, workflows, books, ACID, cache, entry points
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): map and rules
- [docs/FINANCE-STORAGE.md](docs/FINANCE-STORAGE.md): storage for finance-kit, lock dates, posting hook, upgrading a database
- [docs/MOVE-GRAPHQL-TO-BACKEND.md](docs/MOVE-GRAPHQL-TO-BACKEND.md): handoff for the GraphQL move
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): every doc and source file in one document

## Source

- [src/core/ports.ts](src/core/ports.ts): repository interface, errors
- [src/core/services.ts](src/core/services.ts): workflows
- [src/core/accounting.ts](src/core/accounting.ts): chart of accounts, vouchers, posting
- [src/core/reports.ts](src/core/reports.ts): financial reports
- [src/mongo/index.ts](src/mongo/index.ts) · [src/pg/index.ts](src/pg/index.ts): backends
- [src/cache/cache.ts](src/cache/cache.ts): cache techniques

## Optional

- [auth-kit](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/auth-kit)
- [catalog-kit](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/catalog-kit)

## File: scripts/graphql-suite.ts

```ts
// GraphQL module tests: a real Yoga server in memory, viewers chosen by a test header.
import { createYoga } from "graphql-yoga";
import { seedChartOfAccounts, seedOrganization, type Db, type Repositories, type RoleAssignment } from "../src/index";
import { createSchema, dbModule, type DbGraphQLContext } from "../src/graphql/index";

type Ok = (cond: unknown, msg: string) => void;

const PERMS: Record<string, string[]> = {
  owner: ["*:*"],
  front_desk: ["patient:read", "patient:create", "booking:read", "booking:create", "invoice:read", "invoice:create", "payment:create"],
};
const match = (g: string, w: string) => {
  const [gr, ga] = g.split(":");
  const [wr, wa] = w.split(":");
  return (gr === "*" || gr === wr) && (ga === "*" || ga === wa);
};
const can = (roles: RoleAssignment[], perm: string, branchId?: string | null) =>
  roles.some((a) => (!branchId || !a.branchId || a.branchId === branchId) && (PERMS[a.role] ?? []).some((g) => match(g, perm)));

export async function graphqlSuite(db: Db, ok: Ok) {
  const tag = `[graphql/${db.backend}]`;
  console.log(`\n${tag}`);
  let getManyCalls = 0;
  const repos: Repositories = {
    ...db.rawRepos,
    patients: { ...db.rawRepos.patients, getMany: (ids) => { getManyCalls++; return db.rawRepos.patients.getMany(ids); } },
  };

  const a = await seedOrganization(repos, { org: { name: "GQL Lab", code: "GQL" }, branch: { code: "A01", name: "Branch A" }, owner: { name: "O", email: "o@gql.in", passwordHash: "h" } });
  const b2 = await repos.branches.create({ orgId: a.org.id, code: "B01", name: "Branch B", kind: "collection_center", active: true });
  await seedChartOfAccounts(repos, a.org.id);
  const other = await seedOrganization(repos, { org: { name: "Other Lab", code: "OTH" }, branch: { code: "Z01", name: "Z" }, owner: { name: "X", email: "x@oth.in", passwordHash: "h" } });
  const cash = (await repos.ledgers.findBySystemKey(a.org.id, "cash"))!;
  const capital = (await repos.ledgers.findBySystemKey(a.org.id, "capital"))!;

  const viewers: Record<string, { userId: string; orgId: string; roles: RoleAssignment[] }> = {
    owner: { userId: a.owner.id, orgId: a.org.id, roles: [{ role: "owner", branchId: null }] },
    desk: { userId: "0b0b0b0b-0000-4000-8000-00000000d35c", orgId: a.org.id, roles: [{ role: "front_desk", branchId: a.branch.id }] },
    other: { userId: other.owner.id, orgId: other.org.id, roles: [{ role: "owner", branchId: null }] },
  };
  const yoga = createYoga<{ request: Request }, DbGraphQLContext>({
    schema: createSchema([dbModule]),
    logging: false,
    context: ({ request }) => {
      const v = viewers[request.headers.get("x-test-user") ?? ""] ?? null;
      return {
        repos,
        viewer: v,
        can: (p, br) => !!v && can(v.roles, p, br),
        branchesFor: (p) => {
          if (!v) return [];
          if (v.roles.some((r) => !r.branchId && can([r], p))) return "all";
          return v.roles.filter((r) => r.branchId && can([r], p, r.branchId)).map((r) => r.branchId!);
        },
      };
    },
  });
  const gql = async (user: string | null, query: string, variables?: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    const res = await yoga.fetch("http://test/graphql", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json", ...(user ? { "x-test-user": user } : {}) },
      body: JSON.stringify({ query, variables }),
    });
    return (await res.json()) as { data?: any; errors?: { message: string; extensions?: { code?: string } }[] };
  };
  const code = (r: { errors?: { extensions?: { code?: string } }[] }) => r.errors?.[0]?.extensions?.code;

  ok(code(await gql(null, "{ organization { name } }")) === "UNAUTHENTICATED", `${tag} no viewer → UNAUTHENTICATED`);
  const org = await gql("owner", "{ organization { name code branches { code } } }");
  ok(org.data?.organization.code === "GQL" && org.data.organization.branches.length === 2, `${tag} organization with branches`);

  const reg = await gql("owner", "mutation($i: RegisterPatientInput!) { registerPatient(input: $i) { id uhid name sex } }", {
    i: { branchId: a.branch.id, name: "Asha Patel", sex: "female", ageYears: 29, phone: "9111111111" },
  });
  const patientId = reg.data?.registerPatient.id;
  ok(reg.data?.registerPatient.uhid === "GQL-000001", `${tag} registerPatient → ${reg.data?.registerPatient.uhid}`);

  const book = await gql("owner", "mutation($i: CreateBookingInput!) { createBooking(input: $i) { booking { id bookingNo status patient { name } } samples { barcode sampleType } } }", {
    i: { branchId: a.branch.id, patientId, tests: [{ testCode: "CBC", name: "CBC", pricePaise: 39900, sampleType: "EDTA" }, { testCode: "HBA1C", name: "HbA1c", pricePaise: 54900, sampleType: "EDTA" }] },
  });
  const bookingId = book.data?.createBooking.booking.id;
  ok(book.data?.createBooking.samples.length === 1 && book.data.createBooking.booking.patient.name === "Asha Patel", `${tag} createBooking ${book.data?.createBooking.booking.bookingNo}: one EDTA sample`);

  const inv = await gql("owner", "mutation($i: IssueInvoiceInput!) { issueInvoice(input: $i) { id invoiceNo status totalPaise paidPaise duePaise } }", {
    i: { branchId: a.branch.id, patientId, bookingId, items: [{ code: "CBC", name: "CBC", ratePaise: 39900 }, { code: "HBA1C", name: "HbA1c", ratePaise: 54900 }], payments: [{ amountPaise: 50000, mode: "cash" }] },
  });
  const invoiceId = inv.data?.issueInvoice.id;
  ok(inv.data?.issueInvoice.status === "partially_paid" && inv.data.issueInvoice.totalPaise === 94800, `${tag} issueInvoice ${inv.data?.issueInvoice.invoiceNo}: Rs 948, partially paid`);
  const over = await gql("owner", "mutation($id: ID!) { recordPayment(invoiceId: $id, payment: { amountPaise: 999999, mode: upi }) { id } }", { id: invoiceId });
  ok(code(over) === "CONFLICT", `${tag} overpayment → CONFLICT`);
  const pay = await gql("owner", 'mutation($id: ID!) { recordPayment(invoiceId: $id, payment: { amountPaise: 44800, mode: upi, reference: "UPI9" }) { status duePaise payments { mode amountPaise } vouchers { type voucherNo entries { ledger { name } debitPaise creditPaise } } } }', { id: invoiceId });
  const p = pay.data?.recordPayment;
  ok(p?.status === "paid" && p.payments.length === 2 && p.vouchers.length === 3, `${tag} recordPayment → paid; 2 payments, 3 vouchers (sales + 2 receipts)`);
  ok(p?.vouchers.find((v: any) => v.type === "sales")?.entries.some((e: any) => e.ledger.name === "Patient Receivables"), `${tag} voucher entries resolve their ledgers`);

  const books = await gql("owner", '{ trialBalance { differencePaise totalDebitPaise } gstSummary(from: "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z", to: "2100-01-01T00:00:00Z") { totalTaxPaise } outstandingReceivables { totalDuePaise } }');
  ok(books.data?.trialBalance.differencePaise === 0 && books.data.trialBalance.totalDebitPaise > 0 && books.data.outstandingReceivables.totalDuePaise === 0, `${tag} trial balance balances; nothing outstanding`);
  const unbalanced = await gql("owner", "mutation($i: PostVoucherInput!) { postVoucher(input: $i) { id } }", {
    i: { branchId: a.branch.id, type: "journal", entries: [{ ledgerId: cash.id, debitPaise: 100 }, { ledgerId: capital.id, creditPaise: 50 }] },
  });
  ok(code(unbalanced) === "BAD_USER_INPUT", `${tag} unbalanced voucher → BAD_USER_INPUT`);
  const foreignLedger = await gql("other", "mutation($i: PostVoucherInput!) { postVoucher(input: $i) { id } }", {
    i: { branchId: other.branch.id, type: "journal", entries: [{ ledgerId: cash.id, debitPaise: 100 }, { ledgerId: capital.id, creditPaise: 100 }] },
  });
  ok(code(foreignLedger) === "NOT_FOUND", `${tag} cannot post into another organisation's ledgers`);
  const badQty = await gql("owner", "mutation($i: IssueInvoiceInput!) { issueInvoice(input: $i) { id } }", { i: { branchId: a.branch.id, patientId, items: [{ name: "X", qty: 0, ratePaise: 100 }] } });
  ok(code(badQty) === "BAD_USER_INPUT", `${tag} qty 0 → BAD_USER_INPUT`);

  // permissions: front desk limited to branch A
  ok(code(await gql("desk", "{ trialBalance { differencePaise } }")) === "FORBIDDEN", `${tag} front desk cannot read the books → FORBIDDEN`);
  const deskA = await gql("desk", "mutation($i: RegisterPatientInput!) { registerPatient(input: $i) { uhid } }", { i: { branchId: a.branch.id, name: "Walk In", sex: "male" } });
  const deskB = await gql("desk", "mutation($i: RegisterPatientInput!) { registerPatient(input: $i) { uhid } }", { i: { branchId: b2.id, name: "Walk In", sex: "male" } });
  ok(deskA.data?.registerPatient.uhid && code(deskB) === "FORBIDDEN", `${tag} front desk registers in branch A, not branch B`);
  const deskList = await gql("desk", "{ invoices { id branch { code } } }");
  ok(Array.isArray(deskList.data?.invoices) && deskList.data.invoices.every((i: any) => i.branch.code === "A01"), `${tag} lists only show the viewer's branches`);
  const discount = await gql("desk", "mutation($i: IssueInvoiceInput!) { issueInvoice(input: $i) { id } }", { i: { branchId: a.branch.id, patientId, items: [{ name: "X", ratePaise: 1000 }], billDiscountPaise: 100 } });
  ok(code(discount) === "FORBIDDEN", `${tag} discounts need invoice:discount`);

  // tenant isolation
  ok(code(await gql("other", "query($id: ID!) { invoice(id: $id) { id } }", { id: invoiceId })) === "NOT_FOUND", `${tag} another organisation cannot read this invoice`);
  ok((await gql("other", "query($id: ID!) { patient(id: $id) { id } }", { id: patientId })).data?.patient === null, `${tag} …or this patient`);

  // N+1: 10 invoices with their patients → one batched lookup
  for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) await gql("owner", "mutation($i: IssueInvoiceInput!) { issueInvoice(input: $i) { id } }", { i: { branchId: a.branch.id, patientId, items: [{ name: "T", ratePaise: 1000 }] } });
  getManyCalls = 0;
  const list = await gql("owner", "{ invoices(limit: 10) { invoiceNo patient { name } } }");
  ok(list.data?.invoices.length === 10 && getManyCalls === 1, `${tag} 10 invoices → ${getManyCalls} batched patient query (no N+1)`);
}
```

## File: scripts/llms-full.mjs

````js
// Builds llms-full.txt: every doc and source file of the repo in one plain-text document for AI tools.
//   node scripts/llms-full.mjs "<title>" <file-or-folder> [file-or-folder …]
// Folders are walked recursively. Output order: README, AGENTS, docs, then the rest alphabetically.
// Skipped: build output, dependencies, lockfiles, generated files, binaries. Files over 150 KB are
// listed (path + size) instead of inlined. CI checks the file is up to date (`npm run llms` + git diff).
import { readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { extname, join, relative } from "node:path";

const [title, ...inputs] = process.argv.slice(2);
if (!title || !inputs.length) {
  console.error('usage: node scripts/llms-full.mjs "<title>" <file-or-folder> …');
  process.exit(1);
}

const TEXT = new Set([".ts", ".tsx", ".mts", ".cts", ".js", ".mjs", ".cjs", ".md", ".mdx", ".json", ".css", ".yml", ".yaml", ".txt", ".graphql", ".gql", ".sql", ".html"]);
const SKIP_DIRS = new Set(["node_modules", "dist", ".next", ".git", ".turbo", "coverage", "examples", ".pg-test"]);
const SKIP_FILES = /(^|\/)(package-lock\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml|yarn\.lock|llms-full\.txt|[^/]*\.generated\.[^/]+|[^/]*\.log)$/;
const MAX = 150 * 1024;
const LANG = { ".ts": "ts", ".tsx": "tsx", ".mts": "ts", ".cts": "ts", ".js": "js", ".mjs": "js", ".cjs": "js", ".json": "json", ".css": "css", ".yml": "yaml", ".yaml": "yaml", ".graphql": "graphql", ".gql": "graphql", ".sql": "sql", ".html": "html" };

const posix = (p) => p.split("\\").join("/");
const files = new Set();
function walk(p) {
  const st = statSync(p);
  if (st.isDirectory()) {
    for (const name of readdirSync(p)) if (!SKIP_DIRS.has(name)) walk(join(p, name));
  } else if (TEXT.has(extname(p).toLowerCase()) && !SKIP_FILES.test(posix(p))) {
    files.add(posix(relative(".", p)));
  }
}
for (const input of inputs) walk(input);

const rank = (f) => (/^README\.md$/i.test(f) ? 0 : /^AGENTS\.md$/i.test(f) ? 1 : /^docs\//.test(f) ? 2 : 3);
const ordered = [...files].sort((a, b) => rank(a) - rank(b) || (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0));

const parts = [`# ${title} — full documentation and source\n\n> Generated by scripts/llms-full.mjs. Do not edit by hand. ${ordered.length} files.\n\n## Contents\n\n${ordered.map((f) => `- ${f}`).join("\n")}\n`];
const omitted = [];
for (const f of ordered) {
  // LF-normalised text, so Windows and Linux checkouts produce byte-identical output
  const body = readFileSync(f, "utf8").replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").trim();
  const size = Buffer.byteLength(body);
  if (size > MAX) {
    omitted.push(`${f} (${(size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB)`);
    parts.push(`\n\n---\n\n## File: ${f}\n\n_Omitted: ${(size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB. Read the file directly._\n`);
    continue;
  }
  const lang = LANG[extname(f).toLowerCase()];
  const fence = body.includes("```") ? "````" : "```";
  parts.push(`\n\n---\n\n## File: ${f}\n\n${lang ? `${fence}${lang}\n${body}\n${fence}` : body}\n`);
}
const out = parts.join("");
writeFileSync("llms-full.txt", out);
console.log(`llms-full.txt: ${ordered.length} files, ${(out.length / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB${omitted.length ? `; omitted (too large): ${omitted.join(", ")}` : ""}`);
````

## File: scripts/test.ts

```ts
// npm test — the same contract suite against real MongoDB (single-node replica set) and real
// PostgreSQL, both started in-process; then the Redis cache toolkit (ioredis-mock, or REDIS_URL),
// and the Fastify / Express adapters.
import { rmSync } from "node:fs";
import EmbeddedPostgres from "embedded-postgres";
import Fastify from "fastify";
import RedisMock from "ioredis-mock";
import { MongoMemoryReplSet, MongoMemoryServer } from "mongodb-memory-server";
import {
  balanceSheet, cancelInvoice, cancelVoucher, ConflictError, createBooking, createDb, dayBook, defaultPostingHook, gstSummary, invoiceBalance,
  issueInvoice, ledgerBalance, ledgerStatement, NotFoundError, outstandingReceivables, PeriodLockedError, postVoucher, profitAndLoss,
  recordPayment, registerPatient, seedChartOfAccounts, seedOrganization, transitionReport, trialBalance, UnbalancedVoucherError,
  type Branch, type Db, type Organization, type PostingHook, type Repositories,
} from "../src/index";
import { createCache, fixedWindowLimiter, slidingWindowLimiter, withCache, withLock } from "../src/cache/index";
import { createMongoRepositories, TransactionsUnsupportedError } from "../src/mongo/index";
import { createPgRepositories } from "../src/pg/index";
import { mgplDb } from "../src/adapters/fastify";
import { attachDb, dbErrorHandler } from "../src/adapters/express";
import { graphqlSuite } from "./graphql-suite";

let failed = 0;
let passed = 0;
const ok = (cond: unknown, msg: string) => {
  if (cond) { passed++; console.log(`  ok    ${msg}`); }
  else { failed++; console.log(`  FAIL  ${msg}`); }
};
const rejects = async (p: Promise<unknown>, type: new (...a: any[]) => Error, msg: string) => {
  try { await p; ok(false, `${msg} (no error)`); } catch (e) { ok(e instanceof type, `${msg}${e instanceof type ? "" : ` (got ${(e as Error).name}: ${(e as Error).message})`}`); }
};
const sleep = (ms: number) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ contract suite (both backends)

async function contract(db: Db) {
  const r = db.rawRepos;
  const tag = `[${db.backend}]`;
  console.log(`\n${tag} setup`);
  const { org, branch, owner } = await seedOrganization(r, {
    org: { name: "Maa Gayatri Path Lab", code: "MGPL", gstin: "22AAAAA0000A1Z5" },
    branch: { code: "RPR01", name: "Raipur" },
    owner: { name: "Owner", email: "Owner@Example.com", passwordHash: "scrypt$test" },
  });
  ok(org.id && branch.orgId === org.id && owner.email === "owner@example.com", `${tag} seed: org, branch, owner (email lower-cased)`);
  await rejects(seedOrganization(r, { org: { name: "Dup", code: "MGPL" }, branch: { code: "X", name: "X" }, owner: { name: "x", email: "x@x.in", passwordHash: "h" } }), Error, `${tag} duplicate org code rejected (unique index)`);
  const coa = await seedChartOfAccounts(r, org.id);
  ok(coa.groups.length === 28, `${tag} chart of accounts: ${coa.groups.length} Tally groups`);
  ok(coa.ledgers.some((l) => l.systemKey === "receivables") && coa.ledgers.length >= 19, `${tag} default ledgers: ${coa.ledgers.length}`);
  ok((await seedChartOfAccounts(r, org.id)).ledgers.length === coa.ledgers.length, `${tag} seeding the chart again is idempotent`);

  console.log(`${tag} patients, bookings, reports`);
  const p1 = await registerPatient(r, { orgId: org.id, branchId: branch.id, name: "Kavita Sharma", sex: "female", ageYears: 32, phone: "9000000001" });
  const p2 = await registerPatient(r, { orgId: org.id, branchId: branch.id, name: "Ravi Verma", sex: "male", ageYears: 45, phone: "9000000002" });
  ok(p1.uhid === "MGPL-000001" && p2.uhid === "MGPL-000002", `${tag} UHIDs ${p1.uhid}, ${p2.uhid}`);
  ok((await r.patients.search(org.id, "kav"))[0]?.id === p1.id && (await r.patients.search(org.id, "000002"))[0]?.id === p2.id, `${tag} patient search by name and UHID`);
  ok(p1.createdAt instanceof Date && !("_id" in p1), `${tag} entities have id + Date timestamps`);

  const { booking, samples } = await createBooking(r, {
    orgId: org.id, branchId: branch.id, patientId: p1.id,
    tests: [
      { testCode: "CBC", name: "Complete Blood Count", pricePaise: 39900, sampleType: "EDTA" },
      { testCode: "LIFT", name: "Liver Function Tests", pricePaise: 64900, sampleType: "SERUM" },
      { testCode: "KIPR", name: "Kidney Profile", pricePaise: 59900, sampleType: "SERUM" },
    ],
  }, owner.id);
  ok(/^RPR01-\d{6}-0001$/.test(booking.bookingNo), `${tag} booking number ${booking.bookingNo}`);
  ok(samples.length === 2 && new Set(samples.map((s) => s.barcode)).size === 2, `${tag} one sample per sample type (${samples.map((s) => s.barcode).join(", ")})`);

  const report = await r.reports.create({ orgId: org.id, branchId: branch.id, bookingId: booking.id, patientId: p1.id, testCode: "CBC", testName: "CBC", results: [], status: "draft", version: 1 });
  await transitionReport(r, report.id, "entered", owner.id, { results: [{ parameter: "Hemoglobin", value: "10.8", unit: "g/dL", flag: "L" }] });
  const verified = await transitionReport(r, report.id, "verified", owner.id);
  ok(verified.status === "verified" && verified.verifiedBy === owner.id && verified.results[0]?.value === "10.8", `${tag} report draft → entered → verified`);
  await rejects(transitionReport(r, report.id, "draft", owner.id), ConflictError, `${tag} illegal report transition rejected`);

  console.log(`${tag} invoices, payments, ACID`);
  const { invoice, payments } = await issueInvoice(r, {
    orgId: org.id, branchId: branch.id, patientId: p1.id, bookingId: booking.id,
    items: [
      { code: "CBC", name: "Complete Blood Count", ratePaise: 39900 },
      { code: "LIFT", name: "Liver Function Tests", ratePaise: 64900, discountPaise: 4900 },
      { code: "SYR5", name: "Syringe 5 ml", category: "consumable", qty: 2, ratePaise: 1000, taxPercent: 12 },
    ],
    billDiscountPaise: 5000,
    payments: [{ amountPaise: 50000, mode: "cash" }],
  }, owner.id);
  ok(/^MGPL\/RPR01\/\d{4}-\d{2}\/000001$/.test(invoice.invoiceNo), `${tag} invoice number ${invoice.invoiceNo}`);
  ok(invoice.totalPaise % 100 === 0 && invoice.paidPaise === 50000 && invoice.duePaise === invoice.totalPaise - 50000, `${tag} totals: Rs ${invoice.totalPaise / 100}, paid 500, due ${invoice.duePaise / 100}`);
  ok(invoice.status === "partially_paid" && payments.length === 1, `${tag} status partially_paid`);
  ok((await r.bookings.get(booking.id))?.invoiceId === invoice.id, `${tag} booking linked to invoice`);

  await rejects(recordPayment(r, { invoiceId: invoice.id, amountPaise: invoice.duePaise + 100, mode: "upi" }), ConflictError, `${tag} overpayment rejected`);
  // two concurrent payments that together exceed the due amount: the lock lets exactly one through
  const half = Math.ceil(invoice.duePaise / 2) + 100;
  const race = await Promise.allSettled([
    recordPayment(r, { invoiceId: invoice.id, amountPaise: half, mode: "upi" }),
    recordPayment(r, { invoiceId: invoice.id, amountPaise: half, mode: "card" }),
  ]);
  const after = (await r.invoices.get(invoice.id))!;
  ok(race.filter((x) => x.status === "fulfilled").length === 1 && after.paidPaise === 50000 + half, `${tag} concurrent payments: one accepted, one rejected (no lost update)`);
  // deterministic lock check: while T1 holds the invoice, T2's getForUpdate must wait for T1's commit
  let held!: () => void;
  const holding = new Promise<void>((res) => (held = res));
  const t1 = r.transaction(async (tx) => { await tx.invoices.getForUpdate(invoice.id); held(); await sleep(300); });
  await holding;
  const waitStart = Date.now();
  await r.transaction(async (tx) => tx.invoices.getForUpdate(invoice.id));
  const waited = Date.now() - waitStart;
  await t1;
  ok(waited >= 200, `${tag} invoice lock: a second transaction waited ${waited} ms for the first to commit`);

  const paid = await recordPayment(r, { invoiceId: invoice.id, amountPaise: after.duePaise, mode: "upi", reference: "UPI123" });
  ok(paid.invoice.status === "paid" && paid.invoice.duePaise === 0, `${tag} paid in full`);
  const refund = await recordPayment(r, { invoiceId: invoice.id, amountPaise: 10000, mode: "cash", kind: "refund" });
  ok(refund.invoice.status === "partially_paid" && refund.invoice.duePaise === 10000, `${tag} refund re-opens Rs 100 due`);

  // atomicity: a failing transaction leaves nothing behind (not even a consumed counter)
  const doctorsBefore = await r.doctors.count({ orgId: org.id });
  const seqBefore = await r.counters.peek("test:atomic");
  await rejects(r.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.doctors.create({ orgId: org.id, name: "Dr Rollback", active: true });
    await tx.counters.next("test:atomic");
    throw new ConflictError("boom");
  }), ConflictError, `${tag} transaction error propagates`);
  ok((await r.doctors.count({ orgId: org.id })) === doctorsBefore && (await r.counters.peek("test:atomic")) === seqBefore, `${tag} rollback: no doctor, no counter increment`);

  const unpaid = (await issueInvoice(r, { orgId: org.id, branchId: branch.id, patientId: p2.id, items: [{ name: "Blood Group", ratePaise: 11900 }] })).invoice;
  ok(unpaid.invoiceNo.endsWith("000002") && unpaid.status === "issued", `${tag} second invoice ${unpaid.invoiceNo} (gap-free series)`);
  await rejects(cancelInvoice(r, invoice.id, "test"), ConflictError, `${tag} cannot cancel an invoice with payments`);

  console.log(`${tag} accounting`);
  const tb = await trialBalance(r, { orgId: org.id });
  ok(tb.totalDebitPaise === tb.totalCreditPaise && tb.totalDebitPaise > 0, `${tag} trial balance balances: Dr ${tb.totalDebitPaise} = Cr ${tb.totalCreditPaise}`);
  const recv = (await r.ledgers.findBySystemKey(org.id, "receivables"))!;
  const dues = (await r.invoices.find({ orgId: org.id })).reduce((s, i) => s + i.duePaise, 0);
  ok((await ledgerBalance(r, { orgId: org.id, ledgerId: recv.id })) === dues, `${tag} Patient Receivables = sum of invoice dues (${dues})`);
  const cash = (await r.ledgers.findBySystemKey(org.id, "cash"))!;
  ok((await ledgerBalance(r, { orgId: org.id, ledgerId: cash.id })) === 50000 - 10000, `${tag} cash ledger = 500 received − 100 refunded`);
  const from = new Date(Date.now() - 86400000), to = new Date(Date.now() + 86400000);
  const st = await ledgerStatement(r, { orgId: org.id, ledgerId: recv.id, from, to });
  ok(st.closingPaise === dues && st.rows.at(-1)?.balancePaise === dues, `${tag} ledger statement running balance closes at ${st.closingPaise}`);
  const pl = await profitAndLoss(r, { orgId: org.id, from, to });
  const bs = await balanceSheet(r, { orgId: org.id, asOf: to });
  ok(bs.differencePaise === 0 && bs.profitPaise === pl.netProfitPaise, `${tag} balance sheet balances; profit ${pl.netProfitPaise} matches P&L`);
  const gst = await gstSummary(r, { orgId: org.id, from, to });
  ok(gst.totalTaxPaise === invoice.taxPaise && gst.cgstPaise + gst.sgstPaise === invoice.taxPaise, `${tag} GST summary: CGST ${gst.cgstPaise} + SGST ${gst.sgstPaise}`);
  const out = await outstandingReceivables(r, { orgId: org.id });
  ok(out.totalDuePaise === dues && out.buckets["0-30"] === dues, `${tag} outstanding receivables with ageing`);
  const book = await dayBook(r, { orgId: org.id, from, to });
  ok(book.filter((v) => v.type === "sales").length === 2 && book.filter((v) => v.type === "receipt").length === 3 && book.some((v) => v.type === "payment"), `${tag} day book: ${book.length} vouchers (2 sales, 3 receipts, 1 refund)`);

  await rejects(postVoucher(r, { orgId: org.id, branchId: branch.id, type: "journal", entries: [{ ledgerId: cash.id, debitPaise: 100, creditPaise: 0 }, { ledgerId: recv.id, debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: 90 }] }), UnbalancedVoucherError, `${tag} unbalanced voucher rejected`);
  const capital = (await r.ledgers.findBySystemKey(org.id, "capital"))!;
  const jv = await postVoucher(r, { orgId: org.id, branchId: branch.id, type: "receipt", narration: "Capital introduced", entries: [{ ledgerId: cash.id, debitPaise: 1000000, creditPaise: 0 }, { ledgerId: capital.id, debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: 1000000 }] });
  ok(jv.voucherNo.startsWith("RCT/") && (await trialBalance(r, { orgId: org.id })).differencePaise === 0, `${tag} manual voucher ${jv.voucherNo}; books still balance`);

  const cancelled = await cancelInvoice(r, unpaid.id, "duplicate", owner.id);
  const salesVouchers = await r.vouchers.find({ invoiceId: unpaid.id } as any);
  ok(cancelled.status === "cancelled" && salesVouchers.every((v) => v.status === "cancelled"), `${tag} cancelling an invoice cancels its sales voucher`);
  ok((await r.ledgerEntries.list({ orgId: org.id, invoiceId: unpaid.id })).length === 0 && (await trialBalance(r, { orgId: org.id })).differencePaise === 0, `${tag} its postings are removed; books balance`);
  ok((await r.audit.find({ orgId: org.id })).length > 10, `${tag} audit log written`);
  await rejects(recordPayment(r, { invoiceId: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000", amountPaise: 100, mode: "cash" }), NotFoundError, `${tag} unknown invoice → NotFoundError`);
  return { org, branch };
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ finance storage (both backends)

/** Storage used by finance-kit: B2B customers, partners, settlements, cash, bank, lock dates, tax rules, credit notes. */
async function financeStorage(db: Db, org: Organization, branch: Branch, withPosting: (hook: PostingHook) => Promise<Repositories>) {
  const r = db.rawRepos;
  const tag = `[${db.backend}]`;
  const orgId = org.id;
  console.log(`\n${tag} finance storage`);
  const ledgerIn = async (group: string, name: string) => {
    const g = (await r.accountGroups.findOne({ orgId, name: group }))!;
    return r.ledgers.create({ orgId, name, groupId: g.id, openingPaise: 0, systemKey: null, active: true });
  };

  const b2 = await r.branches.create({ orgId, code: "BLS01", name: "Bilaspur CC", kind: "collection_center", stateCode: "22", active: true });
  ok((await r.branches.get(b2.id))?.stateCode === "22", `${tag} branch stateCode`);

  // customers: unique code, own ledger, row lock
  const custLedger = await ledgerIn("Sundry Debtors", "City Hospital");
  const cust = await r.customers.create({ orgId, code: "CITYHOSP", name: "City Hospital", kind: "hospital", gstin: "22AABCC1234D1Z5", stateCode: "22", creditLimitPaise: 5000000, creditDays: 30, ledgerId: custLedger.id, active: true });
  ok(cust.code === "CITYHOSP" && cust.creditLimitPaise === 5000000 && cust.ledgerId === custLedger.id, `${tag} customer stored with its own ledger`);
  await rejects(r.customers.create({ orgId, code: "CITYHOSP", name: "Dup", kind: "other", creditLimitPaise: null, creditDays: 0, ledgerId: custLedger.id, active: true }), Error, `${tag} duplicate customer code rejected`);
  const open = await r.customers.create({ orgId, code: "WALKCORP", name: "Walk Corp", kind: "corporate", creditLimitPaise: null, creditDays: 15, ledgerId: (await ledgerIn("Sundry Debtors", "Walk Corp")).id, active: true });
  ok(open.creditLimitPaise === null, `${tag} customer without a credit limit keeps null`);
  let held!: () => void;
  const holding = new Promise<void>((res) => (held = res));
  const t1 = r.transaction(async (tx) => { await tx.customers.getForUpdate(cust.id); held(); await sleep(300); });
  await holding;
  const waitStart = Date.now();
  await r.transaction(async (tx) => tx.customers.getForUpdate(cust.id));
  const waited = Date.now() - waitStart;
  await t1;
  ok(waited >= 200, `${tag} customer lock: a second transaction waited ${waited} ms`);

  // B2B invoice fields, GST line fields, listByDate
  const patient = (await r.patients.find({ orgId }))[0]!;
  const { invoice: b2b } = await issueInvoice(r, {
    orgId, branchId: branch.id, patientId: patient.id, customerId: cust.id, placeOfSupply: "22", buyerGstin: cust.gstin,
    items: [{ code: "CBC", name: "CBC", ratePaise: 39900, hsnSac: "999316", taxability: "exempt" }, { code: "SYR", name: "Syringe", category: "consumable", ratePaise: 1000, taxPercent: 12, hsnSac: "9018", taxability: "taxable" }],
  });
  const got = (await r.invoices.get(b2b.id))!;
  ok(got.customerId === cust.id && got.placeOfSupply === "22" && got.buyerGstin === "22AABCC1234D1Z5" && got.creditedPaise === 0, `${tag} invoice: customer, place of supply, buyer GSTIN, creditedPaise 0`);
  ok(got.items[0]?.hsnSac === "999316" && got.items[0]?.taxability === "exempt" && got.items[1]?.taxability === "taxable", `${tag} invoice lines keep SAC/HSN and taxability`);
  const day = 86400000;
  const listed = await r.invoices.listByDate({ orgId, from: new Date(Date.now() - day), to: new Date(Date.now() + day) });
  const byCust = await r.invoices.listByDate({ orgId, customerId: cust.id });
  ok(listed.length >= 2 && listed.every((i) => i.status !== "cancelled") && byCust.length === 1 && byCust[0]!.id === b2b.id, `${tag} invoices.listByDate (by date and customer; cancelled left out)`);
  ok((await r.invoices.listByDate({ orgId, includeCancelled: true })).some((i) => i.status === "cancelled"), `${tag} invoices.listByDate includeCancelled`);
  const { duePaise, status } = invoiceBalance({ totalPaise: 10000, creditedPaise: 10000 }, 0);
  const part = invoiceBalance({ totalPaise: 10000, creditedPaise: 4000 }, 6000);
  ok(duePaise === 0 && status === "credited" && part.duePaise === 0 && part.status === "paid", `${tag} invoiceBalance: credit notes reduce what is due`);

  // tax rules
  const rule = await r.taxRules.create({ orgId, code: null, category: "medicine", hsnSac: "3004", taxability: "taxable", ratePercent: 0.25, effectiveFrom: new Date("2026-04-01T00:00:00+05:30"), effectiveTo: null });
  const ruleBack = (await r.taxRules.find({ orgId, category: "medicine" }))[0]!;
  ok(ruleBack.id === rule.id && ruleBack.ratePercent === 0.25 && typeof ruleBack.ratePercent === "number" && ruleBack.code === null && ruleBack.effectiveFrom instanceof Date, `${tag} tax rule (fractional rate stays a number)`);

  // partners, agreements, settlements
  const payable = await ledgerIn("Sundry Creditors", "Bilaspur CC Partner");
  const partner = await r.partners.create({ orgId, code: "BLS", name: "Bilaspur CC", kind: "collection_centre", branchId: b2.id, pan: "ABCDE1234F", ledgerId: payable.id, tds: { section: "194H", rateBp: 200 }, active: true });
  ok(partner.tds?.rateBp === 200 && (await r.partners.get(partner.id))?.tds?.section === "194H", `${tag} partner with a TDS override`);
  const ag = await r.partnerAgreements.create({ orgId, partnerId: partner.id, kind: "fixed_rate", rates: [{ code: "CBC", sharePaise: 8000 }], defaultSharePaise: 5000, effectiveFrom: new Date("2026-04-01T00:00:00+05:30"), effectiveTo: null });
  const agBack = (await r.partnerAgreements.find({ partnerId: partner.id }))[0]!;
  ok(agBack.id === ag.id && agBack.rates?.[0]?.sharePaise === 8000 && agBack.categories === undefined && agBack.shareBp === null, `${tag} agreement: rates round-trip`);
  const sBase = {
    orgId, branchId: branch.id, partnerId: partner.id, period: "2026-10", from: new Date("2026-10-01T00:00:00+05:30"), to: new Date("2026-10-31T23:59:59.999+05:30"),
    lines: [{ invoiceId: b2b.id, invoiceNo: b2b.invoiceNo, day: "2026-10-03", code: "CBC", name: "CBC", netPaise: 39900, sharePaise: 8000, agreementId: ag.id }],
    grossPaise: 39900, sharePaise: 8000, deductions: [{ label: "Tubes", amountPaise: 500 }], deductionsPaise: 500, tdsSection: "194H", tdsRateBp: 200, tdsBasePaise: 8000, tdsPaise: 200, netPaise: 7300, status: "draft" as const,
  };
  const s1 = await r.settlements.create({ ...sBase, periodKey: `${partner.id}:2026-10` });
  ok(s1.lines[0]?.day === "2026-10-03" && s1.deductions[0]?.label === "Tubes" && (await r.settlements.get(s1.id))?.lines[0]?.sharePaise === 8000, `${tag} settlement lines and deductions round-trip`);
  await rejects(r.settlements.create({ ...sBase, periodKey: `${partner.id}:2026-10` }), Error, `${tag} one live settlement per partner per month (unique periodKey)`);
  await r.settlements.update(s1.id, { status: "cancelled", periodKey: null });
  const s2 = await r.settlements.create({ ...sBase, periodKey: `${partner.id}:2026-10` });
  await r.settlements.update(s2.id, { status: "cancelled", periodKey: null });
  ok((await r.settlements.count({ partnerId: partner.id, status: "cancelled" })) === 2, `${tag} cancelled settlements free the month (several null periodKeys)`);

  // cash closings
  const cc = await r.cashClosings.create({ orgId, branchId: b2.id, day: "2026-10-14", bookPaise: 100000, countedPaise: 99500, differencePaise: -500, denominations: [{ valuePaise: 50000, count: 1 }, { valuePaise: 100, count: 495 }], closedBy: null });
  ok(cc.denominations?.length === 2 && cc.differencePaise === -500, `${tag} cash closing with denominations`);
  await rejects(r.cashClosings.create({ orgId, branchId: b2.id, day: "2026-10-14", bookPaise: 0, countedPaise: 0, differencePaise: 0 }), Error, `${tag} one cash closing per branch per day`);

  // bank statements and lines
  const bank = (await r.ledgers.findBySystemKey(orgId, "bank"))!;
  const stmt = await r.bankStatements.create({ orgId, branchId: branch.id, ledgerId: bank.id, fileName: "oct.csv", from: null, to: null, lineCount: 1 });
  const line = await r.bankLines.create({ orgId, statementId: stmt.id, ledgerId: bank.id, date: new Date("2026-10-05T00:00:00+05:30"), description: "UPI SETTLEMENT", debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: 98000, dedupKey: "k1", status: "unmatched", voucherIds: [] });
  ok(Array.isArray(line.voucherIds) && line.voucherIds.length === 0 && line.status === "unmatched", `${tag} bank line stored`);
  await r.bankLines.update(line.id, { status: "matched", matchKind: "settlement", voucherIds: [b2b.id], settlement: { ledgerId: bank.id, day: "2026-10-04", grossPaise: 100000, feePaise: 2000 } });
  const lineBack = (await r.bankLines.get(line.id))!;
  ok(lineBack.voucherIds[0] === b2b.id && lineBack.settlement?.feePaise === 2000 && (await r.bankLines.count({ ledgerId: bank.id, status: "matched" })) === 1, `${tag} bank line match fields round-trip`);
  await rejects(r.bankLines.create({ orgId, statementId: stmt.id, ledgerId: bank.id, date: new Date(), description: "dup", debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: 1, dedupKey: "k1", status: "unmatched", voucherIds: [] }), Error, `${tag} bank line dedupKey is unique (re-import adds nothing)`);

  // credit notes
  const cn = await r.creditNotes.create({
    orgId, branchId: branch.id, invoiceId: b2b.id, customerId: cust.id, noteNo: "MGPL/RPR01/CN/2026-27/000001", date: new Date(), reason: "price correction",
    lines: [{ itemIndex: 1, name: "Syringe", hsnSac: "9018", taxability: "taxable", taxPercent: 12, taxablePaise: 1000, taxPaise: 120, cgstPaise: 60, sgstPaise: 60, igstPaise: 0 }],
    taxablePaise: 1000, taxPaise: 120, cgstPaise: 60, sgstPaise: 60, igstPaise: 0, roundOffPaise: 0, totalPaise: 1120, status: "issued",
  });
  ok((await r.creditNotes.listByDate({ orgId, from: new Date(Date.now() - day), to: new Date(Date.now() + day) }))[0]?.id === cn.id && (await r.creditNotes.find({ invoiceId: b2b.id }))[0]?.lines[0]?.cgstPaise === 60, `${tag} credit note stored and listed by date`);

  // lock dates: postings and cancellations on or before the lock fail, inside the transaction
  const cash = (await r.ledgers.findBySystemKey(orgId, "cash"))!;
  const capital = (await r.ledgers.findBySystemKey(orgId, "capital"))!;
  const jv = (date: Date, b = b2.id) => postVoucher(r, { orgId, branchId: b, type: "journal", date, entries: [{ ledgerId: cash.id, debitPaise: 100, creditPaise: 0 }, { ledgerId: capital.id, debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: 100 }] });
  const sept = await jv(new Date("2026-09-15T10:00:00+05:30"));
  const locks = await r.transaction((tx) => tx.periodLocks.hold(orgId, [b2.id, "org"], "update"));
  ok(locks.length === 2 && locks.every((l) => l.lockedUpTo === null) && locks.some((l) => l.scope === "org" && l.branchId === null), `${tag} periodLocks.hold creates empty org and branch rows`);
  const lockedUpTo = new Date("2026-09-30T23:59:59.999+05:30");
  await r.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const [l] = await tx.periodLocks.hold(orgId, [b2.id], "update");
    await tx.periodLocks.update(l!.id, { lockedUpTo });
  });
  await rejects(jv(new Date("2026-09-30T18:00:00+05:30")), PeriodLockedError, `${tag} posting on the lock date fails`);
  await rejects(cancelVoucher(r, sept.id), ConflictError, `${tag} cancelling a voucher in a locked period fails (ConflictError)`);
  ok((await jv(new Date("2026-09-30T18:00:00+05:30"), branch.id)).status === "posted" && (await jv(new Date("2026-10-01T00:00:00+05:30"))).status === "posted", `${tag} other branches and later dates still post`);
  // concurrency: a lock moved forward while a posting is in flight still stops it
  let lockHeld!: () => void;
  const lockHolding = new Promise<void>((res) => (lockHeld = res));
  const mover = r.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const [l] = await tx.periodLocks.hold(orgId, ["org"], "update");
    lockHeld();
    await sleep(300);
    await tx.periodLocks.update(l!.id, { lockedUpTo: new Date("2026-10-10T23:59:59.999+05:30") });
  });
  await lockHolding;
  await rejects(jv(new Date("2026-10-05T12:00:00+05:30"), branch.id), PeriodLockedError, `${tag} concurrent lock change: the in-flight posting waits, then fails`);
  await mover;
  await r.transaction(async (tx) => {
    for (const l of await tx.periodLocks.hold(orgId, ["org", b2.id], "update")) await tx.periodLocks.update(l.id, { lockedUpTo: null });
  });

  // closing vouchers stay out of the P&L
  const sales = (await r.ledgers.findBySystemKey(orgId, "sales"))!;
  const from = new Date(Date.now() - day), to = new Date(Date.now() + day);
  const before = await profitAndLoss(r, { orgId, from, to });
  const closing = await postVoucher(r, { orgId, branchId: branch.id, type: "closing", entries: [{ ledgerId: sales.id, debitPaise: 1000, creditPaise: 0 }, { ledgerId: capital.id, debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: 1000 }] });
  const after = await profitAndLoss(r, { orgId, from, to });
  const tot = await r.ledgerEntries.totals({ orgId, ledgerId: sales.id, excludeVoucherTypes: ["closing"] });
  const all = await r.ledgerEntries.totals({ orgId, ledgerId: sales.id });
  ok(closing.voucherNo.startsWith("CLS/") && after.netProfitPaise === before.netProfitPaise && all[0]!.debitPaise - tot[0]!.debitPaise === 1000, `${tag} closing voucher ${closing.voucherNo}: left out of the P&L and of excludeVoucherTypes totals`);
  await cancelVoucher(r, closing.id);

  // posting hook: billing calls the configured hook inside its transaction
  const calls: string[] = [];
  const spy: PostingHook = {
    async invoiceIssued(tx, inv, a) { calls.push(`issued:${tx.posting === spy}`); await defaultPostingHook.invoiceIssued(tx, inv, a); },
    async paymentRecorded(tx, p, no, a) { calls.push(`paid:${p.mode}`); await defaultPostingHook.paymentRecorded(tx, p, no, a); },
    async invoiceCancelled(tx, id, a) { calls.push("cancelled"); await defaultPostingHook.invoiceCancelled(tx, id, a); },
  };
  const hooked = await withPosting(spy);
  const hi = await issueInvoice(hooked, { orgId, branchId: branch.id, patientId: patient.id, items: [{ name: "ESR", ratePaise: 9900 }], payments: [{ amountPaise: 5000, mode: "upi" }] });
  await recordPayment(hooked, { invoiceId: hi.invoice.id, amountPaise: 4900, mode: "cash" });
  const hc = await issueInvoice(hooked, { orgId, branchId: branch.id, patientId: patient.id, items: [{ name: "ESR", ratePaise: 9900 }] });
  await cancelInvoice(hooked, hc.invoice.id, "test");
  ok(calls.join(",") === "issued:true,paid:upi,paid:cash,issued:true,cancelled", `${tag} posting hook called by issueInvoice / recordPayment / cancelInvoice (${calls.join(",")})`);
  ok((await trialBalance(r, { orgId })).differencePaise === 0, `${tag} books still balance`);
  await hooked.close();
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ cache toolkit

async function cacheSuite() {
  console.log("\n[cache]");
  const real = process.env.REDIS_URL;
  const make = async () => (real ? new (await import("ioredis")).default(real) : (new RedisMock() as any));
  const redis = await make();
  if (!real) await redis.flushall();
  const prefix = `t${Date.now()}:`;
  const cache = createCache(redis, { prefix, ttl: 60 });

  let loads = 0;
  const loader = async () => { loads++; await sleep(30); return { name: "CBC", at: new Date("2026-01-01T00:00:00Z") }; };
  const a = await cache.getOrSet("x", loader);
  const b = await cache.getOrSet("x", loader);
  ok(loads === 1 && b.at instanceof Date && b.at.toISOString() === a.at.toISOString(), "cache-aside: second read is a hit; Dates survive");

  loads = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 20 }, () => cache.getOrSet("sf", loader)));
  ok(loads === 1, "single-flight: 20 concurrent misses → 1 load");

  loads = 0;
  const other = createCache(redis, { prefix, ttl: 60 }); // a second server sharing Redis
  await Promise.all([cache.getOrSet("lock", loader), other.getOrSet("lock", loader)]);
  ok(loads === 1 && other.stats().lockWaits + cache.stats().lockWaits >= 1, "stampede lock: two servers, one load, the other waits for the value");

  let version = 1;
  const v = async () => ({ v: version });
  await cache.getOrSet("swr", v, { ttl: 1, staleTtl: 30 });
  version = 2;
  await sleep(1300);
  const stale = await cache.getOrSet("swr", v, { ttl: 1, staleTtl: 30 });
  await sleep(100);
  const fresh = await cache.getOrSet("swr", v, { ttl: 1, staleTtl: 30 });
  ok(stale.v === 1 && fresh.v === 2, "stale-while-revalidate: stale value served instantly, refreshed in background");

  loads = 0;
  const missing = async () => { loads++; return null; };
  await cache.getOrSet("nf", missing, { negativeTtl: 30 });
  await cache.getOrSet("nf", missing, { negativeTtl: 30 });
  ok(loads === 1, "negative caching: a miss is remembered");

  await cache.getOrSet("p:1:profile", async () => 1, { tags: ["patient:1"] });
  await cache.getOrSet("p:1:reports", async () => 2, { tags: ["patient:1"] });
  ok((await cache.invalidateTags("patient:1")) === 2 && (await cache.get("p:1:profile")) === undefined, "tags: invalidate every key of patient 1");

  const ns = cache.namespace("catalog");
  await ns.getOrSet("cbc", async () => "old");
  await ns.bump();
  ok((await ns.getOrSet("cbc", async () => "new")) === "new", "versioned namespace: bump drops it in O(1)");

  const l1a = createCache(redis, { prefix: `${prefix}l1:`, l1: { ttlMs: 60_000 }, subscriber: await (real ? make() : redis.duplicate()) });
  const l1b = createCache(redis, { prefix: `${prefix}l1:`, l1: { ttlMs: 60_000 }, subscriber: await (real ? make() : redis.duplicate()) });
  await sleep(50);
  await l1a.getOrSet("k", async () => "A");
  await l1b.getOrSet("k", async () => "A");
  await l1b.getOrSet("k", async () => "A");
  ok(l1b.stats().l1Hits >= 1, "two-tier: repeat reads served from in-process L1");
  await l1a.set("k", "B");
  await sleep(100);
  ok((await l1b.getOrSet("k", async () => "A")) === "B", "two-tier: a write on server A clears L1 on server B (pub/sub)");

  const sliding = slidingWindowLimiter(redis, { limit: 3, windowMs: 1000, prefix: `${prefix}rl:` });
  const s = [await sliding("ip"), await sliding("ip"), await sliding("ip"), await sliding("ip")];
  ok(s.slice(0, 3).every((x) => x.allowed) && !s[3]!.allowed && s[3]!.retryAfterMs > 0, "sliding-window limiter: 3 allowed, 4th blocked with retry-after");
  const fixed = fixedWindowLimiter(redis, { limit: 2, windowMs: 60_000, prefix: `${prefix}rf:` });
  ok((await fixed("k")).allowed && (await fixed("k")).allowed && !(await fixed("k")).allowed, "fixed-window limiter");

  let inside = 0, maxInside = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 5 }, () => withLock(redis, `${prefix}job`, async () => { inside++; maxInside = Math.max(maxInside, inside); await sleep(20); inside--; }, { waitMs: 5000 })));
  ok(maxInside === 1, "distributed lock: mutual exclusion");
  return { redis, cache };
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ main

async function main() {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  // MongoDB: a one-node replica set, so transactions are real
  const rs = await MongoMemoryReplSet.create({ replSet: { count: 1, storageEngine: "wiredTiger" } });
  const mongo = await createDb({ backend: "mongo", mongo: { uri: rs.getUri("mgpl_test") } });
  const m = await contract(mongo);
  await financeStorage(mongo, m.org, m.branch, (posting) => createMongoRepositories({ uri: rs.getUri("mgpl_test"), posting }));
  await graphqlSuite(mongo, ok);

  // a standalone server refuses multi-document work instead of silently losing atomicity
  const standalone = await MongoMemoryServer.create();
  const sa = await createMongoRepositories({ uri: standalone.getUri("sa") });
  await rejects(sa.transaction(async () => 1), TransactionsUnsupportedError, "[mongo] standalone server: transaction() refuses (ACID)");
  ok((await (await createMongoRepositories({ uri: standalone.getUri("sa2"), allowNoTransactions: true })).transaction(async () => 7)) === 7, "[mongo] allowNoTransactions opt-in for dev");
  await sa.close();
  await standalone.stop();

  // PostgreSQL: a real server in a temp folder
  rmSync(".pg-test", { recursive: true, force: true });
  const pg = new EmbeddedPostgres({ databaseDir: ".pg-test", user: "postgres", password: "postgres", port: 54329, persistent: false });
  await pg.initialise();
  await pg.start();
  await pg.createDatabase("mgpl_test");
  const pgUrl = "postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:54329/mgpl_test";
  const pgdb = await createDb({ backend: "pg", pg: { url: pgUrl } });
  const p = await contract(pgdb);
  await financeStorage(pgdb, p.org, p.branch, (posting) => createPgRepositories({ url: pgUrl, posting }));
  await graphqlSuite(pgdb, ok);

  const { redis, cache } = await cacheSuite();

  console.log("\n[adapters]");
  const cached = withCache(mongo.rawRepos, cache, 60);
  const anyOrg = (await mongo.rawRepos.orgs.find())[0]!;
  await cached.orgs.get(anyOrg.id);
  await cached.orgs.update(anyOrg.id, { name: "Renamed Lab" });
  ok((await cached.orgs.get(anyOrg.id))?.name === "Renamed Lab", "cached repositories: update invalidates the cached read");

  const app = Fastify();
  await app.register(mgplDb, { db: { ...pgdb, repos: pgdb.rawRepos } });
  app.get("/orgs", async () => app.db.repos.orgs.find());
  app.get("/invoice/:id", async (req: any) => {
    const inv = await app.db.repos.invoices.get(req.params.id);
    if (!inv) throw new NotFoundError("Invoice", req.params.id);
    return inv;
  });
  const res = await app.inject({ url: "/orgs" });
  ok(res.statusCode === 200 && res.json()[0].code === "MGPL", "fastify: plugin decorates app.db, routes use repositories");
  const nf = await app.inject({ url: "/invoice/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000" });
  ok(nf.statusCode === 404, "fastify: NotFoundError → 404");
  await app.close();

  let seen: any;
  attachDb(pgdb)({}, {}, () => {});
  const req: any = {};
  attachDb(pgdb)(req, {}, () => { seen = req.db; });
  const sent: any = {};
  dbErrorHandler()(new ConflictError("x"), {}, { status: (s: number) => ({ json: (b: unknown) => Object.assign(sent, { s, b }) }) }, () => {});
  ok(seen === pgdb && sent.s === 409, "express: attachDb + dbErrorHandler (409)");

  await mongo.close();
  await rs.stop();
  await pgdb.close();
  await pg.stop();
  rmSync(".pg-test", { recursive: true, force: true });
  redis.disconnect();

  console.log(`\n${passed} passed, ${failed} failed in ${((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(1)}s`);
  process.exit(failed ? 1 : 0);
}

main().catch((e) => {
  console.error(e);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

## File: src/adapters/express.ts

```ts
import type { Db } from "../create-db";

/**
 * Express / Connect helpers. No express import: works with any (req, res, next) framework.
 *
 *   const db = await createDb({ backend: "mongo", mongo: { uri }, redis: process.env.REDIS_URL });
 *   app.use(attachDb(db));
 *   app.get("/patients/:id", async (req, res, next) => res.json(await req.db.repos.patients.get(req.params.id)));
 *   app.use(dbErrorHandler());
 */

type Next = (err?: unknown) => void;

export interface DbRequest {
  db: Db;
}

export function attachDb(db: Db) {
  return (req: any, _res: unknown, next: Next) => {
    (req as DbRequest).db = db;
    next();
  };
}

/** Maps db-kit errors (statusCode 404 / 409 / 422) to JSON responses; passes others on. */
export function dbErrorHandler() {
  return (err: any, _req: unknown, res: any, next: Next) => {
    const status = err?.statusCode;
    if (typeof status === "number" && status >= 400 && status < 500) {
      res.status(status).json({ error: err.message });
      return;
    }
    next(err);
  };
}
```

## File: src/adapters/fastify.ts

```ts
import type { FastifyInstance, FastifyPluginAsync } from "fastify";
import { createDb, type CreateDbOptions, type Db } from "../create-db";

declare module "fastify" {
  interface FastifyInstance {
    db: Db;
  }
}

export interface FastifyDbOptions extends Partial<CreateDbOptions> {
  /** An already created Db (shared with workers or other plugins). Otherwise one is created from the options. */
  db?: Db;
}

/**
 * Fastify plugin: decorates `fastify.db` ({ repos, rawRepos, cache, redis }) and closes it on shutdown.
 * Errors from db-kit carry `statusCode` (404 not found, 409 conflict, 422 unbalanced voucher), which
 * Fastify uses for the response.
 *
 *   await app.register(mgplDb, { backend: "pg", pg: { url: process.env.DATABASE_URL }, redis: process.env.REDIS_URL });
 *   app.get("/patients/:id", (req) => app.db.repos.patients.get(req.params.id));
 */
const plugin: FastifyPluginAsync<FastifyDbOptions> = async (fastify: FastifyInstance, options) => {
  const owned = !options.db;
  const db = options.db ?? (await createDb(options as CreateDbOptions));
  fastify.decorate("db", db);
  if (owned) fastify.addHook("onClose", async () => db.close());
};

// visible to the whole app (same as fastify-plugin), not only to this plugin's children
(plugin as any)[Symbol.for("skip-override")] = true;
(plugin as any)[Symbol.for("fastify.display-name")] = "mgpl-db";

export const mgplDb = plugin;
export default plugin;
```
