## File: src/cache/cache.ts

```ts
import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
import type { Redis } from "ioredis";
import { acquireLock, releaseLock } from "./lock";
import { Lru } from "./lru";
import { decode, encode } from "./serialize";

/**
 * Cache toolkit on Redis. Techniques (each optional, per call):
 *
 *  cache-aside        getOrSet(key, loader): read cache, on miss load and store
 *  TTL jitter         ±10% on every TTL so keys written together do not expire together
 *  single-flight      concurrent misses for one key in this process share one load
 *  stampede lock      across processes, only the lock holder loads; others wait for its value
 *  stale-while-       after `ttl`, serve the stale value for up to `staleTtl` while one caller
 *  revalidate         refreshes it in the background
 *  negative caching   remember "not found" for `negativeTtl` so misses do not hit the database
 *  tags               invalidate groups of keys (e.g. everything about patient 42)
 *  namespaces         versioned prefixes: bump the version to drop a whole namespace in O(1)
 *  two-tier (L1+L2)   in-process LRU in front of Redis; pub/sub keeps L1s on all servers in sync
 */

export interface CacheOptions {
  /** Key prefix, e.g. "mgpl:". */
  prefix?: string;
  /** Default TTL in seconds. Default 300. */
  ttl?: number;
  /** Random TTL spread, 0–1. Default 0.1 (±10%). */
  jitter?: number;
  /** In-process L1 tier. Default off. */
  l1?: { max?: number; ttlMs?: number } | false;
  /**
   * A second Redis connection for subscriptions (e.g. redis.duplicate()). With it, writes and
   * invalidations on any server clear the L1 tier on every server.
   */
  subscriber?: Redis;
}

export interface GetOrSetOptions {
  /** Fresh for this many seconds. */
  ttl?: number;
  /** After `ttl`, serve stale for this many more seconds while refreshing. Default 0 (off). */
  staleTtl?: number;
  /** Cache null/undefined results for this many seconds. Default 0 (do not cache misses). */
  negativeTtl?: number;
  tags?: string[];
  /** Distributed stampede lock. Default true when the loader is likely slow (always safe). */
  lock?: boolean | { ttlMs?: number; waitMs?: number };
  /** Use the L1 tier for this key. Default true when L1 is enabled. */
  l1?: boolean;
}

interface Envelope<T> {
  /** value */
  v: T;
  /** fresh until (epoch ms) */
  f: number;
  /** negative entry */
  n?: 1;
}

export interface CacheStats {
  hits: number;
  misses: number;
  staleHits: number;
  l1Hits: number;
  loads: number;
  lockWaits: number;
}

export type Cache = ReturnType<typeof createCache>;

export function createCache(redis: Redis, options: CacheOptions = {}) {
  const prefix = options.prefix ?? "mgpl:";
  const defaultTtl = options.ttl ?? 300;
  const jitter = options.jitter ?? 0.1;
  const l1 = options.l1 ? new Lru<Envelope<unknown>>(options.l1.max ?? 1000) : null;
  const l1Ttl = options.l1 ? options.l1.ttlMs ?? 5000 : 0;
  const channel = `${prefix}__invalidate`;
  const nodeId = randomBytes(6).toString("hex");
  const inflight = new Map<string, Promise<unknown>>();
  const stats: CacheStats = { hits: 0, misses: 0, staleHits: 0, l1Hits: 0, loads: 0, lockWaits: 0 };

  const k = (key: string) => prefix + key;
  const tagKey = (tag: string) => `${prefix}__tag:${tag}`;
  const lockKey = (key: string) => `${prefix}__lock:${key}`;
  const spread = (seconds: number) => Math.max(1, Math.round(seconds * (1 + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * jitter)));

  // ---- L1 invalidation across servers
  if (l1 && options.subscriber) {
    const sub = options.subscriber;
    void sub.subscribe(channel);
    sub.on("message", (ch: string, msg: string) => {
      if (ch !== channel) return;
      const { from, keys } = JSON.parse(msg) as { from: string; keys: string[] | "*" };
      if (from === nodeId) return;
      if (keys === "*") l1.clear();
      else for (const key of keys) l1.delete(key);
    });
  }
  const broadcast = async (keys: string[] | "*") => {
    if (l1 && options.subscriber && (keys === "*" || keys.length)) await redis.publish(channel, JSON.stringify({ from: nodeId, keys }));
  };

  async function readRaw<T>(full: string): Promise<Envelope<T> | null> {
    const text = await redis.get(full);
    return text ? decode<Envelope<T>>(text) : null;
  }

  async function write<T>(full: string, value: T, o: GetOrSetOptions, negative = false): Promise<void> {
    const fresh = negative ? (o.negativeTtl ?? 0) : spread(o.ttl ?? defaultTtl);
    if (fresh <= 0) return;
    const hard = fresh + (negative ? 0 : o.staleTtl ?? 0);
    const env: Envelope<T> = { v: value, f: Date.now() + fresh * 1000, ...(negative ? { n: 1 as const } : {}) };
    const multi = redis.multi().set(full, encode(env), "EX", hard);
    for (const tag of o.tags ?? []) multi.sadd(tagKey(tag), full).expire(tagKey(tag), Math.max(hard, 3600));
    await multi.exec();
    if (l1 && o.l1 !== false) l1.set(full, env, Math.min(l1Ttl, fresh * 1000));
    await broadcast([full]);
  }

  /**
   * Loads once per process (single-flight) and, optionally, once across processes (lock).
   * `background`: a stale refresh — when another process holds the lock, skip instead of waiting.
   */
  async function load<T>(full: string, loader: () => Promise<T>, o: GetOrSetOptions, background = false): Promise<T> {
    const running = inflight.get(full) as Promise<T> | undefined;
    if (running) return running;
    const p = (async () => {
      const lockOpt = o.lock ?? true;
      let token: string | null = null;
      if (lockOpt) {
        const lo = typeof lockOpt === "object" ? lockOpt : {};
        token = await acquireLock(redis, lockKey(full), lo.ttlMs ?? 10_000);
        if (!token && background) return undefined as T;
        if (!token) {
          // someone else is loading: wait for their value instead of hitting the database too
          stats.lockWaits++;
          const deadline = Date.now() + (lo.waitMs ?? 3000);
          while (Date.now() < deadline) {
            await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 25));
            const env = await readRaw<T>(full);
            if (env) return env.v;
          }
        }
      }
      try {
        stats.loads++;
        const value = await loader();
        if (value === null || value === undefined) await write(full, value as T, o, true);
        else await write(full, value, o);
        return value;
      } finally {
        if (token) await releaseLock(redis, lockKey(full), token);
      }
    })();
    inflight.set(full, p);
    try {
      return await p;
    } finally {
      inflight.delete(full);
    }
  }

  async function getOrSet<T>(key: string, loader: () => Promise<T>, o: GetOrSetOptions = {}): Promise<T> {
    const full = k(key);
    const useL1 = l1 && o.l1 !== false;
    if (useL1) {
      const env = l1.get(full) as Envelope<T> | undefined;
      if (env && env.f > Date.now()) {
        stats.l1Hits++;
        return env.v;
      }
    }
    const env = await readRaw<T>(full);
    if (env) {
      if (env.f > Date.now()) {
        stats.hits++;
        if (useL1) l1.set(full, env, Math.min(l1Ttl, env.f - Date.now()));
        return env.v;
      }
      // stale but still stored: serve it, refresh in the background (one refresher thanks to the lock)
      stats.staleHits++;
      void load(full, loader, o, true).catch(() => {});
      return env.v;
    }
    stats.misses++;
    return load(full, loader, o);
  }

  return {
    getOrSet,

    async get<T>(key: string): Promise<T | undefined> {
      const env = await readRaw<T>(k(key));
      return env && env.f > Date.now() ? env.v : undefined;
    },

    /** Write-through: store a value you just saved to the database. */
    async set<T>(key: string, value: T, o: Omit<GetOrSetOptions, "lock" | "negativeTtl"> = {}): Promise<void> {
      await write(k(key), value, o);
    },

    async del(...keys: string[]): Promise<void> {
      if (!keys.length) return;
      const full = keys.map(k);
      await redis.del(...full);
      if (l1) for (const f of full) l1.delete(f);
      await broadcast(full);
    },

    /** Deletes every key stored with any of these tags. */
    async invalidateTags(...tags: string[]): Promise<number> {
      let removed = 0;
      for (const tag of tags) {
        const keys = await redis.smembers(tagKey(tag));
        if (keys.length) removed += await redis.del(...keys);
        await redis.del(tagKey(tag));
        if (l1) for (const key of keys) l1.delete(key);
        await broadcast(keys);
      }
      return removed;
    },

    /**
     * Versioned namespace. Keys live under "ns:<name>:v<version>:"; bump() moves to a new version,
     * so every old key is ignored at once (and expires on its own).
     */
    namespace(name: string) {
      const verKey = `${prefix}__ns:${name}`;
      const version = async () => Number((await redis.get(verKey)) ?? 0);
      return {
        async getOrSet<T>(key: string, loader: () => Promise<T>, o?: GetOrSetOptions) {
          return getOrSet(`ns:${name}:v${await version()}:${key}`, loader, o);
        },
        async bump(): Promise<number> {
          const v = await redis.incr(verKey);
          if (l1) l1.clear();
          await broadcast("*");
          return v;
        },
        version,
      };
    },

    /** Memoises an async function: wrap(fn, (...args) => key, options). */
    wrap<A extends unknown[], R>(fn: (...args: A) => Promise<R>, keyOf: (...args: A) => string, o?: GetOrSetOptions) {
      return (...args: A) => getOrSet(keyOf(...args), () => fn(...args), o);
    },

    stats: (): CacheStats => ({ ...stats }),
    /** Clears this process's L1 tier only. */
    clearLocal: () => l1?.clear(),
  };
}
```

## File: src/cache/cached-repos.ts

```ts
import type { Repo, Repositories } from "../core/ports";
import type { Id } from "../core/types";
import type { Cache } from "./cache";

/**
 * Read-through + write-invalidate decorator for repositories:
 *   get(id)  → cache-aside on "<entity>:<id>" (tagged "<entity>:<id>")
 *   update / delete → database first, then invalidate that tag
 * Lists and searches are not cached (they go stale too easily); cache them explicitly where safe.
 */
function cachedRepo<T extends { id: Id }>(entity: string, inner: Repo<T>, cache: Cache, ttl: number): Repo<T> {
  const tag = (id: Id) => `${entity}:${id}`;
  return {
    ...inner,
    get: (id) => cache.getOrSet(tag(id), () => inner.get(id), { ttl, staleTtl: ttl, negativeTtl: 30, tags: [tag(id)] }),
    async create(data) {
      const out = await inner.create(data);
      await cache.invalidateTags(tag(out.id)); // drop a cached "not found" for this id
      return out;
    },
    async update(id, patch) {
      const out = await inner.update(id, patch);
      await cache.invalidateTags(tag(id));
      return out;
    },
    async delete(id) {
      const out = await inner.delete(id);
      await cache.invalidateTags(tag(id));
      return out;
    },
  };
}

/** Wraps the slow-changing, often-read repositories. Transactions use the uncached ones. */
export function withCache(repos: Repositories, cache: Cache, ttlSeconds = 300): Repositories {
  return {
    ...repos,
    orgs: cachedRepo("org", repos.orgs, cache, ttlSeconds),
    branches: cachedRepo("branch", repos.branches, cache, ttlSeconds),
    roles: cachedRepo("role", repos.roles, cache, ttlSeconds),
    doctors: cachedRepo("doctor", repos.doctors, cache, ttlSeconds),
    patients: { ...repos.patients, ...cachedRepo("patient", repos.patients, cache, 60) },
    ledgers: { ...repos.ledgers, ...cachedRepo("ledger", repos.ledgers, cache, ttlSeconds) },
  };
}
```

## File: src/cache/lock.ts

```ts
import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
import type { Redis } from "ioredis";

/**
 * Distributed lock: SET key token NX PX ttl, released only by the holder (compare-and-delete in
 * Lua, so an expired lock re-taken by someone else is never deleted by the old holder).
 */
const UNLOCK = `if redis.call("get", KEYS[1]) == ARGV[1] then return redis.call("del", KEYS[1]) else return 0 end`;

export async function acquireLock(redis: Redis, key: string, ttlMs: number): Promise<string | null> {
  const token = randomBytes(12).toString("base64url");
  const ok = await redis.set(key, token, "PX", ttlMs, "NX");
  return ok === "OK" ? token : null;
}

export async function releaseLock(redis: Redis, key: string, token: string): Promise<boolean> {
  return (await redis.eval(UNLOCK, 1, key, token)) === 1;
}

export interface LockOptions {
  /** Lock lifetime; the work must finish within it. Default 10 s. */
  ttlMs?: number;
  /** How long to keep trying to acquire. Default 5 s. */
  waitMs?: number;
  /** Delay between attempts. Default 50 ms. */
  retryMs?: number;
}

export class LockTimeoutError extends Error {
  constructor(key: string) {
    super(`Could not acquire lock ${key}`);
    this.name = "LockTimeoutError";
  }
}

/** Runs fn while holding the lock (e.g. one nightly job across many servers). */
export async function withLock<T>(redis: Redis, key: string, fn: () => Promise<T>, o: LockOptions = {}): Promise<T> {
  const ttl = o.ttlMs ?? 10_000;
  const deadline = Date.now() + (o.waitMs ?? 5_000);
  let token: string | null;
  while (!(token = await acquireLock(redis, key, ttl))) {
    if (Date.now() >= deadline) throw new LockTimeoutError(key);
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, o.retryMs ?? 50));
  }
  try {
    return await fn();
  } finally {
    await releaseLock(redis, key, token);
  }
}
```

## File: src/cache/lru.ts

```ts
/**
 * Tiny in-process LRU with per-entry expiry: the L1 tier in front of Redis. A Map keeps insertion
 * order, so re-inserting on read moves an entry to the "recent" end and the first key is the oldest.
 */
export class Lru<V> {
  private map = new Map<string, { v: V; exp: number }>();

  constructor(private readonly max = 1000) {}

  get(key: string): V | undefined {
    const e = this.map.get(key);
    if (!e) return undefined;
    if (e.exp <= Date.now()) {
      this.map.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    this.map.delete(key);
    this.map.set(key, e);
    return e.v;
  }

  set(key: string, v: V, ttlMs: number): void {
    if (ttlMs <= 0) return;
    this.map.delete(key);
    this.map.set(key, { v, exp: Date.now() + ttlMs });
    while (this.map.size > this.max) this.map.delete(this.map.keys().next().value!);
  }

  delete(key: string): void {
    this.map.delete(key);
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.map.clear();
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.map.size;
  }
}
```

## File: src/cache/rate-limit.ts

```ts
import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
import type { Redis } from "ioredis";

export interface RateLimitResult {
  allowed: boolean;
  /** Requests left in the current window. */
  remaining: number;
  /** Milliseconds until another request is allowed (0 when allowed). */
  retryAfterMs: number;
}

/**
 * Sliding-window log: exact ("at most `limit` in any `windowMs`"), one sorted set per key.
 * Good for logins and OTPs, where precision matters more than memory.
 */
export function slidingWindowLimiter(redis: Redis, o: { limit: number; windowMs: number; prefix?: string }) {
  const prefix = o.prefix ?? "mgpl:__rl:";
  return async function hit(key: string): Promise<RateLimitResult> {
    const full = prefix + key;
    const now = Date.now();
    const member = `${now}:${randomBytes(4).toString("hex")}`;
    const res = await redis
      .multi()
      .zremrangebyscore(full, 0, now - o.windowMs)
      .zadd(full, now, member)
      .zcard(full)
      .zrange(full, 0, 0, "WITHSCORES")
      .pexpire(full, o.windowMs)
      .exec();
    const count = Number(res?.[2]?.[1] ?? 0);
    if (count <= o.limit) return { allowed: true, remaining: o.limit - count, retryAfterMs: 0 };
    await redis.zrem(full, member); // rejected attempts do not extend the block
    const oldest = Number((res?.[3]?.[1] as string[] | undefined)?.[1] ?? now);
    return { allowed: false, remaining: 0, retryAfterMs: Math.max(0, oldest + o.windowMs - now) };
  };
}

/**
 * Fixed window: one counter per window (INCR + expiry). Cheapest; allows up to 2× `limit` across a
 * window boundary. Good for API quotas.
 */
export function fixedWindowLimiter(redis: Redis, o: { limit: number; windowMs: number; prefix?: string }) {
  const prefix = o.prefix ?? "mgpl:__rlf:";
  return async function hit(key: string): Promise<RateLimitResult> {
    const window = Math.floor(Date.now() / o.windowMs);
    const full = `${prefix}${key}:${window}`;
    const res = await redis.multi().incr(full).pexpire(full, o.windowMs).exec();
    const count = Number(res?.[0]?.[1] ?? 0);
    const resetIn = (window + 1) * o.windowMs - Date.now();
    return count <= o.limit
      ? { allowed: true, remaining: o.limit - count, retryAfterMs: 0 }
      : { allowed: false, remaining: 0, retryAfterMs: resetIn };
  };
}
```

## File: src/cache/serialize.ts

```ts
/** JSON that keeps Dates (as {"$d": iso}), so cached entities come back with real Date fields. */
export function encode(value: unknown): string {
  return JSON.stringify(value, function (this: any, key, val) {
    const raw = this[key];
    return raw instanceof Date ? { $d: raw.toISOString() } : val;
  });
}

export function decode<T>(text: string): T {
  return JSON.parse(text, (_key, val) =>
    val && typeof val === "object" && typeof val.$d === "string" && Object.keys(val).length === 1 ? new Date(val.$d) : val,
  );
}
```

## File: src/core/accounting.ts

```ts
import { financialYear } from "./numbering";
import { NotFoundError, PeriodLockedError, ValidationError, type PostingHook, type Repositories } from "./ports";
import type {
  AccountGroup, AccountNature, Id, Invoice, Ledger, Payment, PaymentMode, Voucher, VoucherEntry, VoucherType,
} from "./types";

/**
 * Tally-style double-entry books.
 *
 * Groups → ledgers → vouchers. Every voucher's debits equal its credits; each line is also stored
 * as a LedgerEntry, so any balance is a sum. Invoices and payments post vouchers automatically:
 *
 *   Sales voucher (invoice)       Dr Patient Receivables  total
 *                                 Dr Discount Allowed     discount
 *                                 Cr Lab Test Income      gross (qty × rate)
 *                                 Cr Output CGST / SGST   tax  (IGST when inter-state)
 *                                 Dr/Cr Round Off         rounding
 *   Receipt voucher (payment)     Dr Cash / Bank / UPI / Card    Cr Patient Receivables
 *   Payment voucher (refund)      Dr Patient Receivables         Cr Cash / Bank / UPI / Card
 */

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ chart of accounts

interface GroupDef {
  name: string;
  parent?: string;
  nature?: AccountNature;
  gp?: boolean;
}

/** Tally's 28 predefined groups: 15 primary + 13 sub-groups. */
export const TALLY_GROUPS: GroupDef[] = [
  { name: "Capital Account", nature: "liabilities" },
  { name: "Loans (Liability)", nature: "liabilities" },
  { name: "Current Liabilities", nature: "liabilities" },
  { name: "Fixed Assets", nature: "assets" },
  { name: "Investments", nature: "assets" },
  { name: "Current Assets", nature: "assets" },
  { name: "Branch / Divisions", nature: "liabilities" },
  { name: "Misc. Expenses (ASSET)", nature: "assets" },
  { name: "Suspense A/c", nature: "liabilities" },
  { name: "Sales Accounts", nature: "income", gp: true },
  { name: "Purchase Accounts", nature: "expenses", gp: true },
  { name: "Direct Incomes", nature: "income", gp: true },
  { name: "Indirect Incomes", nature: "income" },
  { name: "Direct Expenses", nature: "expenses", gp: true },
  { name: "Indirect Expenses", nature: "expenses" },
  { name: "Reserves & Surplus", parent: "Capital Account" },
  { name: "Bank OD A/c", parent: "Loans (Liability)" },
  { name: "Secured Loans", parent: "Loans (Liability)" },
  { name: "Unsecured Loans", parent: "Loans (Liability)" },
  { name: "Duties & Taxes", parent: "Current Liabilities" },
  { name: "Provisions", parent: "Current Liabilities" },
  { name: "Sundry Creditors", parent: "Current Liabilities" },
  { name: "Bank Accounts", parent: "Current Assets" },
  { name: "Cash-in-Hand", parent: "Current Assets" },
  { name: "Deposits (Asset)", parent: "Current Assets" },
  { name: "Loans & Advances (Asset)", parent: "Current Assets" },
  { name: "Stock-in-Hand", parent: "Current Assets" },
  { name: "Sundry Debtors", parent: "Current Assets" },
];

/** Ledgers a diagnostic lab needs on day one. `key` = systemKey used by automatic posting. */
export const DEFAULT_LEDGERS: { name: string; group: string; key?: string }[] = [
  { name: "Capital Account", group: "Capital Account", key: "capital" },
  { name: "Cash", group: "Cash-in-Hand", key: "cash" },
  { name: "Bank Account", group: "Bank Accounts", key: "bank" },
  { name: "UPI Collections", group: "Bank Accounts", key: "upi" },
  { name: "Card Settlements", group: "Bank Accounts", key: "card" },
  { name: "Patient Receivables", group: "Sundry Debtors", key: "receivables" },
  { name: "Lab Test Income", group: "Sales Accounts", key: "sales" },
  { name: "Output CGST", group: "Duties & Taxes", key: "cgst" },
  { name: "Output SGST", group: "Duties & Taxes", key: "sgst" },
  { name: "Output IGST", group: "Duties & Taxes", key: "igst" },
  { name: "Discount Allowed", group: "Indirect Expenses", key: "discount" },
  { name: "Round Off", group: "Indirect Expenses", key: "round_off" },
  { name: "Doctor Referral Commission", group: "Indirect Expenses", key: "doctor_commission" },
  { name: "Doctors Payable", group: "Sundry Creditors", key: "doctors_payable" },
  { name: "Reagents & Consumables", group: "Purchase Accounts", key: "purchases" },
  { name: "Salaries", group: "Indirect Expenses" },
  { name: "Rent", group: "Indirect Expenses" },
  { name: "Electricity", group: "Indirect Expenses" },
  { name: "Lab Equipment", group: "Fixed Assets" },
];

/** Creates the groups and default ledgers for an organisation (skips ones that exist). */
export async function seedChartOfAccounts(repos: Repositories, orgId: Id): Promise<{ groups: AccountGroup[]; ledgers: Ledger[] }> {
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const byName = new Map<string, AccountGroup>();
    for (const g of await tx.accountGroups.find({ orgId })) byName.set(g.name, g);
    for (const def of TALLY_GROUPS) {
      if (byName.has(def.name)) continue;
      const parent = def.parent ? byName.get(def.parent)! : null;
      const g = await tx.accountGroups.create({
        orgId, name: def.name, parentId: parent?.id ?? null,
        nature: def.nature ?? parent!.nature, affectsGrossProfit: def.gp ?? parent?.affectsGrossProfit ?? false, system: true,
      });
      byName.set(g.name, g);
    }
    const existing = new Set((await tx.ledgers.find({ orgId })).map((l) => l.name));
    for (const l of DEFAULT_LEDGERS) {
      if (existing.has(l.name)) continue;
      await tx.ledgers.create({ orgId, name: l.name, groupId: byName.get(l.group)!.id, openingPaise: 0, systemKey: l.key ?? null, active: true });
    }
    return { groups: [...byName.values()], ledgers: await tx.ledgers.find({ orgId }) };
  });
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ vouchers

export const VOUCHER_PREFIX: Record<VoucherType, string> = {
  sales: "SAL", receipt: "RCT", payment: "PMT", journal: "JRN", contra: "CTR", credit_note: "CRN", debit_note: "DBN", purchase: "PUR", closing: "CLS",
};

export const voucherCounterKey = (orgId: Id, type: VoucherType, fy: string) => `voucher:${orgId}:${type}:${fy}`;

export interface VoucherInput {
  orgId: Id;
  branchId: Id;
  type: VoucherType;
  date?: Date;
  narration?: string;
  entries: VoucherEntry[];
  invoiceId?: Id | null;
  paymentId?: Id | null;
}

export class UnbalancedVoucherError extends ValidationError {
  readonly statusCode = 422;
  constructor(debit: number, credit: number) {
    super(`Voucher does not balance: debit ${debit} ≠ credit ${credit} paise`);
    this.name = "UnbalancedVoucherError";
  }
}

/** Throws unless every line is one-sided whole paise and debits equal credits. */
export function assertBalanced(entries: VoucherEntry[]): void {
  if (entries.length < 2) throw new UnbalancedVoucherError(0, 0);
  let dr = 0;
  let cr = 0;
  for (const e of entries) {
    const okDr = Number.isInteger(e.debitPaise) && e.debitPaise >= 0;
    const okCr = Number.isInteger(e.creditPaise) && e.creditPaise >= 0;
    if (!okDr || !okCr || (e.debitPaise > 0) === (e.creditPaise > 0)) throw new ValidationError("Each voucher line needs exactly one positive debit or credit (whole paise)");
    dr += e.debitPaise;
    cr += e.creditPaise;
  }
  if (dr !== cr) throw new UnbalancedVoucherError(dr, cr);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ lock dates

/**
 * Inside a transaction: throws PeriodLockedError when `date` is on or before the organisation's or
 * the branch's lock date. Holds both lock rows until commit, so a concurrent lock change cannot slip
 * in between this check and the commit. postVoucher and cancelVoucher call it.
 */
export async function assertPeriodOpen(tx: Repositories, orgId: Id, branchId: Id, date: Date): Promise<void> {
  for (const lock of await tx.periodLocks.hold(orgId, ["org", branchId], "share"))
    if (lock.lockedUpTo && date.getTime() <= lock.lockedUpTo.getTime()) throw new PeriodLockedError(date, lock.lockedUpTo, lock.scope);
}

/** Numbers, stores and posts a voucher atomically (voucher + its ledger entries). Refused in a locked period. */
export async function postVoucher(repos: Repositories, input: VoucherInput, actorId?: Id): Promise<Voucher> {
  const entries = input.entries.filter((e) => e.debitPaise > 0 || e.creditPaise > 0);
  assertBalanced(entries);
  const date = input.date ?? new Date();
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await assertPeriodOpen(tx, input.orgId, input.branchId, date);
    const ids = [...new Set(entries.map((e) => e.ledgerId))];
    for (const id of ids) if (!(await tx.ledgers.get(id))) throw new NotFoundError("Ledger", id);
    const fy = financialYear(date);
    const seq = await tx.counters.next(voucherCounterKey(input.orgId, input.type, fy));
    const voucher = await tx.vouchers.create({
      orgId: input.orgId, branchId: input.branchId, type: input.type, voucherNo: `${VOUCHER_PREFIX[input.type]}/${fy}/${String(seq).padStart(6, "0")}`,
      date, narration: input.narration, entries, invoiceId: input.invoiceId ?? null, paymentId: input.paymentId ?? null, status: "posted", createdBy: actorId ?? null,
    });
    await tx.ledgerEntries.insertMany(entries.map((e) => ({
      orgId: input.orgId, branchId: input.branchId, voucherId: voucher.id, voucherType: input.type, voucherNo: voucher.voucherNo,
      ledgerId: e.ledgerId, date, debitPaise: e.debitPaise, creditPaise: e.creditPaise, invoiceId: e.invoiceId ?? null,
    })));
    await tx.audit.log({ orgId: input.orgId, branchId: input.branchId, userId: actorId ?? null, action: `voucher.${input.type}`, entity: "voucher", entityId: voucher.id, data: { voucherNo: voucher.voucherNo } });
    return voucher;
  });
}

/** Cancels a voucher the Tally way: the number stays, the postings are removed. Refused in a locked period. */
export async function cancelVoucher(repos: Repositories, voucherId: Id, actorId?: Id): Promise<Voucher> {
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const v = await tx.vouchers.get(voucherId);
    if (!v) throw new NotFoundError("Voucher", voucherId);
    if (v.status === "cancelled") return v;
    await assertPeriodOpen(tx, v.orgId, v.branchId, v.date);
    await tx.ledgerEntries.deleteByVoucher(voucherId);
    const out = (await tx.vouchers.update(voucherId, { status: "cancelled" }))!;
    await tx.audit.log({ orgId: v.orgId, branchId: v.branchId, userId: actorId ?? null, action: "voucher.cancel", entity: "voucher", entityId: voucherId });
    return out;
  });
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ automatic posting

const MODE_LEDGER: Record<PaymentMode, string> = {
  cash: "cash", upi: "upi", wallet: "upi", card: "card", netbanking: "bank", cheque: "bank", insurance: "bank",
};

/** Ledgers by systemKey, or null when the organisation has no chart of accounts (posting is skipped). */
async function systemLedgers(repos: Repositories, orgId: Id): Promise<Map<string, Ledger> | null> {
  const all = await repos.ledgers.find({ orgId });
  const map = new Map<string, Ledger>();
  for (const l of all) if (l.systemKey) map.set(l.systemKey, l);
  return map.has("receivables") && map.has("sales") ? map : null;
}

const need = (m: Map<string, Ledger>, key: string) => {
  const l = m.get(key);
  if (!l) throw new NotFoundError("Ledger with systemKey", key);
  return l.id;
};

export function salesEntries(invoice: Invoice, ledgers: Map<string, Ledger>, interState = false): VoucherEntry[] {
  const gross = invoice.items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.amountPaise + i.discountPaise, 0);
  const tax = invoice.taxPaise;
  const cgst = Math.floor(tax / 2);
  const r = invoice.roundOffPaise;
  const e: VoucherEntry[] = [
    { ledgerId: need(ledgers, "receivables"), debitPaise: invoice.totalPaise, creditPaise: 0, invoiceId: invoice.id },
    { ledgerId: need(ledgers, "discount"), debitPaise: invoice.discountPaise, creditPaise: 0 },
    { ledgerId: need(ledgers, "sales"), debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: gross },
  ];
  if (tax > 0) {
    if (interState) e.push({ ledgerId: need(ledgers, "igst"), debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: tax });
    else e.push({ ledgerId: need(ledgers, "cgst"), debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: cgst }, { ledgerId: need(ledgers, "sgst"), debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: tax - cgst });
  }
  if (r !== 0) e.push({ ledgerId: need(ledgers, "round_off"), debitPaise: r < 0 ? -r : 0, creditPaise: r > 0 ? r : 0 });
  return e.filter((x) => x.debitPaise > 0 || x.creditPaise > 0);
}

export function receiptEntries(payment: Payment, ledgers: Map<string, Ledger>): VoucherEntry[] {
  const money = need(ledgers, MODE_LEDGER[payment.mode]);
  const recv = need(ledgers, "receivables");
  return payment.kind === "refund"
    ? [{ ledgerId: recv, debitPaise: payment.amountPaise, creditPaise: 0, invoiceId: payment.invoiceId }, { ledgerId: money, debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: payment.amountPaise }]
    : [{ ledgerId: money, debitPaise: payment.amountPaise, creditPaise: 0 }, { ledgerId: recv, debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: payment.amountPaise, invoiceId: payment.invoiceId }];
}

/** Posts the sales voucher for an invoice (inside the caller's transaction). No-op without a chart of accounts. */
export async function postInvoice(tx: Repositories, invoice: Invoice, actorId?: Id): Promise<Voucher | null> {
  const ledgers = await systemLedgers(tx, invoice.orgId);
  if (!ledgers) return null;
  const org = await tx.orgs.get(invoice.orgId);
  return postVoucher(tx, {
    orgId: invoice.orgId, branchId: invoice.branchId, type: "sales", date: invoice.issuedAt ?? new Date(),
    narration: `Invoice ${invoice.invoiceNo}`, entries: salesEntries(invoice, ledgers, Boolean(org?.settings?.interState)), invoiceId: invoice.id,
  }, actorId);
}

/** Posts a receipt (payment) or payment (refund) voucher. No-op without a chart of accounts. */
export async function postPayment(tx: Repositories, payment: Payment, invoiceNo: string, actorId?: Id): Promise<Voucher | null> {
  const ledgers = await systemLedgers(tx, payment.orgId);
  if (!ledgers) return null;
  return postVoucher(tx, {
    orgId: payment.orgId, branchId: payment.branchId, type: payment.kind === "refund" ? "payment" : "receipt", date: payment.receivedAt,
    narration: `${payment.kind === "refund" ? "Refund" : "Payment"} ${payment.mode.toUpperCase()} against ${invoiceNo}`,
    entries: receiptEntries(payment, ledgers), invoiceId: payment.invoiceId, paymentId: payment.id,
  }, actorId);
}

/** Cancels the sales voucher of a cancelled invoice. */
export async function unpostInvoice(tx: Repositories, invoiceId: Id, actorId?: Id): Promise<void> {
  for (const v of await tx.vouchers.find({ invoiceId, type: "sales", status: "posted" } as any)) await cancelVoucher(tx, v.id, actorId);
}


/** Posting with this package's accounting: what the billing workflows do unless `repos.posting` is set. */
export const defaultPostingHook: PostingHook = {
  async invoiceIssued(tx, invoice, actorId) {
    await postInvoice(tx, invoice, actorId);
  },
  async paymentRecorded(tx, payment, invoiceNo, actorId) {
    await postPayment(tx, payment, invoiceNo, actorId);
  },
  async invoiceCancelled(tx, invoiceId, actorId) {
    await unpostInvoice(tx, invoiceId, actorId);
  },
};
```

## File: src/core/money.ts

```ts
import { ValidationError } from "./ports";
import type { InvoiceItem, InvoiceTotals, ItemCategory, Paise, Taxability } from "./types";

export interface ItemInput {
  code?: string;
  name: string;
  category?: ItemCategory;
  qty?: number;
  ratePaise: Paise;
  /** Line discount in paise. */
  discountPaise?: Paise;
  taxPercent?: number;
  /** SAC / HSN code and GST treatment, kept on the invoice line for GST returns. */
  hsnSac?: string;
  taxability?: Taxability;
}

/** Rupees → paise without float drift (399.5 → 39950). */
export const toPaise = (rupees: number): Paise => Math.round(rupees * 100);
export const toRupees = (paise: Paise): number => paise / 100;

/**
 * Splits a bill discount across line amounts in proportion, with the largest-remainder rule, so the
 * shares add up exactly. GST returns use the same shares to recover each line's taxable value.
 */
export function billDiscountShares(amounts: Paise[], billDiscountPaise: Paise): Paise[] {
  const subtotal = amounts.reduce((s, a) => s + a, 0);
  const shares = amounts.map((a) => (subtotal ? (billDiscountPaise * a) / subtotal : 0));
  const floors = shares.map(Math.floor);
  let left = billDiscountPaise - floors.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  shares
    .map((s, idx) => ({ idx, frac: s - Math.floor(s) }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.frac - a.frac)
    .forEach(({ idx }) => { if (left > 0) { floors[idx]! += 1; left--; } });
  return floors;
}

/**
 * Lines and totals, all integer paise:
 *   line amount = qty × rate − line discount
 *   bill discount is shared across lines in proportion (largest remainder, so shares add up exactly)
 *   tax per line on (amount − its share), then the total rounds to the nearest rupee.
 */
export function computeTotals(input: ItemInput[], billDiscountPaise: Paise = 0): { items: InvoiceItem[]; totals: InvoiceTotals } {
  const items: InvoiceItem[] = input.map((i) => {
    const qty = i.qty ?? 1;
    if (!(qty > 0)) throw new ValidationError(`Quantity must be positive (${i.name})`);
    if (!(i.ratePaise >= 0)) throw new ValidationError(`Rate must not be negative (${i.name})`);
    const gross = Math.round(qty * i.ratePaise);
    const discount = Math.min(gross, Math.max(0, Math.round(i.discountPaise ?? 0)));
    const tax = i.taxPercent ?? 0;
    if (tax < 0 || tax > 100) throw new ValidationError(`Tax must be 0–100% (${i.name})`);
    const item: InvoiceItem = { code: i.code, name: i.name, category: i.category ?? "test", qty, ratePaise: i.ratePaise, discountPaise: discount, taxPercent: tax, amountPaise: gross - discount };
    if (i.hsnSac !== undefined) item.hsnSac = i.hsnSac;
    if (i.taxability !== undefined) item.taxability = i.taxability;
    return item;
  });

  const subtotal = items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.amountPaise, 0);
  const billDiscount = Math.min(subtotal, Math.max(0, Math.round(billDiscountPaise)));

  const floors = billDiscountShares(items.map((i) => i.amountPaise), billDiscount);
  const tax = items.reduce((s, i, idx) => s + Math.round(((i.amountPaise - floors[idx]!) * i.taxPercent) / 100), 0);
  const exact = subtotal - billDiscount + tax;
  const total = Math.round(exact / 100) * 100;
  return {
    items,
    totals: {
      subtotalPaise: subtotal,
      discountPaise: billDiscount + items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.discountPaise, 0),
      taxPaise: tax,
      roundOffPaise: total - exact,
      totalPaise: total,
    },
  };
}
```

## File: src/core/numbering.ts

```ts
/**
 * Indian financial year (1 April – 31 March), e.g. 2026-27, in Asia/Kolkata time.
 */
export function financialYear(date: Date = new Date()): string {
  const ist = new Date(date.getTime() + 5.5 * 3600 * 1000);
  const y = ist.getUTCFullYear();
  const start = ist.getUTCMonth() >= 3 ? y : y - 1;
  return `${start}-${String((start + 1) % 100).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

const pad = (n: number, width: number) => String(n).padStart(width, "0");

/** Counter keys. One sequence per organisation (+ branch / year where numbers restart). */
export const counterKeys = {
  uhid: (orgId: string) => `uhid:${orgId}`,
  invoice: (orgId: string, branchCode: string, fy: string) => `invoice:${orgId}:${branchCode}:${fy}`,
  booking: (orgId: string, branchCode: string, day: string) => `booking:${orgId}:${branchCode}:${day}`,
  sample: (orgId: string) => `sample:${orgId}`,
};

/** "MGPL-000123" */
export const formatUhid = (orgCode: string, seq: number) => `${orgCode}-${pad(seq, 6)}`;

/** "MGPL/RPR01/2026-27/000045" — restarts every financial year (GST invoice series). */
export const formatInvoiceNo = (orgCode: string, branchCode: string, fy: string, seq: number) =>
  `${orgCode}/${branchCode}/${fy}/${pad(seq, 6)}`;

/** "RPR01-261013-0007" — restarts daily per branch. */
export const formatBookingNo = (branchCode: string, day: string, seq: number) => `${branchCode}-${day}-${pad(seq, 4)}`;

/** "S26000123" — numeric barcode-friendly sample id. */
export const formatSampleBarcode = (year2: string, seq: number) => `S${year2}${pad(seq, 6)}`;

/** "261013" for 13 Oct 2026 (IST). */
export function dayKey(date: Date = new Date()): string {
  const ist = new Date(date.getTime() + 5.5 * 3600 * 1000);
  return `${String(ist.getUTCFullYear()).slice(2)}${pad(ist.getUTCMonth() + 1, 2)}${pad(ist.getUTCDate(), 2)}`;
}
```

```ts
import type {
  AccountGroup, AuditEntry, BankLine, BankStatement, Booking, Branch, CashClosing, CreditNote, Customer, Doctor, Id, Invoice, Ledger,
  LedgerEntry, New, Organization, Partner, PartnerAgreement, Patient, Payment, PeriodLock, Report, Role, Sample, Settlement, TaxRule, User,
  Voucher, VoucherType,
} from "./types";

/** Equality filter on top-level fields. Portable across both backends. */
export type Filter<T> = { [K in keyof T]?: T[K] };

export interface ListOptions<T> {
  limit?: number;
  offset?: number;
  sort?: { field: keyof T & string; dir?: "asc" | "desc" };
}

export interface Repo<T extends { id: Id }> {
  create(data: New<T>): Promise<T>;
  get(id: Id): Promise<T | null>;
  /** Several by id, in any order (missing ids are skipped). Used by DataLoader. */
  getMany(ids: readonly Id[]): Promise<T[]>;
  /** Returns the updated entity, or null when it does not exist. */
  update(id: Id, patch: Partial<New<T>>): Promise<T | null>;
  delete(id: Id): Promise<boolean>;
  find(filter?: Filter<T>, options?: ListOptions<T>): Promise<T[]>;
  findOne(filter: Filter<T>): Promise<T | null>;
  count(filter?: Filter<T>): Promise<number>;
}

export interface UserRepo extends Repo<User> {
  findByEmail(orgId: Id, email: string): Promise<User | null>;
  /** Same email in several organisations is allowed; login then needs the organisation. */
  findAllByEmail(email: string): Promise<User[]>;
}

export interface PatientRepo extends Repo<Patient> {
  /** Case-insensitive match on name, phone or UHID. */
  search(orgId: Id, query: string, limit?: number): Promise<Patient[]>;
}

/** A repository whose rows can be locked inside a transaction. */
export interface LockableRepo<T extends { id: Id }> extends Repo<T> {
  /** Inside a transaction: read and lock the row/document until commit. */
  getForUpdate(id: Id): Promise<T | null>;
}

/** Filter for documents by date. `from` and `to` are inclusive. */
export interface DateQuery {
  orgId: Id;
  branchId?: Id;
  from?: Date;
  to?: Date;
}

export interface InvoiceRepo extends LockableRepo<Invoice> {
  /** Issued / partly paid invoices with an amount due, oldest first. */
  listOutstanding(orgId: Id, branchId?: Id): Promise<Invoice[]>;
  /** By issue date, oldest first (then invoice number). Drafts are left out; cancelled ones only on request. */
  listByDate(query: DateQuery & { customerId?: Id; includeCancelled?: boolean }): Promise<Invoice[]>;
}

export interface AuditRepo {
  log(entry: Omit<AuditEntry, "id" | "at"> & { at?: Date }): Promise<AuditEntry>;
  find(filter?: Filter<AuditEntry>, options?: ListOptions<AuditEntry>): Promise<AuditEntry[]>;
}

export interface CounterRepo {
  /** Atomically increments and returns the next value (1, 2, 3…) for a key. */
  next(key: string): Promise<number>;
  /** Current value without incrementing (0 when unused). */
  peek(key: string): Promise<number>;
}

export interface VoucherQuery {
  orgId: Id;
  branchId?: Id;
  type?: Voucher["type"];
  /** inclusive */
  from?: Date;
  /** inclusive */
  to?: Date;
  includeCancelled?: boolean;
}

export interface VoucherRepo extends Repo<Voucher> {
  /** By date, oldest first (the day book). */
  listByDate(query: VoucherQuery, options?: { limit?: number; offset?: number }): Promise<Voucher[]>;
}

export interface LedgerRepo extends Repo<Ledger> {
  findBySystemKey(orgId: Id, key: string): Promise<Ledger | null>;
}

/** Filter for postings. `from` and `to` are inclusive. */
export interface EntryQuery {
  orgId: Id;
  branchId?: Id;
  ledgerId?: Id;
  invoiceId?: Id;
  from?: Date;
  to?: Date;
  /** Leave out postings of these voucher types (e.g. "closing" for a P&L). */
  excludeVoucherTypes?: VoucherType[];
}

export interface LedgerTotals {
  ledgerId: Id;
  debitPaise: number;
  creditPaise: number;
}

export interface LedgerEntryRepo {
  insertMany(entries: Omit<LedgerEntry, "id">[]): Promise<void>;
  deleteByVoucher(voucherId: Id): Promise<number>;
  /** Oldest first (date, then voucher number). */
  list(query: EntryQuery, options?: { limit?: number; offset?: number }): Promise<LedgerEntry[]>;
  /** Debit and credit sums per ledger. */
  totals(query: EntryQuery): Promise<LedgerTotals[]>;
}

export interface CreditNoteRepo extends Repo<CreditNote> {
  /** By date, oldest first (then note number). Cancelled notes only on request. */
  listByDate(query: DateQuery & { includeCancelled?: boolean }): Promise<CreditNote[]>;
}

export type HoldMode = "share" | "update";

export interface PeriodLockRepo extends Repo<PeriodLock> {
  /**
   * Inside a transaction: reads the lock rows of these scopes ("org" and/or branch ids), creating
   * empty ones, and holds them until commit. "share" (posting) lets other postings through but makes a
   * concurrent lock change wait for this transaction (PostgreSQL) or conflict and retry (MongoDB);
   * "update" (changing a lock) is exclusive.
   */
  hold(orgId: Id, scopes: string[], mode: HoldMode): Promise<PeriodLock[]>;
}

/**
 * Called by the billing workflows, inside their transaction, to post the books. The default posts
 * with this package's accounting; an accounting kit (finance-kit today, tally-kit later) supplies its own.
 */
export interface PostingHook {
  invoiceIssued(tx: Repositories, invoice: Invoice, actorId?: string): Promise<void>;
  paymentRecorded(tx: Repositories, payment: Payment, invoiceNo: string, actorId?: string): Promise<void>;
  invoiceCancelled(tx: Repositories, invoiceId: string, actorId?: string): Promise<void>;
}

export type Backend = "mongo" | "pg";

export interface Repositories {
  readonly backend: Backend;
  orgs: Repo<Organization>;
  branches: Repo<Branch>;
  users: UserRepo;
  roles: Repo<Role>;
  patients: PatientRepo;
  doctors: Repo<Doctor>;
  bookings: Repo<Booking>;
  samples: Repo<Sample>;
  reports: Repo<Report>;
  invoices: InvoiceRepo;
  payments: Repo<Payment>;
  audit: AuditRepo;
  counters: CounterRepo;
  // accounting
  accountGroups: Repo<AccountGroup>;
  ledgers: LedgerRepo;
  vouchers: VoucherRepo;
  ledgerEntries: LedgerEntryRepo;
  // finance (used by @mgpl-diagnostics/finance-kit)
  taxRules: Repo<TaxRule>;
  customers: LockableRepo<Customer>;
  partners: Repo<Partner>;
  partnerAgreements: Repo<PartnerAgreement>;
  settlements: LockableRepo<Settlement>;
  cashClosings: Repo<CashClosing>;
  bankStatements: Repo<BankStatement>;
  bankLines: Repo<BankLine>;
  periodLocks: PeriodLockRepo;
  creditNotes: CreditNoteRepo;
  /** Posting for invoices and payments; the default (this package's accounting) when unset. */
  readonly posting?: PostingHook;
  /**
   * Runs `fn` atomically. Use the `tx` repositories inside it. MongoDB needs a replica set for
   * transactions; on a standalone server the work runs without one.
   */
  transaction<T>(fn: (tx: Repositories) => Promise<T>): Promise<T>;
  /** Creates collections / tables and indexes (idempotent). */
  sync(): Promise<void>;
  close(): Promise<void>;
}

export class NotFoundError extends Error {
  readonly statusCode = 404;
  constructor(entity: string, id: string) {
    super(`${entity} ${id} not found`);
    this.name = "NotFoundError";
  }
}

export class ConflictError extends Error {
  readonly statusCode = 409;
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "ConflictError";
  }
}

/** A voucher dated on or before a lock date was posted, cancelled or changed. */
export class PeriodLockedError extends ConflictError {
  constructor(date: Date, lockedUpTo: Date, scope: string) {
    super(`Books are locked up to ${lockedUpTo.toISOString()} (${scope === "org" ? "organisation" : `branch ${scope}`}); ${date.toISOString()} is in a locked period`);
    this.name = "PeriodLockedError";
  }
}

/** Invalid input (bad amount, empty booking, unbalanced lines…). */
export class ValidationError extends Error {
  readonly statusCode: number = 400;
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "ValidationError";
  }
}
```

## File: src/core/reports.ts

```ts
import { NotFoundError, type Repositories } from "./ports";
import type { AccountGroup, AccountNature, Id, Invoice, Ledger, Paise, Voucher, VoucherType } from "./types";

/**
 * Tally-style reports, computed from postings. Balances are in paise, positive = Debit.
 * All reports accept an optional branchId to see one branch's books.
 */

interface Scope {
  orgId: Id;
  branchId?: Id;
}

const day = 24 * 3600 * 1000;
const before = (d: Date) => new Date(d.getTime() - 1);

async function chart(repos: Repositories, orgId: Id) {
  const [groups, ledgers] = await Promise.all([repos.accountGroups.find({ orgId }), repos.ledgers.find({ orgId })]);
  const gById = new Map(groups.map((g) => [g.id, g]));
  const primary = (g: AccountGroup): AccountGroup => (g.parentId ? primary(gById.get(g.parentId)!) : g);
  return { groups, ledgers, gById, primary };
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ ledgers

export async function ledgerBalance(repos: Repositories, scope: Scope & { ledgerId: Id; asOf?: Date }): Promise<Paise> {
  const ledger = await repos.ledgers.get(scope.ledgerId);
  if (!ledger) throw new NotFoundError("Ledger", scope.ledgerId);
  const [t] = await repos.ledgerEntries.totals({ orgId: scope.orgId, branchId: scope.branchId, ledgerId: scope.ledgerId, to: scope.asOf });
  return (scope.branchId ? 0 : ledger.openingPaise) + (t ? t.debitPaise - t.creditPaise : 0);
}

export interface StatementRow {
  date: Date;
  voucherNo: string;
  voucherType: VoucherType;
  debitPaise: Paise;
  creditPaise: Paise;
  /** Running balance after this row (positive = Dr). */
  balancePaise: Paise;
  invoiceId?: Id | null;
}

/** Ledger account / cash book / bank book: opening, every posting with running balance, closing. */
export async function ledgerStatement(repos: Repositories, q: Scope & { ledgerId: Id; from: Date; to: Date }) {
  const ledger = await repos.ledgers.get(q.ledgerId);
  if (!ledger) throw new NotFoundError("Ledger", q.ledgerId);
  const opening = await ledgerBalance(repos, { ...q, asOf: before(q.from) });
  const entries = await repos.ledgerEntries.list({ orgId: q.orgId, branchId: q.branchId, ledgerId: q.ledgerId, from: q.from, to: q.to });
  let bal = opening;
  let dr = 0;
  let cr = 0;
  const rows: StatementRow[] = entries.map((e) => {
    bal += e.debitPaise - e.creditPaise;
    dr += e.debitPaise;
    cr += e.creditPaise;
    return { date: e.date, voucherNo: e.voucherNo, voucherType: e.voucherType, debitPaise: e.debitPaise, creditPaise: e.creditPaise, balancePaise: bal, invoiceId: e.invoiceId };
  });
  return { ledger, openingPaise: opening, rows, totalDebitPaise: dr, totalCreditPaise: cr, closingPaise: bal };
}

/** Cash book = the statement of the "cash" system ledger. */
export async function cashBook(repos: Repositories, q: Scope & { from: Date; to: Date }) {
  const cash = await repos.ledgers.findBySystemKey(q.orgId, "cash");
  if (!cash) throw new NotFoundError("Ledger with systemKey", "cash");
  return ledgerStatement(repos, { ...q, ledgerId: cash.id });
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ trial balance

export interface TrialBalanceRow {
  ledger: Ledger;
  group: AccountGroup;
  primaryGroup: AccountGroup;
  debitPaise: Paise;
  creditPaise: Paise;
}

/** Closing balance of every ledger, on its debit or credit side. Debits = credits when the books are right. */
export async function trialBalance(repos: Repositories, q: Scope & { asOf?: Date }) {
  const { ledgers, gById, primary } = await chart(repos, q.orgId);
  const totals = new Map((await repos.ledgerEntries.totals({ orgId: q.orgId, branchId: q.branchId, to: q.asOf })).map((t) => [t.ledgerId, t]));
  const rows: TrialBalanceRow[] = [];
  let dr = 0;
  let cr = 0;
  for (const l of ledgers) {
    const t = totals.get(l.id);
    const bal = (q.branchId ? 0 : l.openingPaise) + (t ? t.debitPaise - t.creditPaise : 0);
    if (bal === 0) continue;
    const group = gById.get(l.groupId)!;
    rows.push({ ledger: l, group, primaryGroup: primary(group), debitPaise: bal > 0 ? bal : 0, creditPaise: bal < 0 ? -bal : 0 });
    if (bal > 0) dr += bal;
    else cr -= bal;
  }
  rows.sort((a, b) => a.primaryGroup.name.localeCompare(b.primaryGroup.name) || a.ledger.name.localeCompare(b.ledger.name));
  /** Non-zero only when opening balances were entered unbalanced (Tally shows "Difference in opening balances"). */
  return { rows, totalDebitPaise: dr, totalCreditPaise: cr, differencePaise: dr - cr };
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ P&L and balance sheet

export interface GroupLine {
  group: AccountGroup;
  amountPaise: Paise;
  ledgers: { ledger: Ledger; amountPaise: Paise }[];
}

/** Income and expenses for a period, by primary group; gross and net profit. Year-end closing vouchers are left out. */
export async function profitAndLoss(repos: Repositories, q: Scope & { from: Date; to: Date }) {
  const { ledgers, gById, primary } = await chart(repos, q.orgId);
  const totals = new Map((await repos.ledgerEntries.totals({ orgId: q.orgId, branchId: q.branchId, from: q.from, to: q.to, excludeVoucherTypes: ["closing"] })).map((t) => [t.ledgerId, t]));
  const lines = new Map<Id, GroupLine>();
  for (const l of ledgers) {
    const p = primary(gById.get(l.groupId)!);
    if (p.nature !== "income" && p.nature !== "expenses") continue;
    const t = totals.get(l.id);
    if (!t) continue;
    // income is a credit balance, expense a debit balance: show both as positive amounts
    const amount = p.nature === "income" ? t.creditPaise - t.debitPaise : t.debitPaise - t.creditPaise;
    if (amount === 0) continue;
    const line = lines.get(p.id) ?? { group: p, amountPaise: 0, ledgers: [] };
    line.amountPaise += amount;
    line.ledgers.push({ ledger: l, amountPaise: amount });
    lines.set(p.id, line);
  }
  const all = [...lines.values()];
  const sum = (nature: AccountNature, gp: boolean) => all.filter((x) => x.group.nature === nature && x.group.affectsGrossProfit === gp).reduce((s, x) => s + x.amountPaise, 0);
  const grossProfit = sum("income", true) - sum("expenses", true);
  const netProfit = grossProfit + sum("income", false) - sum("expenses", false);
  return {
    income: all.filter((x) => x.group.nature === "income"),
    expenses: all.filter((x) => x.group.nature === "expenses"),
    grossProfitPaise: grossProfit,
    netProfitPaise: netProfit,
  };
}

/** Assets and liabilities at a date; profit to date is shown on the liabilities side, like Tally. */
export async function balanceSheet(repos: Repositories, q: Scope & { asOf: Date }) {
  const { ledgers, gById, primary } = await chart(repos, q.orgId);
  const totals = new Map((await repos.ledgerEntries.totals({ orgId: q.orgId, branchId: q.branchId, to: q.asOf })).map((t) => [t.ledgerId, t]));
  const lines = new Map<Id, GroupLine>();
  let profit = 0;
  for (const l of ledgers) {
    const p = primary(gById.get(l.groupId)!);
    const t = totals.get(l.id);
    const bal = (q.branchId ? 0 : l.openingPaise) + (t ? t.debitPaise - t.creditPaise : 0); // +Dr
    if (bal === 0) continue;
    if (p.nature === "income" || p.nature === "expenses") {
      profit -= bal; // income credit (−) raises profit, expense debit (+) lowers it
      continue;
    }
    const amount = p.nature === "assets" ? bal : -bal;
    const line = lines.get(p.id) ?? { group: p, amountPaise: 0, ledgers: [] };
    line.amountPaise += amount;
    line.ledgers.push({ ledger: l, amountPaise: amount });
    lines.set(p.id, line);
  }
  const all = [...lines.values()];
  const assets = all.filter((x) => x.group.nature === "assets");
  const liabilities = all.filter((x) => x.group.nature === "liabilities");
  const totalAssets = assets.reduce((s, x) => s + x.amountPaise, 0);
  const totalLiabilities = liabilities.reduce((s, x) => s + x.amountPaise, 0) + profit;
  return { assets, liabilities, profitPaise: profit, totalAssetsPaise: totalAssets, totalLiabilitiesPaise: totalLiabilities, differencePaise: totalAssets - totalLiabilities };
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ day book, outstanding, GST

export async function dayBook(repos: Repositories, q: Scope & { from: Date; to: Date; type?: VoucherType }): Promise<Voucher[]> {
  return repos.vouchers.listByDate({ orgId: q.orgId, branchId: q.branchId, from: q.from, to: q.to, type: q.type, includeCancelled: true });
}

export interface OutstandingRow {
  invoice: Invoice;
  ageDays: number;
  bucket: "0-30" | "31-60" | "61-90" | "90+";
}

/** Bills receivable with ageing buckets (Tally "Bills Receivable"). */
export async function outstandingReceivables(repos: Repositories, q: Scope & { asOf?: Date }) {
  const asOf = q.asOf ?? new Date();
  const invoices = await repos.invoices.listOutstanding(q.orgId, q.branchId);
  const rows: OutstandingRow[] = invoices.map((invoice) => {
    const ageDays = Math.max(0, Math.floor((asOf.getTime() - (invoice.issuedAt ?? invoice.createdAt).getTime()) / day));
    const bucket = ageDays <= 30 ? "0-30" : ageDays <= 60 ? "31-60" : ageDays <= 90 ? "61-90" : "90+";
    return { invoice, ageDays, bucket };
  });
  const buckets = { "0-30": 0, "31-60": 0, "61-90": 0, "90+": 0 } as Record<OutstandingRow["bucket"], Paise>;
  for (const r of rows) buckets[r.bucket] += r.invoice.duePaise;
  return { rows, buckets, totalDuePaise: rows.reduce((s, r) => s + r.invoice.duePaise, 0) };
}

/** Output tax for a period from the GST ledgers, with the taxable value from sales. */
export async function gstSummary(repos: Repositories, q: Scope & { from: Date; to: Date }) {
  const keyed = new Map<string, Ledger>();
  for (const l of await repos.ledgers.find({ orgId: q.orgId })) if (l.systemKey) keyed.set(l.systemKey, l);
  const totals = new Map((await repos.ledgerEntries.totals({ orgId: q.orgId, branchId: q.branchId, from: q.from, to: q.to, excludeVoucherTypes: ["closing"] })).map((t) => [t.ledgerId, t]));
  const credit = (key: string) => {
    const l = keyed.get(key);
    const t = l && totals.get(l.id);
    return t ? t.creditPaise - t.debitPaise : 0;
  };
  const cgst = credit("cgst"), sgst = credit("sgst"), igst = credit("igst");
  // taxable value = sales (gross) less discounts allowed
  return { taxableValuePaise: credit("sales") + credit("discount"), cgstPaise: cgst, sgstPaise: sgst, igstPaise: igst, totalTaxPaise: cgst + sgst + igst };
}
```

## File: src/core/services.ts

```ts
import { defaultPostingHook } from "./accounting";
import { computeTotals, type ItemInput } from "./money";
import { counterKeys, dayKey, financialYear, formatBookingNo, formatInvoiceNo, formatSampleBarcode, formatUhid } from "./numbering";
import { ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationError, type Repositories } from "./ports";
import type {
  Booking, BookingTest, Branch, CollectionType, Id, Invoice, InvoiceStatus, Organization, Patient, Payment, PaymentMode,
  Paise, Report, ReportStatus, ResultValue, Sample, User,
} from "./types";

/**
 * Workflows written once against the repository interface, so they behave identically on
 * MongoDB and PostgreSQL. Each one that touches several records runs in a transaction.
 */

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ setup

export interface SeedInput {
  org: Pick<Organization, "name" | "code"> & Partial<Omit<Organization, "id" | "createdAt" | "updatedAt">>;
  branch: Pick<Branch, "code" | "name"> & Partial<Pick<Branch, "kind" | "phone" | "gstin" | "address">>;
  /** Hash the password with @mgpl-diagnostics/auth-kit (hashPassword) before calling. */
  owner: { name: string; email: string; passwordHash: string; phone?: string };
  /** Roles to create, e.g. SYSTEM_ROLES from auth-kit. The owner gets "owner". */
  roles?: { key: string; name: string; permissions: string[] }[];
}

/** Creates an organisation with its roles, its first branch and an owner account. */
export async function seedOrganization(repos: Repositories, input: SeedInput) {
  const passwordHash = input.owner.passwordHash;
  const roles = input.roles ?? [{ key: "owner", name: "Owner", permissions: ["*:*"] }];
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const org = await tx.orgs.create({ settings: {}, ...input.org });
    for (const r of roles) await tx.roles.create({ orgId: org.id, key: r.key, name: r.name, permissions: r.permissions, system: true });
    const branch = await tx.branches.create({ orgId: org.id, kind: "lab", active: true, ...input.branch });
    const owner = await tx.users.create({
      orgId: org.id,
      name: input.owner.name,
      email: input.owner.email.trim().toLowerCase(),
      phone: input.owner.phone,
      passwordHash,
      status: "active",
      roles: [{ role: "owner", branchId: null }],
      lastLoginAt: null,
    });
    await tx.audit.log({ orgId: org.id, userId: owner.id, action: "org.seed", entity: "organization", entityId: org.id });
    return { org, branch, owner };
  });
}

export async function createUser(
  repos: Repositories,
  input: Pick<User, "orgId" | "name" | "email" | "roles" | "passwordHash"> & { phone?: string },
  actorId?: Id,
): Promise<User> {
  const email = input.email.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (await repos.users.findByEmail(input.orgId, email)) throw new ConflictError(`User ${email} already exists`);
  const user = await repos.users.create({
    orgId: input.orgId, name: input.name, email, phone: input.phone, roles: input.roles,
    passwordHash: input.passwordHash, status: "active", lastLoginAt: null,
  });
  await repos.audit.log({ orgId: input.orgId, userId: actorId ?? null, action: "user.create", entity: "user", entityId: user.id });
  return user;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ patients & bookings

export async function registerPatient(
  repos: Repositories,
  input: Omit<Patient, "id" | "uhid" | "createdAt" | "updatedAt">,
  actorId?: Id,
): Promise<Patient> {
  const org = await repos.orgs.get(input.orgId);
  if (!org) throw new NotFoundError("Organization", input.orgId);
  const seq = await repos.counters.next(counterKeys.uhid(org.id));
  const patient = await repos.patients.create({ ...input, uhid: formatUhid(org.code, seq) });
  await repos.audit.log({ orgId: org.id, branchId: input.branchId, userId: actorId ?? null, action: "patient.create", entity: "patient", entityId: patient.id });
  return patient;
}

export interface BookingInput {
  orgId: Id;
  branchId: Id;
  patientId: Id;
  doctorId?: Id | null;
  tests: BookingTest[];
  sampleCollection?: { type: CollectionType; scheduledAt?: Date | null };
  notes?: string;
}

/** Creates a booking and one sample (barcode) per distinct sample type. */
export async function createBooking(repos: Repositories, input: BookingInput, actorId?: Id): Promise<{ booking: Booking; samples: Sample[] }> {
  if (!input.tests.length) throw new ValidationError("A booking needs at least one test");
  const branch = await repos.branches.get(input.branchId);
  if (!branch) throw new NotFoundError("Branch", input.branchId);
  const now = new Date();
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const day = dayKey(now);
    const seq = await tx.counters.next(counterKeys.booking(input.orgId, branch.code, day));
    const booking = await tx.bookings.create({
      orgId: input.orgId, branchId: input.branchId, patientId: input.patientId, doctorId: input.doctorId ?? null,
      bookingNo: formatBookingNo(branch.code, day, seq), tests: input.tests,
      sampleCollection: input.sampleCollection ?? { type: "walk_in" }, status: "booked", invoiceId: null, createdBy: actorId ?? null, notes: input.notes,
    });
    const samples: Sample[] = [];
    for (const type of new Set(input.tests.map((t) => t.sampleType ?? "OTHER"))) {
      const n = await tx.counters.next(counterKeys.sample(input.orgId));
      samples.push(await tx.samples.create({
        orgId: input.orgId, branchId: input.branchId, bookingId: booking.id, sampleType: type, status: "pending",
        barcode: formatSampleBarcode(day.slice(0, 2), n), collectedAt: null, collectedBy: null, receivedAt: null, rejectReason: null,
      }));
    }
    await tx.audit.log({ orgId: input.orgId, branchId: input.branchId, userId: actorId ?? null, action: "booking.create", entity: "booking", entityId: booking.id });
    return { booking, samples };
  });
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ reports

const REPORT_FLOW: Record<ReportStatus, ReportStatus[]> = {
  draft: ["entered"],
  entered: ["entered", "verified", "draft"],
  verified: ["released", "entered"],
  released: ["amended"],
  amended: ["verified"],
};

export async function saveResults(repos: Repositories, reportId: Id, results: ResultValue[], actorId: Id): Promise<Report> {
  return transitionReport(repos, reportId, "entered", actorId, { results });
}

/** Moves a report along draft → entered → verified → released (→ amended → verified …). */
export async function transitionReport(
  repos: Repositories,
  reportId: Id,
  to: ReportStatus,
  actorId: Id,
  extra: Partial<Pick<Report, "results">> = {},
): Promise<Report> {
  const report = await repos.reports.get(reportId);
  if (!report) throw new NotFoundError("Report", reportId);
  if (!REPORT_FLOW[report.status].includes(to)) throw new ConflictError(`Report cannot go from ${report.status} to ${to}`);
  const now = new Date();
  const patch: Partial<Report> = { status: to, ...extra };
  if (to === "entered") patch.enteredBy = actorId;
  if (to === "verified") Object.assign(patch, { verifiedBy: actorId, verifiedAt: now });
  if (to === "released") patch.releasedAt = now;
  if (to === "amended") patch.version = report.version + 1;
  const updated = await repos.reports.update(reportId, patch);
  await repos.audit.log({ orgId: report.orgId, branchId: report.branchId, userId: actorId, action: `report.${to}`, entity: "report", entityId: reportId });
  return updated!;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ billing

export interface IssueInvoiceInput {
  orgId: Id;
  branchId: Id;
  patientId: Id;
  bookingId?: Id | null;
  /** B2B customer billed; finance-kit's issueCustomerInvoice fills these three. */
  customerId?: Id | null;
  placeOfSupply?: string | null;
  buyerGstin?: string | null;
  items: ItemInput[];
  billDiscountPaise?: Paise;
  /** Payments taken at the counter together with the invoice. */
  payments?: { amountPaise: Paise; mode: PaymentMode; reference?: string }[];
  date?: Date;
}

const statusFor = (total: Paise, paid: Paise): InvoiceStatus => (paid >= total ? "paid" : paid > 0 ? "partially_paid" : "issued");

/** Amount due and status after a payment, refund or credit note. Credit notes reduce what is owed. */
export function invoiceBalance(inv: Pick<Invoice, "totalPaise" | "creditedPaise">, paidPaise: Paise, refund = false): { duePaise: Paise; status: InvoiceStatus } {
  const credited = inv.creditedPaise ?? 0;
  const net = inv.totalPaise - credited;
  const duePaise = Math.max(0, net - paidPaise);
  if (credited > 0 && net <= 0 && paidPaise <= 0) return { duePaise, status: "credited" };
  if (refund && paidPaise === 0) return { duePaise, status: "refunded" };
  return { duePaise, status: statusFor(net, paidPaise) };
}

const postingOf = (tx: Repositories) => tx.posting ?? defaultPostingHook;

/** Numbers the invoice in the branch's financial-year series, stores it, links the booking, takes payments. */
export async function issueInvoice(repos: Repositories, input: IssueInvoiceInput, actorId?: Id): Promise<{ invoice: Invoice; payments: Payment[] }> {
  const [org, branch] = await Promise.all([repos.orgs.get(input.orgId), repos.branches.get(input.branchId)]);
  if (!org) throw new NotFoundError("Organization", input.orgId);
  if (!branch) throw new NotFoundError("Branch", input.branchId);
  const { items, totals } = computeTotals(input.items, input.billDiscountPaise);
  const when = input.date ?? new Date();
  const paid = (input.payments ?? []).reduce((s, p) => s + p.amountPaise, 0);
  if (paid > totals.totalPaise) throw new ConflictError("Payments exceed the invoice total");

  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const fy = financialYear(when);
    const seq = await tx.counters.next(counterKeys.invoice(org.id, branch.code, fy));
    const invoice = await tx.invoices.create({
      orgId: org.id, branchId: branch.id, patientId: input.patientId, bookingId: input.bookingId ?? null,
      customerId: input.customerId ?? null, placeOfSupply: input.placeOfSupply ?? null, buyerGstin: input.buyerGstin ?? null,
      invoiceNo: formatInvoiceNo(org.code, branch.code, fy, seq), items, ...totals,
      paidPaise: paid, creditedPaise: 0, duePaise: totals.totalPaise - paid, status: statusFor(totals.totalPaise, paid),
      issuedAt: when, createdBy: actorId ?? null, cancelReason: null,
    });
    const payments: Payment[] = [];
    for (const p of input.payments ?? [])
      payments.push(await tx.payments.create({
        orgId: org.id, branchId: branch.id, invoiceId: invoice.id, kind: "payment", amountPaise: p.amountPaise,
        mode: p.mode, reference: p.reference, receivedBy: actorId ?? null, receivedAt: when,
      }));
    if (input.bookingId) await tx.bookings.update(input.bookingId, { invoiceId: invoice.id });
    // books: sales voucher, then a receipt per payment (the default hook skips them without a chart of accounts)
    const posting = postingOf(tx);
    await posting.invoiceIssued(tx, invoice, actorId);
    for (const p of payments) await posting.paymentRecorded(tx, p, invoice.invoiceNo, actorId);
    await tx.audit.log({ orgId: org.id, branchId: branch.id, userId: actorId ?? null, action: "invoice.issue", entity: "invoice", entityId: invoice.id, data: { invoiceNo: invoice.invoiceNo, totalPaise: invoice.totalPaise } });
    return { invoice, payments };
  });
}

/** Adds a payment or refund. Locks the invoice, so concurrent payments cannot lose updates. */
export async function recordPayment(
  repos: Repositories,
  input: { invoiceId: Id; amountPaise: Paise; mode: PaymentMode; kind?: "payment" | "refund"; reference?: string },
  actorId?: Id,
): Promise<{ invoice: Invoice; payment: Payment }> {
  if (!(input.amountPaise > 0)) throw new ValidationError("Amount must be positive");
  const kind = input.kind ?? "payment";
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const inv = await tx.invoices.getForUpdate(input.invoiceId);
    if (!inv) throw new NotFoundError("Invoice", input.invoiceId);
    if (inv.status === "cancelled") throw new ConflictError("Invoice is cancelled");
    if (kind === "payment" && input.amountPaise > inv.duePaise) throw new ConflictError(`Payment exceeds the amount due (${inv.duePaise} paise)`);
    if (kind === "refund" && input.amountPaise > inv.paidPaise) throw new ConflictError(`Refund exceeds the amount paid (${inv.paidPaise} paise)`);
    const payment = await tx.payments.create({
      orgId: inv.orgId, branchId: inv.branchId, invoiceId: inv.id, kind, amountPaise: input.amountPaise,
      mode: input.mode, reference: input.reference, receivedBy: actorId ?? null, receivedAt: new Date(),
    });
    const paid = inv.paidPaise + (kind === "payment" ? input.amountPaise : -input.amountPaise);
    const invoice = (await tx.invoices.update(inv.id, { paidPaise: paid, ...invoiceBalance(inv, paid, kind === "refund") }))!;
    await postingOf(tx).paymentRecorded(tx, payment, inv.invoiceNo, actorId);
    await tx.audit.log({ orgId: inv.orgId, branchId: inv.branchId, userId: actorId ?? null, action: `payment.${kind}`, entity: "invoice", entityId: inv.id, data: { amountPaise: input.amountPaise, mode: input.mode } });
    return { invoice, payment };
  });
}

/** Cancels an unpaid invoice. A paid one must be refunded first. */
export async function cancelInvoice(repos: Repositories, invoiceId: Id, reason: string, actorId?: Id): Promise<Invoice> {
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const inv = await tx.invoices.getForUpdate(invoiceId);
    if (!inv) throw new NotFoundError("Invoice", invoiceId);
    if (inv.status === "cancelled") return inv;
    if (inv.paidPaise > 0) throw new ConflictError("Refund the payments before cancelling");
    const invoice = (await tx.invoices.update(invoiceId, { status: "cancelled", cancelReason: reason, duePaise: 0 }))!;
    if (inv.bookingId) await tx.bookings.update(inv.bookingId, { invoiceId: null });
    await postingOf(tx).invoiceCancelled(tx, invoiceId, actorId);
    await tx.audit.log({ orgId: inv.orgId, branchId: inv.branchId, userId: actorId ?? null, action: "invoice.cancel", entity: "invoice", entityId: invoiceId, data: { reason } });
    return invoice;
  });
}
```
