## File: src/core/types.ts

```ts
/**
 * Domain model, shared by the MongoDB and PostgreSQL backends.
 * Ids are UUID strings in both, so data and code move between backends unchanged.
 * Money is integer paise (₹1 = 100 paise), matching invoice-kit.
 */

export type Id = string;
export type Paise = number;

export interface Timestamps {
  createdAt: Date;
  updatedAt: Date;
}

/** Fields a caller supplies when creating an entity. */
export type New<T> = Omit<T, "id" | "createdAt" | "updatedAt"> & { id?: Id };

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ organisation

export interface Address {
  line1?: string;
  line2?: string;
  city?: string;
  district?: string;
  state?: string;
  pincode?: string;
}

export interface Organization extends Timestamps {
  id: Id;
  name: string;
  legalName?: string;
  gstin?: string;
  phone?: string;
  email?: string;
  address?: Address;
  /** Prefix for patient UHIDs and invoice numbers, e.g. "MGPL". */
  code: string;
  settings: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export type BranchKind = "lab" | "collection_center";

export interface Branch extends Timestamps {
  id: Id;
  orgId: Id;
  /** Short unique code within the organisation, e.g. "RPR01". */
  code: string;
  name: string;
  kind: BranchKind;
  phone?: string;
  gstin?: string;
  /** GST state code where the branch supplies from, e.g. "22" (Chhattisgarh). Falls back to the GSTIN's first two digits. */
  stateCode?: string;
  address?: Address;
  active: boolean;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ people & access

export type UserStatus = "active" | "disabled" | "invited";

/** A role held in one branch, or in every branch when branchId is null. */
export interface RoleAssignment {
  role: string;
  branchId: Id | null;
}

export interface User extends Timestamps {
  id: Id;
  orgId: Id;
  name: string;
  /** Lower-cased, unique within the organisation. */
  email: string;
  phone?: string;
  passwordHash: string;
  status: UserStatus;
  roles: RoleAssignment[];
  lastLoginAt?: Date | null;
}

export interface Role extends Timestamps {
  id: Id;
  orgId: Id;
  /** Unique within the organisation, e.g. "pathologist". */
  key: string;
  name: string;
  permissions: string[];
  /** Built-in roles cannot be deleted. */
  system: boolean;
}

export interface AuditEntry {
  id: Id;
  orgId: Id;
  branchId?: Id | null;
  userId?: Id | null;
  /** e.g. "invoice.issue", "report.verify", "auth.login" */
  action: string;
  entity?: string;
  entityId?: Id | null;
  ip?: string;
  data?: Record<string, unknown>;
  at: Date;
}

export type Sex = "male" | "female" | "other";

export interface Patient extends Timestamps {
  id: Id;
  orgId: Id;
  /** Branch where the patient registered. */
  branchId: Id;
  /** Unique hospital id within the organisation, e.g. "MGPL-000123". */
  uhid: string;
  title?: string;
  name: string;
  sex: Sex;
  dob?: Date | null;
  /** When the date of birth is unknown. */
  ageYears?: number | null;
  phone?: string;
  email?: string;
  address?: Address;
}

export interface Doctor extends Timestamps {
  id: Id;
  orgId: Id;
  name: string;
  qualification?: string;
  phone?: string;
  clinic?: string;
  active: boolean;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ work

export type BookingStatus = "booked" | "sample_collected" | "in_process" | "completed" | "cancelled";
export type CollectionType = "walk_in" | "home";

export interface BookingTest {
  /** Test id or code in @mgpl-diagnostics/catalog-kit. */
  testCode: string;
  name: string;
  pricePaise: Paise;
  sampleType?: string;
}

export interface Booking extends Timestamps {
  id: Id;
  orgId: Id;
  branchId: Id;
  bookingNo: string;
  patientId: Id;
  doctorId?: Id | null;
  tests: BookingTest[];
  sampleCollection: { type: CollectionType; scheduledAt?: Date | null; address?: Address };
  status: BookingStatus;
  invoiceId?: Id | null;
  createdBy?: Id | null;
  notes?: string;
}

export type SampleStatus = "pending" | "collected" | "received" | "rejected";

export interface Sample extends Timestamps {
  id: Id;
  orgId: Id;
  branchId: Id;
  bookingId: Id;
  /** Unique within the organisation (printed as the tube barcode). */
  barcode: string;
  sampleType: string;
  status: SampleStatus;
  collectedAt?: Date | null;
  collectedBy?: Id | null;
  receivedAt?: Date | null;
  rejectReason?: string | null;
}

export type ReportStatus = "draft" | "entered" | "verified" | "released" | "amended";

export interface ResultValue {
  parameter: string;
  value: string;
  unit?: string;
  flag?: "L" | "H" | "A" | "";
  range?: string;
}

export interface Report extends Timestamps {
  id: Id;
  orgId: Id;
  branchId: Id;
  bookingId: Id;
  patientId: Id;
  testCode: string;
  testName: string;
  results: ResultValue[];
  status: ReportStatus;
  enteredBy?: Id | null;
  verifiedBy?: Id | null;
  verifiedAt?: Date | null;
  releasedAt?: Date | null;
  /** Increases on every amendment after release. */
  version: number;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ billing

/** "credited": credit notes cover the whole invoice. */
export type InvoiceStatus = "draft" | "issued" | "partially_paid" | "paid" | "cancelled" | "refunded" | "credited";
export type ItemCategory = "test" | "package" | "service" | "consumable" | "medicine" | "other";
/** How GST treats a line. Rates and exemptions are configuration (finance-kit tax rules), checked by the lab's CA. */
export type Taxability = "taxable" | "exempt" | "nil_rated" | "non_gst";

export interface InvoiceItem {
  code?: string;
  name: string;
  category: ItemCategory;
  qty: number;
  ratePaise: Paise;
  discountPaise: Paise;
  /** GST percent, 0–100. */
  taxPercent: number;
  /** SAC (services) or HSN (goods) code, for GST returns. */
  hsnSac?: string;
  taxability?: Taxability;
  /** qty × rate − discount, before tax. */
  amountPaise: Paise;
}

export interface InvoiceTotals {
  subtotalPaise: Paise;
  discountPaise: Paise;
  taxPaise: Paise;
  roundOffPaise: Paise;
  totalPaise: Paise;
}

export interface Invoice extends Timestamps, InvoiceTotals {
  id: Id;
  orgId: Id;
  branchId: Id;
  /** Unique within the organisation, e.g. "MGPL/RPR01/2026-27/000123". */
  invoiceNo: string;
  patientId: Id;
  bookingId?: Id | null;
  /** B2B customer billed (hospital, insurer/TPA, corporate); null for patient bills. */
  customerId?: Id | null;
  /** GST state code of the place of supply, e.g. "22". */
  placeOfSupply?: string | null;
  /** Buyer's GSTIN at the time of the invoice (B2B in GSTR-1). */
  buyerGstin?: string | null;
  items: InvoiceItem[];
  paidPaise: Paise;
  /** Sum of credit notes against this invoice (total incl. tax). */
  creditedPaise: Paise;
  /** total − credited − paid, never below 0. */
  duePaise: Paise;
  status: InvoiceStatus;
  issuedAt?: Date | null;
  createdBy?: Id | null;
  cancelReason?: string | null;
}

export type PaymentMode = "cash" | "upi" | "card" | "netbanking" | "wallet" | "cheque" | "insurance";

export interface Payment extends Timestamps {
  id: Id;
  orgId: Id;
  branchId: Id;
  invoiceId: Id;
  kind: "payment" | "refund";
  /** Always positive; refunds subtract. */
  amountPaise: Paise;
  mode: PaymentMode;
  reference?: string;
  receivedBy?: Id | null;
  receivedAt: Date;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ accounting (Tally-style double entry)

/** Where a group sits in the books. Assets/liabilities → balance sheet; income/expenses → P&L. */
export type AccountNature = "assets" | "liabilities" | "income" | "expenses";

/** Tally's account groups (Capital Account, Current Assets, Sundry Debtors, Sales Accounts…). */
export interface AccountGroup extends Timestamps {
  id: Id;
  orgId: Id;
  name: string;
  /** null for primary groups. */
  parentId: Id | null;
  nature: AccountNature;
  /** Direct incomes/expenses, sales and purchases: they make up gross profit. */
  affectsGrossProfit: boolean;
  system: boolean;
}

export interface Ledger extends Timestamps {
  id: Id;
  orgId: Id;
  name: string;
  groupId: Id;
  /** Opening balance in paise: positive = Debit, negative = Credit. */
  openingPaise: Paise;
  /**
   * Fixed role used by automatic posting: "cash", "bank", "upi", "card", "receivables", "sales",
   * "discount", "round_off", "cgst", "sgst", "igst", "doctor_commission", "doctors_payable".
   */
  systemKey?: string | null;
  gstin?: string;
  active: boolean;
}

/** "closing" = the year-end voucher that moves the P&L result to Reserves & Surplus (left out of profitAndLoss). */
export type VoucherType = "sales" | "receipt" | "payment" | "journal" | "contra" | "credit_note" | "debit_note" | "purchase" | "closing";

/** One line of a voucher. Exactly one of debit / credit is positive. */
export interface VoucherEntry {
  ledgerId: Id;
  debitPaise: Paise;
  creditPaise: Paise;
  /** Bill-wise tracking (Tally "Agst Ref"): which invoice this line settles or raises. */
  invoiceId?: Id | null;
}

export interface Voucher extends Timestamps {
  id: Id;
  orgId: Id;
  branchId: Id;
  type: VoucherType;
  /** "SAL/2026-27/000045" — one series per type per financial year. */
  voucherNo: string;
  date: Date;
  narration?: string;
  entries: VoucherEntry[];
  invoiceId?: Id | null;
  paymentId?: Id | null;
  status: "posted" | "cancelled";
  createdBy?: Id | null;
}

/** A posting: one voucher line, stored flat so balances and statements are simple sums. */
export interface LedgerEntry {
  id: Id;
  orgId: Id;
  branchId: Id;
  voucherId: Id;
  voucherType: VoucherType;
  voucherNo: string;
  ledgerId: Id;
  date: Date;
  debitPaise: Paise;
  creditPaise: Paise;
  invoiceId?: Id | null;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ finance (storage for @mgpl-diagnostics/finance-kit)
// Dates nested inside arrays are IST day strings ("2026-10-14"): JSONB would return them as strings anyway.

/** A GST rule: which SAC/HSN, taxability and rate apply to an item code or a whole category from a date. */
export interface TaxRule extends Timestamps {
  id: Id;
  orgId: Id;
  /** Item code; null = the whole category. A code rule wins over a category rule. */
  code?: string | null;
  category?: ItemCategory | null;
  /** SAC (services) or HSN (goods). */
  hsnSac: string;
  taxability: Taxability;
  /** GST percent, 0–100 (0 unless taxable). */
  ratePercent: number;
  effectiveFrom: Date;
  /** Inclusive; null = open-ended. */
  effectiveTo?: Date | null;
  note?: string;
}

export type CustomerKind = "hospital" | "insurer" | "tpa" | "corporate" | "other";

/** A B2B customer billed on credit. */
export interface Customer extends Timestamps {
  id: Id;
  orgId: Id;
  /** Unique within the organisation, e.g. "CITYHOSP". */
  code: string;
  name: string;
  kind: CustomerKind;
  legalName?: string;
  gstin?: string;
  /** GST state code, e.g. "22". Falls back to the GSTIN's first two digits. */
  stateCode?: string;
  pan?: string;
  phone?: string;
  email?: string;
  address?: Address;
  /** null = no limit. */
  creditLimitPaise: Paise | null;
  /** Payment terms in days from the invoice date. */
  creditDays: number;
  /** The customer's own ledger under Sundry Debtors. */
  ledgerId: Id;
  active: boolean;
}

export type PartnerKind = "collection_centre" | "franchise";

/** A business partner (collection centre or franchise) paid a share of what its tests bill. */
export interface Partner extends Timestamps {
  id: Id;
  orgId: Id;
  /** Unique within the organisation. */
  code: string;
  name: string;
  kind: PartnerKind;
  /** The branch (usually a collection_center) whose invoices count for this partner. */
  branchId: Id;
  legalName?: string;
  pan?: string;
  gstin?: string;
  stateCode?: string;
  phone?: string;
  email?: string;
  address?: Address;
  /** The partner's payable ledger under Sundry Creditors. */
  ledgerId: Id;
  /** Overrides the default TDS (e.g. a lower-deduction certificate). Rate in basis points. */
  tds?: { section: string; rateBp: number } | null;
  active: boolean;
}

export type AgreementKind = "revenue_share" | "fixed_rate";

/** What a partner earns, effective from a date. */
export interface PartnerAgreement extends Timestamps {
  id: Id;
  orgId: Id;
  partnerId: Id;
  kind: AgreementKind;
  /** revenue_share: share of the net billed value (after discounts, before GST) in basis points (2500 = 25%). */
  shareBp?: number | null;
  /** fixed_rate: amount per unit, by item code. */
  rates?: { code: string; sharePaise: Paise }[];
  /** fixed_rate: amount for codes not in `rates` (default 0). */
  defaultSharePaise?: Paise | null;
  /** Item categories that earn a share. Default: test, package. */
  categories?: ItemCategory[];
  effectiveFrom: Date;
  /** Inclusive; null = open-ended. */
  effectiveTo?: Date | null;
  notes?: string;
}

export interface SettlementLine {
  invoiceId: Id;
  invoiceNo: string;
  /** IST day of the invoice or credit note, "2026-10-03". */
  day: string;
  code?: string;
  name: string;
  /** Net billed value of the line (negative for a credit note). */
  netPaise: Paise;
  sharePaise: Paise;
  agreementId: Id;
  creditNoteId?: Id | null;
}

export interface SettlementDeduction {
  label: string;
  amountPaise: Paise;
  /** Ledger credited; default: the "partner_recoveries" ledger. */
  ledgerId?: Id | null;
}

export type SettlementStatus = "draft" | "accrued" | "paid" | "cancelled";

/** A partner's statement for one month. */
export interface Settlement extends Timestamps {
  id: Id;
  orgId: Id;
  /** Branch whose books carry the vouchers. */
  branchId: Id;
  partnerId: Id;
  /** "2026-10" */

  /** "<partnerId>:<period>" while not cancelled (unique); null once cancelled. */
  periodKey?: string | null;

  to: Date;

  deductions: SettlementDeduction[];

  tdsPaise: Paise;

  status: SettlementStatus;
  accrualVoucherId?: Id | null;

}
```

## File: src/create-db.ts

```ts
import type { Redis } from "ioredis";
import type { Cache, CacheOptions } from "./cache/cache";
import type { Backend, PostingHook, Repositories } from "./core/ports";
import type { MongoOptions } from "./mongo/index";
import type { PgOptions } from "./pg/index";

export interface CreateDbOptions {
  backend: Backend;
  mongo?: MongoOptions;
  pg?: PgOptions;
  /** A Redis connection or URL. Enables `db.cache` and cached repositories. */
  redis?: Redis | string;
  cache?: CacheOptions & {
    /** Cache reads of orgs, branches, roles, doctors, ledgers and patients by id. Default true. */
    repositories?: boolean;
    /** TTL in seconds for cached repositories. Default 300. */
    ttl?: number;
    /** Two-tier cache with cross-server L1 invalidation (opens a second Redis connection). Default false. */
    twoTier?: boolean;
  };
  /** Create collections / tables and indexes on start. Default true. */
  sync?: boolean;
  /** Posting for invoices and payments, e.g. finance-kit's `financePosting`. Default: this package's accounting. */
  posting?: PostingHook;
}

export interface Db {
  readonly backend: Backend;
  /** Repositories (cached reads where configured). */
  repos: Repositories;
  /** Uncached repositories. Transactions always use these. */
  rawRepos: Repositories;
  cache?: Cache;
  redis?: Redis;
  close(): Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * One call for any backend framework:
 *   const db = await createDb({ backend: "pg", pg: { url }, redis: "redis://localhost:6379" });
 * The backend packages are imported lazily, so Mongo users never load Sequelize and vice versa.
 */
export async function createDb(o: CreateDbOptions): Promise<Db> {
  const rawRepos =
    o.backend === "mongo"
      ? await (await import("./mongo/index")).createMongoRepositories({ posting: o.posting, ...o.mongo })
      : await (await import("./pg/index")).createPgRepositories({ posting: o.posting, ...o.pg });
  if (o.sync !== false) await rawRepos.sync();

  let redis: Redis | undefined;
  let subscriber: Redis | undefined;
  let cache: Cache | undefined;
  let repos = rawRepos;
  const ownsRedis = typeof o.redis === "string";
  if (o.redis) {
    const { default: IORedis } = await import("ioredis");
    redis = typeof o.redis === "string" ? new IORedis(o.redis) : o.redis;
    const c = await import("./cache/index");
    if (o.cache?.twoTier) subscriber = redis.duplicate();
    cache = c.createCache(redis, { ...o.cache, ...(o.cache?.twoTier ? { l1: o.cache.l1 || {}, subscriber } : {}) });
    if (o.cache?.repositories !== false) repos = c.withCache(rawRepos, cache, o.cache?.ttl ?? 300);
  }

  return {
    backend: o.backend,
    repos,
    rawRepos,
    cache,
    redis,
    async close() {
      await rawRepos.close();
      subscriber?.disconnect();
      if (ownsRedis) redis?.disconnect();
    },
  };
}
```

## File: src/graphql/context.ts

```ts
import { GraphQLError } from "graphql";
import { ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationError, type Repositories } from "../core/ports";
import type { Branch, Doctor, Id, Invoice, Ledger, Patient, AccountGroup, Booking, RoleAssignment } from "../core/types";
import { BatchLoader } from "./loader";

/** The signed-in user, as resolved by auth-kit (or your own auth). */
export interface Viewer {
  userId: Id;
  orgId: Id;
  roles: RoleAssignment[];
}

/**
 * What the db-kit resolvers need from a request. auth-kit's context builder provides all of it;
 * any other auth can too.
 */
export interface DbGraphQLContext {
  repos: Repositories;
  viewer: Viewer | null;
  /** Throws (or returns false) when the viewer lacks `permission` in `branchId` (or anywhere when omitted). */
  can(permission: string, branchId?: Id | null): boolean | Promise<boolean>;
  /** Branches where the viewer has `permission`: "all" for organisation-wide roles. */
  branchesFor(permission: string): "all" | Id[] | Promise<"all" | Id[]>;
  /** Created on first use, one set per request. */
  loaders?: Loaders;
}

export interface Loaders {
  patient: BatchLoader<Patient>;
  branch: BatchLoader<Branch>;
  doctor: BatchLoader<Doctor>;
  booking: BatchLoader<Booking>;
  invoice: BatchLoader<Invoice>;
  ledger: BatchLoader<Ledger>;
  group: BatchLoader<AccountGroup>;
}

export function loaders(ctx: DbGraphQLContext): Loaders {
  const r = ctx.repos;
  return (ctx.loaders ??= {
    patient: new BatchLoader((ids) => r.patients.getMany(ids)),
    branch: new BatchLoader((ids) => r.branches.getMany(ids)),
    doctor: new BatchLoader((ids) => r.doctors.getMany(ids)),
    booking: new BatchLoader((ids) => r.bookings.getMany(ids)),
    invoice: new BatchLoader((ids) => r.invoices.getMany(ids)),
    ledger: new BatchLoader((ids) => r.ledgers.getMany(ids)),
    group: new BatchLoader((ids) => r.accountGroups.getMany(ids)),
  });
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ guards

export function viewerOf(ctx: DbGraphQLContext): Viewer {
  if (!ctx.viewer) throw new GraphQLError("Sign in required", { extensions: { code: "UNAUTHENTICATED", http: { status: 401 } } });
  return ctx.viewer;
}

export async function authorize(ctx: DbGraphQLContext, permission: string, branchId?: Id | null): Promise<Viewer> {
  const v = viewerOf(ctx);
  if (!(await ctx.can(permission, branchId))) {
    throw new GraphQLError(`Missing permission ${permission}`, { extensions: { code: "FORBIDDEN", permission, http: { status: 403 } } });
  }
  return v;
}

/** Null unless the entity belongs to the viewer's organisation (tenant isolation). */
export function own<T extends { orgId: Id }>(ctx: DbGraphQLContext, entity: T | null | undefined): T | null {
  return entity && ctx.viewer && entity.orgId === ctx.viewer.orgId ? entity : null;
}

/** Loads an entity by id, enforces organisation + permission in its branch; NOT_FOUND otherwise. */
export async function load<T extends { orgId: Id; branchId?: Id }>(
  ctx: DbGraphQLContext,
  name: string,
  fetch: () => Promise<T | null>,
  permission: string,
): Promise<T> {
  viewerOf(ctx);
  const e = own(ctx, await fetch());
  if (!e) throw notFound(name);
  await authorize(ctx, permission, e.branchId ?? null);
  return e;
}

export const notFound = (name: string) => new GraphQLError(`${name} not found`, { extensions: { code: "NOT_FOUND", http: { status: 404 } } });

/** The branch filter for a list: the requested one (checked) or the viewer's allowed branches. */
export async function branchScope(ctx: DbGraphQLContext, permission: string, branchId?: Id | null): Promise<"all" | Id[]> {
  if (branchId) {
    await authorize(ctx, permission, branchId);
    return [branchId];
  }
  viewerOf(ctx);
  const allowed = await ctx.branchesFor(permission);
  if (allowed !== "all" && !allowed.length) await authorize(ctx, permission); // throws FORBIDDEN
  return allowed;
}

/** Domain errors → GraphQL errors with codes. Anything else is re-thrown (and masked by the server). */
export function toGraphQLError(e: unknown): unknown {
  if (e instanceof GraphQLError) return e;
  const code =
    e instanceof NotFoundError ? "NOT_FOUND"
    : e instanceof ConflictError ? "CONFLICT"
    : e instanceof ValidationError ? "BAD_USER_INPUT"
    : null;
  if (!code) return e;
  const err = e as Error & { statusCode?: number };
  // no `originalError`: Yoga masks any GraphQLError that wraps a non-GraphQL error as "Unexpected error"
  return new GraphQLError(err.message, { extensions: { code, http: { status: err.statusCode } } });
}

/** Wraps every resolver of a map so domain errors surface with proper codes. */
export function withErrorCodes<R extends Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>>(resolvers: R): R {
  for (const type of Object.values(resolvers)) {
    for (const [field, fn] of Object.entries(type)) {
      if (typeof fn !== "function") continue;
      type[field] = async (...args: unknown[]) => {
        try {
          return await (fn as (...a: unknown[]) => unknown)(...args);
        } catch (e) {
          throw toGraphQLError(e);
        }
      };
    }
  }
  return resolvers;
}
```

```ts
import { makeExecutableSchema } from "@graphql-tools/schema";
import type { GraphQLSchema } from "graphql";
import { resolvers } from "./resolvers";
import { typeDefs } from "./type-defs";

export { typeDefs, resolvers };
export { BatchLoader } from "./loader";
export {
  authorize, branchScope, load, loaders, own, toGraphQLError, viewerOf, withErrorCodes,
  type DbGraphQLContext, type Loaders, type Viewer,
} from "./context";

/** A GraphQL module: merge several (db-kit, auth-kit, catalog-kit, your own) into one schema. */
export interface GraphQLModule {
  typeDefs: string;
  resolvers: Record<string, any>;
}

export const dbModule: GraphQLModule = { typeDefs, resolvers };

/** Permissions the db-kit resolvers check. auth-kit's roles grant these. */
export const DB_PERMISSIONS = [
  "org:read", "branch:read",
  "patient:read", "patient:create", "patient:update",
  "doctor:read", "doctor:manage",
  "booking:read", "booking:create", "booking:cancel",
  "sample:read", "sample:collect", "sample:receive", "sample:reject",
  "report:read", "report:enter", "report:verify", "report:release", "report:amend",
  "invoice:read", "invoice:create", "invoice:discount", "invoice:cancel",
  "payment:create", "payment:refund",
  "accounts:read", "accounts:post", "accounts:manage",
] as const;

/**
 * Builds one executable schema from modules. Each module may `extend type Query/Mutation`.
 *   const schema = createSchema([dbModule, authModule, catalogModule]);
 *   const yoga = createYoga({ schema, context: (req) => auth.context(req, db.repos) });
 */
export function createSchema(modules: GraphQLModule[]): GraphQLSchema {
  return makeExecutableSchema({ typeDefs: modules.map((m) => m.typeDefs), resolvers: modules.map((m) => m.resolvers) });
}
```

## File: src/graphql/loader.ts

```ts
/**
 * Minimal DataLoader: every load() in the same tick is batched into one getMany(), and results
 * are memoised for the request. Prevents N+1 queries when a list resolves nested fields
 * (e.g. 50 invoices → 1 query for their patients).
 */
export class BatchLoader<T extends { id: string }> {
  private cache = new Map<string, Promise<T | null>>();
  private queue: { id: string; resolve: (v: T | null) => void; reject: (e: unknown) => void }[] = [];

  constructor(private readonly fetchMany: (ids: readonly string[]) => Promise<T[]>) {}

  load(id: string | null | undefined): Promise<T | null> {
    if (!id) return Promise.resolve(null);
    const hit = this.cache.get(id);
    if (hit) return hit;
    const p = new Promise<T | null>((resolve, reject) => {
      this.queue.push({ id, resolve, reject });
      if (this.queue.length === 1) queueMicrotask(() => void this.flush());
    });
    this.cache.set(id, p);
    return p;
  }

  /** Seeds the cache with an entity you already have (e.g. just created). */
  prime(entity: T): void {
    this.cache.set(entity.id, Promise.resolve(entity));
  }

  clear(id: string): void {
    this.cache.delete(id);
  }

  private async flush(): Promise<void> {
    const batch = this.queue;
    this.queue = [];
    try {
      const rows = await this.fetchMany([...new Set(batch.map((b) => b.id))]);
      const byId = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.id, r]));
      for (const b of batch) b.resolve(byId.get(b.id) ?? null);
    } catch (e) {
      for (const b of batch) {
        this.cache.delete(b.id);
        b.reject(e);
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## File: src/graphql/resolvers.ts

```ts
import { GraphQLScalarType, Kind } from "graphql";
import { cancelVoucher, postVoucher, seedChartOfAccounts } from "../core/accounting";
import { ConflictError, ValidationError, type Repo } from "../core/ports";
import {
  balanceSheet, dayBook, gstSummary, ledgerBalance, ledgerStatement, outstandingReceivables, profitAndLoss, trialBalance,
} from "../core/reports";
import {
  cancelInvoice, createBooking, issueInvoice, recordPayment, registerPatient, saveResults, transitionReport,
} from "../core/services";
import type {
  AccountGroup, Booking, Id, Invoice, Ledger, Patient, Report, ResultValue, Sample, Voucher, VoucherEntry,
} from "../core/types";
import { authorize, branchScope, load, loaders, notFound, own, viewerOf, withErrorCodes, type DbGraphQLContext as Ctx } from "./context";

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ scalars & enum mapping

const DateTime = new GraphQLScalarType({
  name: "DateTime",
  description: "ISO-8601 date-time",
  serialize: (v) => (v instanceof Date ? v : new Date(v as string)).toISOString(),
  parseValue: (v) => {
    const d = new Date(v as string);
    if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) throw new TypeError("Invalid DateTime");
    return d;
  },
  parseLiteral: (ast) => (ast.kind === Kind.STRING ? new Date(ast.value) : null),
});

const JSONScalar = new GraphQLScalarType({ name: "JSON", serialize: (v) => v, parseValue: (v) => v });

const flagOut = (f: ResultValue["flag"]) => (f === "" ? "NONE" : f ?? null);
const flagIn = (f?: string | null): ResultValue["flag"] => (f === "NONE" ? "" : ((f ?? undefined) as ResultValue["flag"]));
const BUCKET = { "0-30": "D0_30", "31-60": "D31_60", "61-90": "D61_90", "90+": "D90_PLUS" } as const;

const clean = <T extends object>(o: T): Partial<T> => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(o).filter(([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== null)) as Partial<T>;
const cap = (n: number | undefined, d: number) => Math.min(Math.max(1, n ?? d), 200);

/** Lists honour the viewer's branch access: all branches, or only the allowed ones. */
async function scopedFind<T extends { id: Id }>(repo: Repo<T>, filter: Record<string, unknown>, scope: "all" | Id[], limit: number, offset: number, sortField: string): Promise<T[]> {
  const sort = { field: sortField as keyof T & string, dir: "desc" as const };
  if (scope === "all") return repo.find(filter as any, { limit, offset, sort });
  const lists = await Promise.all(scope.map((b) => repo.find({ ...filter, branchId: b } as any, { limit: limit + offset, sort })));
  return lists.flat().sort((a: any, b: any) => +b[sortField] - +a[sortField]).slice(offset, offset + limit);
}

async function ownLedgers(ctx: Ctx, ids: Id[]): Promise<void> {
  const v = viewerOf(ctx);
  const found = await ctx.repos.ledgers.getMany([...new Set(ids)]);
  if (found.length !== new Set(ids).size || found.some((l) => l.orgId !== v.orgId)) throw notFound("Ledger");
}

const canSee = async (ctx: Ctx, permission: string, branchId?: Id | null) => Boolean(ctx.viewer && (await ctx.can(permission, branchId)));

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ resolvers

export const resolvers = withErrorCodes({
  Query: {
    organization: async (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.repos.orgs.get(viewerOf(ctx).orgId),
    branches: async (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.repos.branches.find({ orgId: viewerOf(ctx).orgId }, { sort: { field: "code" } }),

    patient: async (_: unknown, a: { id: Id }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      await authorize(ctx, "patient:read");
      return own(ctx, await ctx.repos.patients.get(a.id));
    },
    patients: async (_: unknown, a: { search: string; limit?: number }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const v = await authorize(ctx, "patient:read");
      return ctx.repos.patients.search(v.orgId, a.search, cap(a.limit, 20));
    },
    doctors: async (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const v = await authorize(ctx, "doctor:read");
      return ctx.repos.doctors.find({ orgId: v.orgId }, { sort: { field: "name" } });
    },

    booking: async (_: unknown, a: { id: Id }, ctx: Ctx) => load(ctx, "Booking", () => ctx.repos.bookings.get(a.id), "booking:read"),
    bookings: async (_: unknown, a: { branchId?: Id; status?: string; patientId?: Id; limit?: number; offset?: number }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const scope = await branchScope(ctx, "booking:read", a.branchId);
      return scopedFind(ctx.repos.bookings, clean({ orgId: viewerOf(ctx).orgId, status: a.status, patientId: a.patientId }), scope, cap(a.limit, 50), a.offset ?? 0, "createdAt");
    },
    sampleByBarcode: async (_: unknown, a: { barcode: string }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const v = viewerOf(ctx);
      const s = await ctx.repos.samples.findOne({ orgId: v.orgId, barcode: a.barcode.trim() });
      if (!s) return null;
      await authorize(ctx, "sample:read", s.branchId);
      return s;
    },
    report: async (_: unknown, a: { id: Id }, ctx: Ctx) => load(ctx, "Report", () => ctx.repos.reports.get(a.id), "report:read"),
    invoice: async (_: unknown, a: { id: Id }, ctx: Ctx) => load(ctx, "Invoice", () => ctx.repos.invoices.get(a.id), "invoice:read"),
    invoices: async (_: unknown, a: { branchId?: Id; status?: string; patientId?: Id; limit?: number; offset?: number }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const scope = await branchScope(ctx, "invoice:read", a.branchId);
      return scopedFind(ctx.repos.invoices, clean({ orgId: viewerOf(ctx).orgId, status: a.status, patientId: a.patientId }), scope, cap(a.limit, 50), a.offset ?? 0, "createdAt");
    },

    accountGroups: async (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.repos.accountGroups.find({ orgId: (await authorize(ctx, "accounts:read")).orgId }, { sort: { field: "name" } }),
    ledgers: async (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.repos.ledgers.find({ orgId: (await authorize(ctx, "accounts:read")).orgId }, { sort: { field: "name" } }),
    ledgerStatement: async (_: unknown, a: { ledgerId: Id; from: Date; to: Date; branchId?: Id }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const v = await authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", a.branchId);
      await ownLedgers(ctx, [a.ledgerId]);
      return ledgerStatement(ctx.repos, { orgId: v.orgId, ...a });
    },
    trialBalance: async (_: unknown, a: { asOf?: Date; branchId?: Id }, ctx: Ctx) => trialBalance(ctx.repos, { orgId: (await authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", a.branchId)).orgId, ...a }),
    profitAndLoss: async (_: unknown, a: { from: Date; to: Date; branchId?: Id }, ctx: Ctx) => profitAndLoss(ctx.repos, { orgId: (await authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", a.branchId)).orgId, ...a }),
    balanceSheet: async (_: unknown, a: { asOf: Date; branchId?: Id }, ctx: Ctx) => balanceSheet(ctx.repos, { orgId: (await authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", a.branchId)).orgId, ...a }),
    dayBook: async (_: unknown, a: { from: Date; to: Date; branchId?: Id; type?: Voucher["type"] }, ctx: Ctx) => dayBook(ctx.repos, { orgId: (await authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", a.branchId)).orgId, ...a }),
    outstandingReceivables: async (_: unknown, a: { branchId?: Id }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const out = await outstandingReceivables(ctx.repos, { orgId: (await authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", a.branchId)).orgId, branchId: a.branchId });
      return {
        rows: out.rows.map((r) => ({ ...r, bucket: BUCKET[r.bucket] })),
        buckets: { d0to30: out.buckets["0-30"], d31to60: out.buckets["31-60"], d61to90: out.buckets["61-90"], d90plus: out.buckets["90+"] },
        totalDuePaise: out.totalDuePaise,
      };
    },
    gstSummary: async (_: unknown, a: { from: Date; to: Date; branchId?: Id }, ctx: Ctx) => gstSummary(ctx.repos, { orgId: (await authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", a.branchId)).orgId, ...a }),
  },

  Organization: {
    branches: (o: { id: Id }, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.repos.branches.find({ orgId: o.id }, { sort: { field: "code" } }),
  },
  Patient: {
    branch: (p: Patient, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => loaders(ctx).branch.load(p.branchId),
    bookings: async (p: Patient, a: { limit?: number }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      if (!(await canSee(ctx, "booking:read"))) return [];
      const scope = await ctx.branchesFor("booking:read");
      return scopedFind(ctx.repos.bookings, { patientId: p.id }, scope, cap(a.limit, 20), 0, "createdAt");
    },
    invoices: async (p: Patient, a: { limit?: number }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      if (!(await canSee(ctx, "invoice:read"))) return [];
      const scope = await ctx.branchesFor("invoice:read");
      return scopedFind(ctx.repos.invoices, { patientId: p.id }, scope, cap(a.limit, 20), 0, "createdAt");
    },
  },
  Booking: {
    patient: (b: Booking, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => loaders(ctx).patient.load(b.patientId),
    doctor: (b: Booking, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => loaders(ctx).doctor.load(b.doctorId),
    branch: (b: Booking, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => loaders(ctx).branch.load(b.branchId),
    samples: (b: Booking, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.repos.samples.find({ bookingId: b.id }, { sort: { field: "barcode" } }),
    reports: async (b: Booking, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ((await canSee(ctx, "report:read", b.branchId)) ? ctx.repos.reports.find({ bookingId: b.id }) : []),
    invoice: async (b: Booking, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ((await canSee(ctx, "invoice:read", b.branchId)) ? loaders(ctx).invoice.load(b.invoiceId) : null),
  },
  Report: {
    results: (r: Report) => r.results.map((x) => ({ ...x, flag: flagOut(x.flag) })),
    patient: (r: Report, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => loaders(ctx).patient.load(r.patientId),
    booking: (r: Report, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => loaders(ctx).booking.load(r.bookingId),
  },
  Invoice: {
    patient: (i: Invoice, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => loaders(ctx).patient.load(i.patientId),
    branch: (i: Invoice, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => loaders(ctx).branch.load(i.branchId),
    booking: (i: Invoice, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => loaders(ctx).booking.load(i.bookingId),
    payments: (i: Invoice, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.repos.payments.find({ invoiceId: i.id }, { sort: { field: "receivedAt" } }),
    vouchers: async (i: Invoice, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ((await canSee(ctx, "accounts:read", i.branchId)) ? ctx.repos.vouchers.find({ invoiceId: i.id } as any, { sort: { field: "date" } }) : []),
  },
  AccountGroup: {
    parent: (g: AccountGroup, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => loaders(ctx).group.load(g.parentId),
  },
  Ledger: {
    group: (l: Ledger, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => loaders(ctx).group.load(l.groupId),
    balancePaise: (l: Ledger, a: { asOf?: Date; branchId?: Id }, ctx: Ctx) => ledgerBalance(ctx.repos, { orgId: l.orgId, ledgerId: l.id, ...a }),
  },
  VoucherEntry: {
    ledger: (e: VoucherEntry, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => loaders(ctx).ledger.load(e.ledgerId),
  },

  Mutation: {
    registerPatient: async (_: unknown, { input }: { input: any }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const v = await authorize(ctx, "patient:create", input.branchId);
      if (!own(ctx, await ctx.repos.branches.get(input.branchId))) throw notFound("Branch");
      return registerPatient(ctx.repos, { ...input, orgId: v.orgId }, v.userId);
    },
    updatePatient: async (_: unknown, { id, input }: { id: Id; input: any }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const v = await authorize(ctx, "patient:update");
      if (!own(ctx, await ctx.repos.patients.get(id))) throw notFound("Patient");
      const p = await ctx.repos.patients.update(id, clean(input));
      await ctx.repos.audit.log({ orgId: v.orgId, userId: v.userId, action: "patient.update", entity: "patient", entityId: id });
      return p;
    },
    createDoctor: async (_: unknown, { input }: { input: any }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const v = await authorize(ctx, "doctor:manage");
      return ctx.repos.doctors.create({ ...input, orgId: v.orgId, active: input.active ?? true });
    },

    createBooking: async (_: unknown, { input }: { input: any }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const v = await authorize(ctx, "booking:create", input.branchId);
      if (!own(ctx, await ctx.repos.branches.get(input.branchId))) throw notFound("Branch");
      if (!own(ctx, await ctx.repos.patients.get(input.patientId))) throw notFound("Patient");
      if (input.doctorId && !own(ctx, await ctx.repos.doctors.get(input.doctorId))) throw notFound("Doctor");
      return createBooking(ctx.repos, {
        orgId: v.orgId, branchId: input.branchId, patientId: input.patientId, doctorId: input.doctorId ?? null, tests: input.tests,
        sampleCollection: { type: input.collectionType ?? "walk_in", scheduledAt: input.scheduledAt ?? null }, notes: input.notes,
      }, v.userId);
    },
    cancelBooking: async (_: unknown, { id }: { id: Id }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const b = await load(ctx, "Booking", () => ctx.repos.bookings.get(id), "booking:cancel");
      if (b.invoiceId) {
        const inv = await ctx.repos.invoices.get(b.invoiceId);
        if (inv && inv.status !== "cancelled") throw new ConflictError("Cancel the booking's invoice first");
      }
      const out = await ctx.repos.bookings.update(id, { status: "cancelled" });
      await ctx.repos.audit.log({ orgId: b.orgId, branchId: b.branchId, userId: ctx.viewer!.userId, action: "booking.cancel", entity: "booking", entityId: id });
      return out;
    },
    collectSample: async (_: unknown, { id }: { id: Id }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const s = await load<Sample>(ctx, "Sample", () => ctx.repos.samples.get(id), "sample:collect");
      if (s.status !== "pending") throw new ConflictError(`Sample is ${s.status}`);
      const out = await ctx.repos.samples.update(id, { status: "collected", collectedAt: new Date(), collectedBy: ctx.viewer!.userId });
      const b = await ctx.repos.bookings.get(s.bookingId);
      if (b?.status === "booked") await ctx.repos.bookings.update(b.id, { status: "sample_collected" });
      return out;
    },
    receiveSample: async (_: unknown, { id }: { id: Id }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const s = await load<Sample>(ctx, "Sample", () => ctx.repos.samples.get(id), "sample:receive");
      if (s.status !== "collected") throw new ConflictError(`Sample is ${s.status}`);
      const out = await ctx.repos.samples.update(id, { status: "received", receivedAt: new Date() });
      await ctx.repos.bookings.update(s.bookingId, { status: "in_process" });
      return out;
    },
    rejectSample: async (_: unknown, { id, reason }: { id: Id; reason: string }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      await load<Sample>(ctx, "Sample", () => ctx.repos.samples.get(id), "sample:reject");
      return ctx.repos.samples.update(id, { status: "rejected", rejectReason: reason });
    },

    createReport: async (_: unknown, a: { bookingId: Id; testCode: string; testName: string }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const b = await load(ctx, "Booking", () => ctx.repos.bookings.get(a.bookingId), "report:enter");
      if (!b.tests.some((t) => t.testCode === a.testCode)) throw new ValidationError(`Test ${a.testCode} is not in booking ${b.bookingNo}`);
      return ctx.repos.reports.create({ orgId: b.orgId, branchId: b.branchId, bookingId: b.id, patientId: b.patientId, testCode: a.testCode, testName: a.testName, results: [], status: "draft", version: 1 });
    },
    saveResults: async (_: unknown, a: { reportId: Id; results: any[] }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      await load(ctx, "Report", () => ctx.repos.reports.get(a.reportId), "report:enter");
      return saveResults(ctx.repos, a.reportId, a.results.map((r) => ({ ...r, flag: flagIn(r.flag) })), ctx.viewer!.userId);
    },
    verifyReport: async (_: unknown, { id }: { id: Id }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      await load(ctx, "Report", () => ctx.repos.reports.get(id), "report:verify");
      return transitionReport(ctx.repos, id, "verified", ctx.viewer!.userId);
    },
    releaseReport: async (_: unknown, { id }: { id: Id }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const r = await load(ctx, "Report", () => ctx.repos.reports.get(id), "report:release");
      const out = await transitionReport(ctx.repos, id, "released", ctx.viewer!.userId);
      const all = await ctx.repos.reports.find({ bookingId: r.bookingId });
      if (all.every((x) => x.status === "released")) await ctx.repos.bookings.update(r.bookingId, { status: "completed" });
      return out;
    },
    amendReport: async (_: unknown, { id }: { id: Id }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      await load(ctx, "Report", () => ctx.repos.reports.get(id), "report:amend");
      return transitionReport(ctx.repos, id, "amended", ctx.viewer!.userId);
    },

    issueInvoice: async (_: unknown, { input }: { input: any }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const v = await authorize(ctx, "invoice:create", input.branchId);
      const discounted = (input.billDiscountPaise ?? 0) > 0 || input.items.some((i: any) => (i.discountPaise ?? 0) > 0);
      if (discounted) await authorize(ctx, "invoice:discount", input.branchId);
      if (input.payments?.length) await authorize(ctx, "payment:create", input.branchId);
      if (!own(ctx, await ctx.repos.branches.get(input.branchId))) throw notFound("Branch");
      if (!own(ctx, await ctx.repos.patients.get(input.patientId))) throw notFound("Patient");
      if (input.bookingId && !own(ctx, await ctx.repos.bookings.get(input.bookingId))) throw notFound("Booking");
      const { invoice } = await issueInvoice(ctx.repos, { ...input, orgId: v.orgId }, v.userId);
      return invoice;
    },
    recordPayment: async (_: unknown, a: { invoiceId: Id; payment: any }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      await load(ctx, "Invoice", () => ctx.repos.invoices.get(a.invoiceId), "payment:create");
      return (await recordPayment(ctx.repos, { invoiceId: a.invoiceId, ...a.payment, kind: "payment" }, ctx.viewer!.userId)).invoice;
    },
    refundPayment: async (_: unknown, a: { invoiceId: Id; payment: any }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      await load(ctx, "Invoice", () => ctx.repos.invoices.get(a.invoiceId), "payment:refund");
      return (await recordPayment(ctx.repos, { invoiceId: a.invoiceId, ...a.payment, kind: "refund" }, ctx.viewer!.userId)).invoice;
    },
    cancelInvoice: async (_: unknown, a: { id: Id; reason: string }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      await load(ctx, "Invoice", () => ctx.repos.invoices.get(a.id), "invoice:cancel");
      return cancelInvoice(ctx.repos, a.id, a.reason, ctx.viewer!.userId);
    },

    setupChartOfAccounts: async (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => (await seedChartOfAccounts(ctx.repos, (await authorize(ctx, "accounts:manage")).orgId)).ledgers,
    createLedger: async (_: unknown, { input }: { input: any }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const v = await authorize(ctx, "accounts:manage");
      if (!own(ctx, await ctx.repos.accountGroups.get(input.groupId))) throw notFound("Account group");
      return ctx.repos.ledgers.create({ orgId: v.orgId, name: input.name, groupId: input.groupId, openingPaise: input.openingPaise ?? 0, gstin: input.gstin, systemKey: null, active: true });
    },
    postVoucher: async (_: unknown, { input }: { input: any }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const v = await authorize(ctx, "accounts:post", input.branchId);
      if (!own(ctx, await ctx.repos.branches.get(input.branchId))) throw notFound("Branch");
      await ownLedgers(ctx, input.entries.map((e: VoucherEntry) => e.ledgerId)); // no posting into another organisation's books
      for (const e of input.entries) if (e.invoiceId && !own(ctx, await ctx.repos.invoices.get(e.invoiceId))) throw notFound("Invoice");
      return postVoucher(ctx.repos, { ...input, orgId: v.orgId, entries: input.entries.map((e: any) => ({ ...e, debitPaise: e.debitPaise ?? 0, creditPaise: e.creditPaise ?? 0 })) }, v.userId);
    },
    cancelVoucher: async (_: unknown, { id }: { id: Id }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      await load(ctx, "Voucher", () => ctx.repos.vouchers.get(id), "accounts:post");
      return cancelVoucher(ctx.repos, id, ctx.viewer!.userId);
    },
  },
});

// scalars are added after wrapping (they are not functions to wrap)
Object.assign(resolvers, { DateTime, JSON: JSONScalar });
```

## File: src/graphql/type-defs.ts

```ts
/**
 * GraphQL schema for the data layer. Money is Int paise (₹1 = 100). Dates are ISO-8601 DateTime.
 * Everything is scoped to the signed-in user's organisation; no query takes an orgId.
 */
export const typeDefs = /* GraphQL */ `
  scalar DateTime
  scalar JSON

  enum Sex { male female other }
  enum BranchKind { lab collection_center }
  enum BookingStatus { booked sample_collected in_process completed cancelled }
  enum CollectionType { walk_in home }
  enum SampleStatus { pending collected received rejected }
  enum ReportStatus { draft entered verified released amended }
  enum InvoiceStatus { draft issued partially_paid paid cancelled refunded credited }
  enum ItemCategory { test package service consumable medicine other }
  enum PaymentMode { cash upi card netbanking wallet cheque insurance }
  enum PaymentKind { payment refund }
  enum ResultFlag { L H A NONE }
  enum AccountNature { assets liabilities income expenses }
  enum VoucherType { sales receipt payment journal contra credit_note debit_note purchase closing }
  enum VoucherStatus { posted cancelled }
  enum AgeBucket { D0_30 D31_60 D61_90 D90_PLUS }

  type Address { line1: String, line2: String, city: String, district: String, state: String, pincode: String }

  type Organization {
    id: ID!
    name: String!
    code: String!
    legalName: String
    gstin: String
    phone: String
    email: String
    address: Address
    branches: [Branch!]!
  }

  type Branch { id: ID!, code: String!, name: String!, kind: BranchKind!, phone: String, gstin: String, address: Address, active: Boolean! }

  type Patient {
    id: ID!
    uhid: String!
    title: String
    name: String!
    sex: Sex!
    dob: DateTime
    ageYears: Int
    phone: String
    email: String
    address: Address
    branch: Branch
    createdAt: DateTime!
    bookings(limit: Int = 20): [Booking!]!
    invoices(limit: Int = 20): [Invoice!]!
  }

  type Doctor { id: ID!, name: String!, qualification: String, phone: String, clinic: String, active: Boolean! }

  type BookingTest { testCode: String!, name: String!, pricePaise: Int!, sampleType: String }
  type SampleCollection { type: CollectionType!, scheduledAt: DateTime, address: Address }

  type Booking {
    id: ID!
    bookingNo: String!
    status: BookingStatus!
    patient: Patient!
    doctor: Doctor
    branch: Branch!
    tests: [BookingTest!]!
    sampleCollection: SampleCollection!
    samples: [Sample!]!
    reports: [Report!]!
    invoice: Invoice
    notes: String
    createdAt: DateTime!
  }

  type Sample {
    id: ID!
    barcode: String!
    sampleType: String!
    status: SampleStatus!
    collectedAt: DateTime
    receivedAt: DateTime
    rejectReason: String
  }

  type ResultValue { parameter: String!, value: String!, unit: String, flag: ResultFlag, range: String }

  type Report {
    id: ID!
    testCode: String!
    testName: String!
    status: ReportStatus!
    results: [ResultValue!]!
    version: Int!
    verifiedAt: DateTime
    releasedAt: DateTime
    patient: Patient!
    booking: Booking!
    updatedAt: DateTime!
  }

  type InvoiceItem {
    code: String
    name: String!
    category: ItemCategory!
    qty: Float!
    ratePaise: Int!
    discountPaise: Int!
    taxPercent: Float!
    amountPaise: Int!
  }

  type Invoice {
    id: ID!
    invoiceNo: String!
    status: InvoiceStatus!
    patient: Patient!
    branch: Branch!
    booking: Booking
    items: [InvoiceItem!]!
    subtotalPaise: Int!
    discountPaise: Int!
    taxPaise: Int!
    roundOffPaise: Int!
    totalPaise: Int!
    paidPaise: Int!
    duePaise: Int!
    issuedAt: DateTime
    cancelReason: String
    payments: [Payment!]!
    vouchers: [Voucher!]!
  }

  type Payment { id: ID!, kind: PaymentKind!, amountPaise: Int!, mode: PaymentMode!, reference: String, receivedAt: DateTime! }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- accounting (Tally-style)

  type AccountGroup { id: ID!, name: String!, nature: AccountNature!, parent: AccountGroup, affectsGrossProfit: Boolean! }

  type Ledger {
    id: ID!
    name: String!
    group: AccountGroup!
    openingPaise: Int!
    systemKey: String
    gstin: String
    active: Boolean!
    "Closing balance, positive = Debit."
    balancePaise(asOf: DateTime, branchId: ID): Int!
  }

  type VoucherEntry { ledger: Ledger!, debitPaise: Int!, creditPaise: Int!, invoiceId: ID }

  type Voucher {
    id: ID!
    type: VoucherType!
    voucherNo: String!
    date: DateTime!
    narration: String
    status: VoucherStatus!
    entries: [VoucherEntry!]!
    invoiceId: ID
  }

  type StatementRow { date: DateTime!, voucherNo: String!, voucherType: VoucherType!, debitPaise: Int!, creditPaise: Int!, balancePaise: Int!, invoiceId: ID }
  type LedgerStatement { ledger: Ledger!, openingPaise: Int!, closingPaise: Int!, totalDebitPaise: Int!, totalCreditPaise: Int!, rows: [StatementRow!]! }
  type TrialBalanceRow { ledger: Ledger!, group: AccountGroup!, primaryGroup: AccountGroup!, debitPaise: Int!, creditPaise: Int! }
  type TrialBalance { rows: [TrialBalanceRow!]!, totalDebitPaise: Int!, totalCreditPaise: Int!, differencePaise: Int! }
  type LedgerAmount { ledger: Ledger!, amountPaise: Int! }
  type GroupLine { group: AccountGroup!, amountPaise: Int!, ledgers: [LedgerAmount!]! }
  type ProfitAndLoss { income: [GroupLine!]!, expenses: [GroupLine!]!, grossProfitPaise: Int!, netProfitPaise: Int! }
  type BalanceSheet { assets: [GroupLine!]!, liabilities: [GroupLine!]!, profitPaise: Int!, totalAssetsPaise: Int!, totalLiabilitiesPaise: Int!, differencePaise: Int! }
  type OutstandingRow { invoice: Invoice!, ageDays: Int!, bucket: AgeBucket! }
  type BucketTotals { d0to30: Int!, d31to60: Int!, d61to90: Int!, d90plus: Int! }
  type Outstanding { rows: [OutstandingRow!]!, buckets: BucketTotals!, totalDuePaise: Int! }
  type GstSummary { taxableValuePaise: Int!, cgstPaise: Int!, sgstPaise: Int!, igstPaise: Int!, totalTaxPaise: Int! }

  type Query {
    organization: Organization!
    branches: [Branch!]!
    patient(id: ID!): Patient
    "Name, phone or UHID."
    patients(search: String!, limit: Int = 20): [Patient!]!
    doctors: [Doctor!]!
    booking(id: ID!): Booking
    bookings(branchId: ID, status: BookingStatus, patientId: ID, limit: Int = 50, offset: Int = 0): [Booking!]!
    sampleByBarcode(barcode: String!): Sample
    report(id: ID!): Report
    invoice(id: ID!): Invoice
    invoices(branchId: ID, status: InvoiceStatus, patientId: ID, limit: Int = 50, offset: Int = 0): [Invoice!]!

    accountGroups: [AccountGroup!]!
    ledgers: [Ledger!]!
    ledgerStatement(ledgerId: ID!, from: DateTime!, to: DateTime!, branchId: ID): LedgerStatement!
    trialBalance(asOf: DateTime, branchId: ID): TrialBalance!
    profitAndLoss(from: DateTime!, to: DateTime!, branchId: ID): ProfitAndLoss!
    balanceSheet(asOf: DateTime!, branchId: ID): BalanceSheet!
    dayBook(from: DateTime!, to: DateTime!, branchId: ID, type: VoucherType): [Voucher!]!
    outstandingReceivables(branchId: ID): Outstanding!
    gstSummary(from: DateTime!, to: DateTime!, branchId: ID): GstSummary!
  }

  input AddressInput { line1: String, line2: String, city: String, district: String, state: String, pincode: String }

  input RegisterPatientInput {
    branchId: ID!
    title: String
    name: String!
    sex: Sex!
    dob: DateTime
    ageYears: Int
    phone: String
    email: String
    address: AddressInput
  }

  input UpdatePatientInput { title: String, name: String, sex: Sex, dob: DateTime, ageYears: Int, phone: String, email: String, address: AddressInput }

  input DoctorInput { name: String!, qualification: String, phone: String, clinic: String, active: Boolean = true }

  input BookingTestInput { testCode: String!, name: String!, pricePaise: Int!, sampleType: String }

  input CreateBookingInput {
    branchId: ID!
    patientId: ID!
    doctorId: ID
    tests: [BookingTestInput!]!
    collectionType: CollectionType = walk_in
    scheduledAt: DateTime
    notes: String
  }

  input ResultInput { parameter: String!, value: String!, unit: String, flag: ResultFlag, range: String }

  input InvoiceItemInput { code: String, name: String!, category: ItemCategory = test, qty: Float = 1, ratePaise: Int!, discountPaise: Int = 0, taxPercent: Float = 0 }
  input PaymentInput { amountPaise: Int!, mode: PaymentMode!, reference: String }

  input IssueInvoiceInput {
    branchId: ID!
    patientId: ID!
    bookingId: ID
    items: [InvoiceItemInput!]!
    billDiscountPaise: Int = 0
    payments: [PaymentInput!]
  }

  input VoucherEntryInput { ledgerId: ID!, debitPaise: Int = 0, creditPaise: Int = 0, invoiceId: ID }
  input PostVoucherInput { branchId: ID!, type: VoucherType!, date: DateTime, narration: String, entries: [VoucherEntryInput!]! }
  input LedgerInput { name: String!, groupId: ID!, openingPaise: Int = 0, gstin: String }

  type CreateBookingResult { booking: Booking!, samples: [Sample!]! }

  type Mutation {
    registerPatient(input: RegisterPatientInput!): Patient!
    updatePatient(id: ID!, input: UpdatePatientInput!): Patient!
    createDoctor(input: DoctorInput!): Doctor!

    createBooking(input: CreateBookingInput!): CreateBookingResult!
    cancelBooking(id: ID!): Booking!
    collectSample(id: ID!): Sample!
    receiveSample(id: ID!): Sample!
    rejectSample(id: ID!, reason: String!): Sample!

    createReport(bookingId: ID!, testCode: String!, testName: String!): Report!
    saveResults(reportId: ID!, results: [ResultInput!]!): Report!
    verifyReport(id: ID!): Report!
    releaseReport(id: ID!): Report!
    amendReport(id: ID!): Report!

    issueInvoice(input: IssueInvoiceInput!): Invoice!
    recordPayment(invoiceId: ID!, payment: PaymentInput!): Invoice!
    refundPayment(invoiceId: ID!, payment: PaymentInput!): Invoice!
    cancelInvoice(id: ID!, reason: String!): Invoice!

    setupChartOfAccounts: [Ledger!]!
    createLedger(input: LedgerInput!): Ledger!
    postVoucher(input: PostVoucherInput!): Voucher!
    cancelVoucher(id: ID!): Voucher!
  }
`;
```

## File: src/mongo/index.ts

```ts
import mongoose, { type ClientSession, type Connection, type ConnectOptions, type Model } from "mongoose";

/** The driver's TransactionOptions, without depending on the "mongodb" package directly. */
type TransactionOptions = NonNullable<Parameters<ClientSession["withTransaction"]>[1]>;
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import type {
  AuditRepo, CounterRepo, CreditNoteRepo, DateQuery, EntryQuery, Filter, InvoiceRepo, LedgerEntryRepo, LedgerRepo, ListOptions, LockableRepo,
  PatientRepo, PeriodLockRepo, PostingHook, Repo, Repositories, UserRepo, VoucherRepo,
} from "../core/ports";
import type { Id } from "../core/types";
import { registerModels, schemas, type ModelName } from "./schemas";

export { schemas, registerModels };

export interface MongoOptions {
  /** An existing connection (mongoose.createConnection). Or pass `uri`. */
  connection?: Connection;
  uri?: string;
  options?: ConnectOptions;
  /**
   * Transactions need a replica set (a single-node replica set is enough). By default
   * repos.transaction() throws on a standalone server rather than silently giving up atomicity.
   * Set true only for throw-away development databases.
   */
  allowNoTransactions?: boolean;
  /** Defaults: snapshot reads, majority writes, primary reads. */
  transactionOptions?: TransactionOptions;
  /** Posting for invoices and payments (e.g. finance-kit's). Default: this package's accounting. */
  posting?: PostingHook;
}

export class TransactionsUnsupportedError extends Error {
  constructor() {
    super(
      "MongoDB transactions need a replica set. Start mongod with --replSet rs0 and run rs.initiate() " +
        "(one node is enough), or pass allowNoTransactions: true for a throw-away dev database.",
    );
    this.name = "TransactionsUnsupportedError";
  }
}

/** _id → id, drop internals. */
function toEntity<T>(doc: any): T {
  if (!doc) return doc;
  const { _id, lockVersion, ...rest } = doc;
  return { id: _id, ...rest } as T;
}

const clean = (o: Record<string, unknown>) => {
  const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(o)) if (v !== undefined && k !== "id") out[k] = v;
  return out;
};

const escapeRegex = (s: string) => s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");

function mapFilter(filter: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const rest = clean(filter);
  return "id" in filter && filter.id !== undefined ? { _id: filter.id, ...rest } : rest;
}

const dateRange = (from?: Date, to?: Date) =>
  from || to ? { date: { ...(from ? { $gte: from } : {}), ...(to ? { $lte: to } : {}) } } : {};

function entryMatch(q: EntryQuery) {
  return {
    orgId: q.orgId,
    ...(q.branchId ? { branchId: q.branchId } : {}),
    ...(q.ledgerId ? { ledgerId: q.ledgerId } : {}),
    ...(q.invoiceId ? { invoiceId: q.invoiceId } : {}),
    ...(q.excludeVoucherTypes?.length ? { voucherType: { $nin: q.excludeVoucherTypes } } : {}),
    ...dateRange(q.from, q.to),
  };
}

const fieldRange = (field: string, from?: Date, to?: Date) =>
  from || to ? { [field]: { ...(from ? { $gte: from } : {}), ...(to ? { $lte: to } : {}) } } : {};

const scoped = (q: DateQuery) => ({ orgId: q.orgId, ...(q.branchId ? { branchId: q.branchId } : {}) });

/** A write inside the transaction takes the document's lock until commit (MongoDB has no SELECT … FOR UPDATE). */
function lockable<T extends { id: Id }>(model: Model<any>, session?: ClientSession): LockableRepo<T> {
  return {
    ...repo<T>(model, session),
    async getForUpdate(id) {
      if (!session) return toEntity<T>(await model.findById(id).lean());
      return toEntity<T>(await model.findOneAndUpdate({ _id: id }, { $inc: { lockVersion: 1 } }, { returnDocument: "after", session, timestamps: false }).lean());
    },
  };
}

function repo<T extends { id: Id }>(model: Model<any>, session?: ClientSession): Repo<T> {
  const s = session ? { session } : {};
  return {
    async create(data) {
      const { id, ...rest } = data as any;
      const [doc] = await model.create([{ ...clean(rest), ...(id ? { _id: id } : {}) }], s);
      return toEntity<T>(doc.toObject());
    },
    async get(id) {
      return toEntity<T>(await model.findById(id, null, s).lean());
    },
    async getMany(ids) {
      if (!ids.length) return [];
      return (await model.find({ _id: { $in: [...ids] } }, null, s).lean()).map((d: any) => toEntity<T>(d));
    },
    async update(id, patch) {
      return toEntity<T>(await model.findByIdAndUpdate(id, { $set: clean(patch as any) }, { new: true, runValidators: true, ...s }).lean());
    },
    async delete(id) {
      return (await model.deleteOne({ _id: id }, s)).deletedCount === 1;
    },
    async find(filter: Filter<T> = {}, o: ListOptions<T> = {}) {
      const q = model.find(mapFilter(filter), null, s).lean();
      if (o.sort) q.sort({ [o.sort.field === "id" ? "_id" : o.sort.field]: o.sort.dir === "desc" ? -1 : 1 });
      if (o.offset) q.skip(o.offset);
      if (o.limit) q.limit(o.limit);
      return (await q).map((d: any) => toEntity<T>(d));
    },
    async findOne(filter) {
      return toEntity<T>(await model.findOne(mapFilter(filter), null, s).lean());
    },
    async count(filter = {}) {
      return model.countDocuments(mapFilter(filter), s);
    },
  };
}

export async function createMongoRepositories(opts: MongoOptions): Promise<Repositories> {
  const connection = opts.connection ?? (await mongoose.createConnection(opts.uri!, opts.options).asPromise());
  const owned = !opts.connection;
  const models = registerModels(connection);
  const txOptions: TransactionOptions = {
    readConcern: { level: "snapshot" },
    writeConcern: { w: "majority" },
    readPreference: "primary",
    ...opts.transactionOptions,
  };
  let supportsTx: boolean | undefined;

  async function transactionsSupported() {
    if (supportsTx === undefined) {
      const hello = await connection.db!.admin().command({ hello: 1 });
      supportsTx = Boolean(hello.setName || hello.msg === "isdbgrid");
    }
    return supportsTx;
  }

  function build(session?: ClientSession): Repositories {
    const s = session ? { session } : {};
    const users: UserRepo = {
      ...repo(models.User, session),
      findByEmail: async (orgId, email) => toEntity(await models.User.findOne({ orgId, email: email.trim().toLowerCase() }, null, s).lean()),
      findAllByEmail: async (email) => (await models.User.find({ email: email.trim().toLowerCase() }, null, s).lean()).map((d) => toEntity(d)),
    };
    const patients: PatientRepo = {
      ...repo(models.Patient, session),
      async search(orgId, query, limit = 20) {
        const q = query.trim();
        if (!q) return [];
        const re = new RegExp(escapeRegex(q), "i");
        const docs = await models.Patient.find({ orgId, $or: [{ name: re }, { phone: re }, { uhid: re }] }, null, s).sort({ updatedAt: -1 }).limit(limit).lean();
        return docs.map((d) => toEntity(d));
      },
    };
    const invoices: InvoiceRepo = {
      ...lockable(models.Invoice, session),
      async listOutstanding(orgId, branchId) {
        const docs = await models.Invoice.find({ orgId, ...(branchId ? { branchId } : {}), status: { $in: ["issued", "partially_paid"] }, duePaise: { $gt: 0 } }, null, s).sort({ issuedAt: 1 }).lean();
        return docs.map((d) => toEntity(d));
      },
      async listByDate(q) {
        const docs = await models.Invoice.find({
          ...scoped(q), ...(q.customerId ? { customerId: q.customerId } : {}), ...fieldRange("issuedAt", q.from, q.to),
          status: q.includeCancelled ? { $ne: "draft" } : { $nin: ["draft", "cancelled"] },
        }, null, s).sort({ issuedAt: 1, invoiceNo: 1 }).lean();
        return docs.map((d) => toEntity(d));
      },
    };
    const creditNotes: CreditNoteRepo = {
      ...repo(models.CreditNote, session),
      async listByDate(q) {
        const docs = await models.CreditNote.find({ ...scoped(q), ...fieldRange("date", q.from, q.to), ...(q.includeCancelled ? {} : { status: "issued" }) }, null, s)
          .sort({ date: 1, noteNo: 1 }).lean();
        return docs.map((d) => toEntity(d));
      },
    };
    const periodLocks: PeriodLockRepo = {
      ...repo(models.PeriodLock, session),
      async hold(orgId, scopes) {
        // Both modes write the lock document: in MongoDB only a write makes a concurrent writer conflict.
        const out = [];
        for (const scope of [...new Set(scopes)].sort()) {
          const now = new Date();
          const doc = await models.PeriodLock.findOneAndUpdate(
            { orgId, scope },
            { $inc: { lockVersion: 1 }, $setOnInsert: { _id: randomUUID(), branchId: scope === "org" ? null : scope, lockedUpTo: null, updatedBy: null, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now } },
            { upsert: true, returnDocument: "after", timestamps: false, ...s },
          ).lean();
          out.push(toEntity<any>(doc));
        }
        return out;
      },
    };
    const audit: AuditRepo = {
      async log(entry) {
        const [doc] = await models.AuditEntry.create([clean(entry as any)], s);
        return toEntity(doc.toObject());
      },
      find: repo<any>(models.AuditEntry, session).find,
    };
    const counters: CounterRepo = {
      async next(key) {
        const doc: any = await models.Counter.findOneAndUpdate({ _id: key }, { $inc: { seq: 1 } }, { upsert: true, new: true, ...s }).lean();
        return doc.seq;
      },
      async peek(key) {
        const doc: any = await models.Counter.findById(key, null, s).lean();
        return doc?.seq ?? 0;
      },
    };
    const ledgers: LedgerRepo = {
      ...repo(models.Ledger, session),
      findBySystemKey: async (orgId, key) => toEntity(await models.Ledger.findOne({ orgId, systemKey: key }, null, s).lean()),
    };
    const vouchers: VoucherRepo = {
      ...repo(models.Voucher, session),
      async listByDate(q, o = {}) {
        const query = models.Voucher.find({
          orgId: q.orgId, ...(q.branchId ? { branchId: q.branchId } : {}), ...(q.type ? { type: q.type } : {}),
          ...(q.includeCancelled ? {} : { status: "posted" }), ...dateRange(q.from, q.to),
        }, null, s).sort({ date: 1, voucherNo: 1 }).lean();
        if (o.offset) query.skip(o.offset);
        if (o.limit) query.limit(o.limit);
        return (await query).map((d) => toEntity(d));
      },
    };
    const ledgerEntries: LedgerEntryRepo = {
      async insertMany(entries) {
        await models.LedgerEntry.insertMany(entries.map((e) => clean(e as any)), s);
      },
      async deleteByVoucher(voucherId) {
        return (await models.LedgerEntry.deleteMany({ voucherId }, s)).deletedCount;
      },
      async list(q, o = {}) {
        const query = models.LedgerEntry.find(entryMatch(q), null, s).sort({ date: 1, voucherNo: 1, _id: 1 }).lean();
        if (o.offset) query.skip(o.offset);
        if (o.limit) query.limit(o.limit);
        return (await query).map((d) => toEntity(d));
      },
      async totals(q) {
        const rows = await models.LedgerEntry.aggregate([
          { $match: entryMatch(q) },
          { $group: { _id: "$ledgerId", debitPaise: { $sum: "$debitPaise" }, creditPaise: { $sum: "$creditPaise" } } },
        ]).session(session ?? null);
        return rows.map((r: any) => ({ ledgerId: r._id, debitPaise: r.debitPaise, creditPaise: r.creditPaise }));
      },
    };

    const self: Repositories = {
      backend: "mongo",
      orgs: repo(models.Organization, session),
      branches: repo(models.Branch, session),
      users,
      roles: repo(models.Role, session),
      patients,
      doctors: repo(models.Doctor, session),
      bookings: repo(models.Booking, session),
      samples: repo(models.Sample, session),
      reports: repo(models.Report, session),
      invoices,
      payments: repo(models.Payment, session),
      audit,
      counters,
      accountGroups: repo(models.AccountGroup, session),
      ledgers,
      vouchers,
      ledgerEntries,
      taxRules: repo(models.TaxRule, session),
      customers: lockable(models.Customer, session),
      partners: repo(models.Partner, session),
      partnerAgreements: repo(models.PartnerAgreement, session),
      settlements: lockable(models.Settlement, session),
      cashClosings: repo(models.CashClosing, session),
      bankStatements: repo(models.BankStatement, session),
      bankLines: repo(models.BankLine, session),
      periodLocks,
      creditNotes,
      posting: opts.posting,
      async transaction(fn) {
        if (session) return fn(self); // already inside one: join it
        if (!(await transactionsSupported())) {
          if (opts.allowNoTransactions) return fn(self);
          throw new TransactionsUnsupportedError();
        }
        const sess = await connection.startSession();
        try {
          let result: any;
          // withTransaction retries on TransientTransactionError / UnknownTransactionCommitResult
          await sess.withTransaction(async () => {
            result = await fn(build(sess));
          }, txOptions);
          return result;
        } finally {
          await sess.endSession();
        }
      },
      async sync() {
        // collections must exist before they are used inside a transaction
        for (const name of Object.keys(schemas) as ModelName[]) await models[name].syncIndexes();
      },
      async close() {
        if (owned) await connection.close();
      },
    };
    return self;
  }

  return build();
}
```
