## File: src/mongo/schemas.ts

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { Schema, type Connection, type Model } from "mongoose";

/**
 * Mongoose schemas. Ids are UUID strings (same as PostgreSQL), stored in _id and exposed as `id`.
 * Every query the repositories run is backed by an index declared here.
 */

const uuid = { type: String, default: () => randomUUID() };
const opts = { versionKey: false, timestamps: true } as const;
const sub = { _id: false } as const;

const Address = new Schema({ line1: String, line2: String, city: String, district: String, state: String, pincode: String }, sub);
const RoleAssignment = new Schema({ role: { type: String, required: true }, branchId: { type: String, default: null } }, sub);
const BookingTest = new Schema({ testCode: { type: String, required: true }, name: { type: String, required: true }, pricePaise: { type: Number, required: true, min: 0 }, sampleType: String }, sub);
const ResultValue = new Schema({ parameter: { type: String, required: true }, value: { type: String, default: "" }, unit: String, flag: { type: String, enum: ["L", "H", "A", ""] }, range: String }, sub);
const TAXABILITY = ["taxable", "exempt", "nil_rated", "non_gst"];
const CATEGORIES = ["test", "package", "service", "consumable", "medicine", "other"];
const InvoiceItem = new Schema(
  {
    code: String,
    name: { type: String, required: true },
    category: { type: String, enum: CATEGORIES, default: "test" },
    qty: { type: Number, required: true, min: 0 },
    ratePaise: { type: Number, required: true, min: 0 },
    discountPaise: { type: Number, default: 0, min: 0 },
    taxPercent: { type: Number, default: 0, min: 0, max: 100 },
    hsnSac: String,
    taxability: { type: String, enum: TAXABILITY },
    amountPaise: { type: Number, required: true },
  },
  sub,
);

export const schemas = {
  Organization: new Schema(
    { _id: uuid, name: { type: String, required: true }, legalName: String, gstin: String, phone: String, email: String, address: Address, code: { type: String, required: true, unique: true, uppercase: true, trim: true }, settings: { type: Schema.Types.Mixed, default: {} } },
    opts,
  ),

  Branch: new Schema(
    { _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, code: { type: String, required: true, uppercase: true, trim: true }, name: { type: String, required: true }, kind: { type: String, enum: ["lab", "collection_center"], default: "lab" }, phone: String, gstin: String, stateCode: String, address: Address, active: { type: Boolean, default: true } },
    opts,
  ).index({ orgId: 1, code: 1 }, { unique: true }),

  User: new Schema(
    { _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, name: { type: String, required: true }, email: { type: String, required: true, lowercase: true, trim: true }, phone: String, passwordHash: { type: String, required: true }, status: { type: String, enum: ["active", "disabled", "invited"], default: "active" }, roles: { type: [RoleAssignment], default: [] }, lastLoginAt: { type: Date, default: null } },
    opts,
  ).index({ orgId: 1, email: 1 }, { unique: true }).index({ email: 1 }),

  Role: new Schema(
    { _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, key: { type: String, required: true }, name: { type: String, required: true }, permissions: { type: [String], default: [] }, system: { type: Boolean, default: false } },
    opts,
  ).index({ orgId: 1, key: 1 }, { unique: true }),

  Patient: new Schema(
    { _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, branchId: { type: String, required: true }, uhid: { type: String, required: true }, title: String, name: { type: String, required: true, trim: true }, sex: { type: String, enum: ["male", "female", "other"], required: true }, dob: { type: Date, default: null }, ageYears: { type: Number, default: null }, phone: String, email: String, address: Address },
    opts,
  ).index({ orgId: 1, uhid: 1 }, { unique: true }).index({ orgId: 1, phone: 1 }).index({ orgId: 1, name: 1 }),

  Doctor: new Schema(
    { _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, name: { type: String, required: true }, qualification: String, phone: String, clinic: String, active: { type: Boolean, default: true } },
    opts,
  ).index({ orgId: 1, name: 1 }),

  Booking: new Schema(
    {
      _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, branchId: { type: String, required: true }, bookingNo: { type: String, required: true },
      patientId: { type: String, required: true }, doctorId: { type: String, default: null }, tests: { type: [BookingTest], default: [] },
      sampleCollection: { type: new Schema({ type: { type: String, enum: ["walk_in", "home"], default: "walk_in" }, scheduledAt: { type: Date, default: null }, address: Address }, sub), default: () => ({ type: "walk_in" }) },
      status: { type: String, enum: ["booked", "sample_collected", "in_process", "completed", "cancelled"], default: "booked" },
      invoiceId: { type: String, default: null }, createdBy: { type: String, default: null }, notes: String,
    },
    opts,
  ).index({ orgId: 1, bookingNo: 1 }, { unique: true }).index({ branchId: 1, createdAt: -1 }).index({ patientId: 1 }).index({ orgId: 1, status: 1 }),

  Sample: new Schema(
    { _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, branchId: { type: String, required: true }, bookingId: { type: String, required: true }, barcode: { type: String, required: true }, sampleType: { type: String, required: true }, status: { type: String, enum: ["pending", "collected", "received", "rejected"], default: "pending" }, collectedAt: { type: Date, default: null }, collectedBy: { type: String, default: null }, receivedAt: { type: Date, default: null }, rejectReason: { type: String, default: null } },
    opts,
  ).index({ orgId: 1, barcode: 1 }, { unique: true }).index({ bookingId: 1 }),

  Report: new Schema(
    { _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, branchId: { type: String, required: true }, bookingId: { type: String, required: true }, patientId: { type: String, required: true }, testCode: { type: String, required: true }, testName: { type: String, required: true }, results: { type: [ResultValue], default: [] }, status: { type: String, enum: ["draft", "entered", "verified", "released", "amended"], default: "draft" }, enteredBy: { type: String, default: null }, verifiedBy: { type: String, default: null }, verifiedAt: { type: Date, default: null }, releasedAt: { type: Date, default: null }, version: { type: Number, default: 1 } },
    opts,
  ).index({ bookingId: 1 }).index({ patientId: 1, createdAt: -1 }).index({ orgId: 1, status: 1 }),

  Invoice: new Schema(
    {
      _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, branchId: { type: String, required: true }, invoiceNo: { type: String, required: true },
      patientId: { type: String, required: true }, bookingId: { type: String, default: null },
      customerId: { type: String, default: null }, placeOfSupply: { type: String, default: null }, buyerGstin: { type: String, default: null },
      items: { type: [InvoiceItem], default: [] },
      subtotalPaise: { type: Number, required: true }, discountPaise: { type: Number, default: 0 }, taxPaise: { type: Number, default: 0 },
      roundOffPaise: { type: Number, default: 0 }, totalPaise: { type: Number, required: true }, paidPaise: { type: Number, default: 0 },
      creditedPaise: { type: Number, default: 0 }, duePaise: { type: Number, required: true },
      status: { type: String, enum: ["draft", "issued", "partially_paid", "paid", "cancelled", "refunded", "credited"], default: "issued" },
      issuedAt: { type: Date, default: null }, createdBy: { type: String, default: null }, cancelReason: { type: String, default: null },
      /** bumped by getForUpdate to take the document's write lock inside a transaction */
      lockVersion: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    },
    opts,
  ).index({ orgId: 1, invoiceNo: 1 }, { unique: true }).index({ patientId: 1 }).index({ branchId: 1, issuedAt: -1 }).index({ orgId: 1, status: 1 })
    .index({ orgId: 1, issuedAt: 1 }).index({ customerId: 1, issuedAt: 1 }),

  Payment: new Schema(
    { _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, branchId: { type: String, required: true }, invoiceId: { type: String, required: true }, kind: { type: String, enum: ["payment", "refund"], default: "payment" }, amountPaise: { type: Number, required: true, min: 1 }, mode: { type: String, enum: ["cash", "upi", "card", "netbanking", "wallet", "cheque", "insurance"], required: true }, reference: String, receivedBy: { type: String, default: null }, receivedAt: { type: Date, default: () => new Date() } },
    opts,
  ).index({ invoiceId: 1 }).index({ branchId: 1, receivedAt: -1 }),

  AuditEntry: new Schema(
    { _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, branchId: { type: String, default: null }, userId: { type: String, default: null }, action: { type: String, required: true }, entity: String, entityId: { type: String, default: null }, ip: String, data: Schema.Types.Mixed, at: { type: Date, default: () => new Date() } },
    { versionKey: false },
  ).index({ orgId: 1, at: -1 }).index({ entity: 1, entityId: 1 }),

  // ---- accounting (Tally-style)
  AccountGroup: new Schema(
    { _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, name: { type: String, required: true }, parentId: { type: String, default: null }, nature: { type: String, enum: ["assets", "liabilities", "income", "expenses"], required: true }, affectsGrossProfit: { type: Boolean, default: false }, system: { type: Boolean, default: false } },
    opts,
  ).index({ orgId: 1, name: 1 }, { unique: true }),

  Ledger: new Schema(
    { _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, name: { type: String, required: true }, groupId: { type: String, required: true }, openingPaise: { type: Number, default: 0 }, systemKey: { type: String, default: null }, gstin: String, active: { type: Boolean, default: true } },
    opts,
  )
    .index({ orgId: 1, name: 1 }, { unique: true })
    // MongoDB counts null as a value in unique indexes, so only real keys are constrained
    .index({ orgId: 1, systemKey: 1 }, { unique: true, partialFilterExpression: { systemKey: { $type: "string" } } }),

  Voucher: new Schema(
    {
      _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, branchId: { type: String, required: true },
      type: { type: String, enum: ["sales", "receipt", "payment", "journal", "contra", "credit_note", "debit_note", "purchase", "closing"], required: true },
      voucherNo: { type: String, required: true }, date: { type: Date, required: true }, narration: String,
      entries: { type: [new Schema({ ledgerId: { type: String, required: true }, debitPaise: { type: Number, default: 0, min: 0 }, creditPaise: { type: Number, default: 0, min: 0 }, invoiceId: { type: String, default: null } }, sub)], default: [] },
      invoiceId: { type: String, default: null }, paymentId: { type: String, default: null },
      status: { type: String, enum: ["posted", "cancelled"], default: "posted" }, createdBy: { type: String, default: null },
    },
    opts,
  ).index({ orgId: 1, voucherNo: 1 }, { unique: true }).index({ orgId: 1, date: 1 }).index({ invoiceId: 1 }),

  LedgerEntry: new Schema(
    {
      _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, branchId: { type: String, required: true }, voucherId: { type: String, required: true },
      voucherType: { type: String, required: true }, voucherNo: { type: String, required: true }, ledgerId: { type: String, required: true },
      date: { type: Date, required: true }, debitPaise: { type: Number, default: 0, min: 0 }, creditPaise: { type: Number, default: 0, min: 0 },
      invoiceId: { type: String, default: null },
    },
    { versionKey: false },
  ).index({ orgId: 1, ledgerId: 1, date: 1 }).index({ orgId: 1, date: 1 }).index({ voucherId: 1 }).index({ invoiceId: 1 }),

  Counter: new Schema({ _id: String, seq: { type: Number, default: 0 } }, { versionKey: false }),

  // ---- finance (used by @mgpl-diagnostics/finance-kit)
  TaxRule: new Schema(
    {
      _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, code: { type: String, default: null }, category: { type: String, enum: [...CATEGORIES, null], default: null },
      hsnSac: { type: String, required: true }, taxability: { type: String, enum: TAXABILITY, required: true }, ratePercent: { type: Number, default: 0, min: 0, max: 100 },
      effectiveFrom: { type: Date, required: true }, effectiveTo: { type: Date, default: null }, note: String,
    },
    opts,
  ).index({ orgId: 1, code: 1 }).index({ orgId: 1, category: 1 }),

  Customer: new Schema(
    {
      _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, code: { type: String, required: true }, name: { type: String, required: true },
      kind: { type: String, enum: ["hospital", "insurer", "tpa", "corporate", "other"], default: "other" }, legalName: String, gstin: String, stateCode: String, pan: String,
      phone: String, email: String, address: Address, creditLimitPaise: { type: Number, default: null }, creditDays: { type: Number, default: 0, min: 0 },
      ledgerId: { type: String, required: true }, active: { type: Boolean, default: true }, lockVersion: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    },
    opts,
  ).index({ orgId: 1, code: 1 }, { unique: true }).index({ orgId: 1, name: 1 }),

  Partner: new Schema(
    {
      _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, code: { type: String, required: true }, name: { type: String, required: true },
      kind: { type: String, enum: ["collection_centre", "franchise"], default: "collection_centre" }, branchId: { type: String, required: true }, legalName: String,
      pan: String, gstin: String, stateCode: String, phone: String, email: String, address: Address, ledgerId: { type: String, required: true },
      tds: { type: new Schema({ section: { type: String, required: true }, rateBp: { type: Number, required: true, min: 0, max: 10000 } }, sub), default: null },
      active: { type: Boolean, default: true },
    },
    opts,
  ).index({ orgId: 1, code: 1 }, { unique: true }).index({ branchId: 1 }),

  PartnerAgreement: new Schema(
    {
      _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, partnerId: { type: String, required: true }, kind: { type: String, enum: ["revenue_share", "fixed_rate"], required: true },
      shareBp: { type: Number, default: null, min: 0, max: 10000 },
      rates: { type: [new Schema({ code: { type: String, required: true }, sharePaise: { type: Number, required: true, min: 0 } }, sub)], default: [] },
      defaultSharePaise: { type: Number, default: null }, categories: { type: [{ type: String, enum: CATEGORIES }], default: undefined },
      effectiveFrom: { type: Date, required: true }, effectiveTo: { type: Date, default: null }, notes: String,
    },
    opts,
  ).index({ partnerId: 1, effectiveFrom: 1 }),

  Settlement: new Schema(
    {
      _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, branchId: { type: String, required: true }, partnerId: { type: String, required: true },
      period: { type: String, required: true }, periodKey: { type: String, default: null }, from: { type: Date, required: true }, to: { type: Date, required: true },
      lines: {
        type: [new Schema({
          invoiceId: { type: String, required: true }, invoiceNo: { type: String, required: true }, day: { type: String, required: true }, code: String, name: { type: String, required: true },
          netPaise: { type: Number, required: true }, sharePaise: { type: Number, required: true }, agreementId: { type: String, required: true }, creditNoteId: { type: String, default: null },
        }, sub)],
        default: [],
      },
      grossPaise: { type: Number, default: 0 }, sharePaise: { type: Number, default: 0 },
      deductions: { type: [new Schema({ label: { type: String, required: true }, amountPaise: { type: Number, required: true, min: 0 }, ledgerId: { type: String, default: null } }, sub)], default: [] },
      deductionsPaise: { type: Number, default: 0 }, tdsSection: { type: String, default: null }, tdsRateBp: { type: Number, default: 0 }, tdsBasePaise: { type: Number, default: 0 },
      tdsPaise: { type: Number, default: 0 }, netPaise: { type: Number, default: 0 },
      status: { type: String, enum: ["draft", "accrued", "paid", "cancelled"], default: "draft" },
      accrualVoucherId: { type: String, default: null }, payoutVoucherId: { type: String, default: null }, paidAt: { type: Date, default: null },
      createdBy: { type: String, default: null }, lockVersion: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    },
    opts,
  )
    .index({ orgId: 1, periodKey: 1 }, { unique: true, partialFilterExpression: { periodKey: { $type: "string" } } })
    .index({ partnerId: 1, period: 1 }),

  CashClosing: new Schema(
    {
      _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, branchId: { type: String, required: true }, day: { type: String, required: true },
      bookPaise: { type: Number, required: true }, countedPaise: { type: Number, required: true, min: 0 }, differencePaise: { type: Number, required: true },
      denominations: { type: [new Schema({ valuePaise: { type: Number, required: true, min: 1 }, count: { type: Number, required: true, min: 0 } }, sub)], default: undefined },
      voucherId: { type: String, default: null }, closedBy: { type: String, default: null }, notes: String,
    },
    opts,
  ).index({ orgId: 1, branchId: 1, day: 1 }, { unique: true }),

  BankStatement: new Schema(
    {
      _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, branchId: { type: String, required: true }, ledgerId: { type: String, required: true }, fileName: String,
      from: { type: Date, default: null }, to: { type: Date, default: null }, openingPaise: { type: Number, default: null }, closingPaise: { type: Number, default: null },
      lineCount: { type: Number, default: 0 }, importedBy: { type: String, default: null },
    },
    opts,
  ).index({ orgId: 1, ledgerId: 1 }),

  BankLine: new Schema(
    {
      _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, statementId: { type: String, required: true }, ledgerId: { type: String, required: true },
      date: { type: Date, required: true }, description: { type: String, default: "" }, reference: String,
      debitPaise: { type: Number, default: 0, min: 0 }, creditPaise: { type: Number, default: 0, min: 0 }, balancePaise: { type: Number, default: null },
      dedupKey: { type: String, required: true }, status: { type: String, enum: ["unmatched", "matched", "ignored"], default: "unmatched" },
      matchKind: { type: String, enum: ["entry", "settlement", "manual", null], default: null }, voucherIds: { type: [String], default: [] },
      settlement: { type: new Schema({ ledgerId: { type: String, required: true }, day: { type: String, required: true }, grossPaise: { type: Number, required: true }, feePaise: { type: Number, required: true } }, sub), default: null },
      matchedBy: { type: String, default: null }, matchedAt: { type: Date, default: null },
    },
    opts,
  ).index({ orgId: 1, dedupKey: 1 }, { unique: true }).index({ statementId: 1, date: 1 }).index({ orgId: 1, ledgerId: 1, status: 1 }),

  PeriodLock: new Schema(
    {
      _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, scope: { type: String, required: true }, branchId: { type: String, default: null },
      lockedUpTo: { type: Date, default: null }, reason: String, updatedBy: { type: String, default: null },
      /** bumped by hold() so concurrent lock changes and postings conflict inside transactions */
      lockVersion: { type: Number, default: 0 },
    },
    opts,
  ).index({ orgId: 1, scope: 1 }, { unique: true }),

  CreditNote: new Schema(
    {
      _id: uuid, orgId: { type: String, required: true }, branchId: { type: String, required: true }, invoiceId: { type: String, required: true },
      customerId: { type: String, default: null }, noteNo: { type: String, required: true }, date: { type: Date, required: true }, reason: { type: String, required: true },
      lines: {
        type: [new Schema({
          itemIndex: { type: Number, required: true, min: 0 }, name: { type: String, required: true }, code: String, hsnSac: String, taxability: { type: String, enum: TAXABILITY },
          taxPercent: { type: Number, default: 0 }, taxablePaise: { type: Number, required: true }, taxPaise: { type: Number, default: 0 },
          cgstPaise: { type: Number, default: 0 }, sgstPaise: { type: Number, default: 0 }, igstPaise: { type: Number, default: 0 },
        }, sub)],
        default: [],
      },
      taxablePaise: { type: Number, default: 0 }, taxPaise: { type: Number, default: 0 }, cgstPaise: { type: Number, default: 0 }, sgstPaise: { type: Number, default: 0 },
      igstPaise: { type: Number, default: 0 }, roundOffPaise: { type: Number, default: 0 }, totalPaise: { type: Number, required: true },
      placeOfSupply: { type: String, default: null }, buyerGstin: { type: String, default: null }, voucherId: { type: String, default: null },
      status: { type: String, enum: ["issued", "cancelled"], default: "issued" }, createdBy: { type: String, default: null },
    },
    opts,
  ).index({ orgId: 1, noteNo: 1 }, { unique: true }).index({ invoiceId: 1 }).index({ orgId: 1, date: 1 }),
};

export type ModelName = keyof typeof schemas;

/** Registers the models on a connection (idempotent). Collection names: organizations, branches, … */
export function registerModels(connection: Connection): Record<ModelName, Model<any>> {
  const out = {} as Record<ModelName, Model<any>>;
  for (const name of Object.keys(schemas) as ModelName[]) out[name] = connection.models[name] ?? connection.model(name, schemas[name]);
  return out;
}
```


---

## File: src/pg/index.ts

```ts
import { Op, QueryTypes, Sequelize, Transaction, type Model, type ModelStatic, type Options } from "sequelize";
import type {
  AuditRepo, CounterRepo, CreditNoteRepo, DateQuery, EntryQuery, Filter, InvoiceRepo, LedgerEntryRepo, LedgerRepo, ListOptions, LockableRepo,
  PatientRepo, PeriodLockRepo, PostingHook, Repo, Repositories, UserRepo, VoucherRepo,
} from "../core/ports";
import type { Id } from "../core/types";
import { defineModels, definitions } from "./models";

export { defineModels, definitions };

export interface PgOptions {
  /** An existing Sequelize instance (dialect "postgres"). Or pass `url`. */
  sequelize?: Sequelize;
  /** postgres://user:pass@host:5432/db */
  url?: string;
  options?: Options;
  /** Default READ COMMITTED; money paths also take row locks (SELECT … FOR UPDATE). */
  isolationLevel?: Transaction.ISOLATION_LEVELS;
  /** Retries after a deadlock or serialization failure (SQLSTATE 40P01 / 40001). Default 3. */
  retries?: number;
  /** Posting for invoices and payments (e.g. finance-kit's). Default: this package's accounting. */
  posting?: PostingHook;
}

const RETRYABLE = new Set(["40001", "40P01"]);
const sqlState = (e: any): string | undefined => e?.parent?.code ?? e?.original?.code ?? e?.code;

function dateWhere(from?: Date, to?: Date, field = "date") {
  if (!from && !to) return {};
  return { [field]: { ...(from ? { [Op.gte]: from } : {}), ...(to ? { [Op.lte]: to } : {}) } };
}

const scoped = (q: DateQuery) => ({ orgId: q.orgId, ...(q.branchId ? { branchId: q.branchId } : {}) });

const clean = (o: Record<string, unknown>) => {
  const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(o)) if (v !== undefined) out[k] = v;
  return out;
};

/** Attributes whose "no value" is an explicit null (kept); other nulls are dropped, like MongoDB. */
const keepNull = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
for (const [name, d] of Object.entries(definitions)) {
  keepNull.set(name, new Set(Object.entries(d.attributes).filter(([, a]: any) => a && a.defaultValue === null).map(([k]) => k)));
}

function toEntity<T>(row: Model | null, name: string): T | null {
  if (!row) return null;
  const plain = row.get({ plain: true }) as Record<string, unknown>;
  const keep = keepNull.get(name)!;
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(plain)) if (v === null && !keep.has(k)) delete plain[k];
  return plain as T;
}

const escapeLike = (s: string) => s.replace(/[\\%_]/g, (c) => `\\${c}`);

function repo<T extends { id: Id }>(model: ModelStatic<Model>, transaction?: Transaction): Repo<T> {
  const t = transaction ? { transaction } : {};
  const name = model.name;
  return {
    async create(data) {
      return toEntity<T>(await model.create(clean(data as any), t), name)!;
    },
    async get(id) {
      return toEntity<T>(await model.findByPk(id, t), name);
    },
    async getMany(ids) {
      if (!ids.length) return [];
      return (await model.findAll({ where: { id: [...ids] }, ...t })).map((r) => toEntity<T>(r, name)!);
    },
    async update(id, patch) {
      const [, rows] = await model.update(clean(patch as any), { where: { id }, returning: true, ...t });
      return toEntity<T>(rows[0] ?? null, name);
    },
    async delete(id) {
      return (await model.destroy({ where: { id }, ...t })) > 0;
    },
    async find(filter: Filter<T> = {}, o: ListOptions<T> = {}) {
      const rows = await model.findAll({
        where: clean(filter as any),
        order: o.sort ? [[o.sort.field, o.sort.dir === "desc" ? "DESC" : "ASC"]] : undefined,
        limit: o.limit,
        offset: o.offset,
        ...t,
      });
      return rows.map((r) => toEntity<T>(r, name)!);
    },
    async findOne(filter) {
      return toEntity<T>(await model.findOne({ where: clean(filter as any), ...t }), name);
    },
    async count(filter = {}) {
      return model.count({ where: clean(filter as any), ...t });
    },
  };
}

/** SELECT … FOR UPDATE inside a transaction: concurrent writers of the same row wait for each other. */
function lockable<T extends { id: Id }>(model: ModelStatic<Model>, transaction?: Transaction): LockableRepo<T> {
  return {
    ...repo<T>(model, transaction),
    async getForUpdate(id) {
      return toEntity<T>(await model.findByPk(id, transaction ? { transaction, lock: transaction.LOCK.UPDATE } : {}), model.name);
    },
  };
}

export async function createPgRepositories(opts: PgOptions): Promise<Repositories> {
  const sequelize = opts.sequelize ?? new Sequelize(opts.url!, { dialect: "postgres", logging: false, ...opts.options });
  const owned = !opts.sequelize;
  const m = defineModels(sequelize);

  function build(transaction?: Transaction): Repositories {
    const t = transaction ? { transaction } : {};
    const users: UserRepo = {
      ...repo(m.User!, transaction),
      findByEmail: async (orgId, email) => toEntity(await m.User!.findOne({ where: { orgId, email: email.trim().toLowerCase() }, ...t }), "User"),
      findAllByEmail: async (email) => (await m.User!.findAll({ where: { email: email.trim().toLowerCase() }, ...t })).map((r) => toEntity<any>(r, "User")),
    };
    const patients: PatientRepo = {
      ...repo(m.Patient!, transaction),
      async search(orgId, query, limit = 20) {
        const q = query.trim();
        if (!q) return [];
        const like = `%${escapeLike(q)}%`;
        const rows = await m.Patient!.findAll({
          where: { orgId, [Op.or]: [{ name: { [Op.iLike]: like } }, { phone: { [Op.iLike]: like } }, { uhid: { [Op.iLike]: like } }] },
          order: [["updatedAt", "DESC"]],
          limit,
          ...t,
        });
        return rows.map((r) => toEntity<any>(r, "Patient"));
      },
    };
    const invoices: InvoiceRepo = {
      // getForUpdate: concurrent payments on the same invoice wait for each other
      ...lockable(m.Invoice!, transaction),
      async listOutstanding(orgId, branchId) {
        const rows = await m.Invoice!.findAll({
          where: { orgId, ...(branchId ? { branchId } : {}), status: ["issued", "partially_paid"], duePaise: { [Op.gt]: 0 } },
          order: [["issuedAt", "ASC"]],
          ...t,
        });
        return rows.map((r) => toEntity<any>(r, "Invoice"));
      },
      async listByDate(q) {
        const rows = await m.Invoice!.findAll({
          where: {
            ...scoped(q), ...(q.customerId ? { customerId: q.customerId } : {}), ...dateWhere(q.from, q.to, "issuedAt"),
            status: { [Op.notIn]: q.includeCancelled ? ["draft"] : ["draft", "cancelled"] },
          },
          order: [["issuedAt", "ASC"], ["invoiceNo", "ASC"]],
          ...t,
        });
        return rows.map((r) => toEntity<any>(r, "Invoice"));
      },
    };
    const creditNotes: CreditNoteRepo = {
      ...repo(m.CreditNote!, transaction),
      async listByDate(q) {
        const rows = await m.CreditNote!.findAll({
          where: { ...scoped(q), ...dateWhere(q.from, q.to), ...(q.includeCancelled ? {} : { status: "issued" }) },
          order: [["date", "ASC"], ["noteNo", "ASC"]],
          ...t,
        });
        return rows.map((r) => toEntity<any>(r, "CreditNote"));
      },
    };
    const periodLocks: PeriodLockRepo = {
      ...repo(m.PeriodLock!, transaction),
      async hold(orgId, scopes, mode) {
        const keys = [...new Set(scopes)].sort();
        // create missing rows (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING), then lock them in a fixed order
        await m.PeriodLock!.bulkCreate(keys.map((scope) => ({ orgId, scope, branchId: scope === "org" ? null : scope, lockedUpTo: null })), { ignoreDuplicates: true, ...t });
        const rows = await m.PeriodLock!.findAll({
          where: { orgId, scope: keys },
          order: [["scope", "ASC"]],
          ...(transaction ? { transaction, lock: mode === "update" ? transaction.LOCK.UPDATE : transaction.LOCK.SHARE } : {}),
        });
        return rows.map((r) => toEntity<any>(r, "PeriodLock"));
      },
    };
    const ledgers: LedgerRepo = {
      ...repo(m.Ledger!, transaction),
      findBySystemKey: async (orgId, key) => toEntity(await m.Ledger!.findOne({ where: { orgId, systemKey: key }, ...t }), "Ledger"),
    };
    const vouchers: VoucherRepo = {
      ...repo(m.Voucher!, transaction),
      async listByDate(q, o = {}) {
        const rows = await m.Voucher!.findAll({
          where: { orgId: q.orgId, ...(q.branchId ? { branchId: q.branchId } : {}), ...(q.type ? { type: q.type } : {}), ...(q.includeCancelled ? {} : { status: "posted" }), ...dateWhere(q.from, q.to) },
          order: [["date", "ASC"], ["voucherNo", "ASC"]],
          limit: o.limit,
          offset: o.offset,
          ...t,
        });
        return rows.map((r) => toEntity<any>(r, "Voucher"));
      },
    };
    const entryWhere = (q: EntryQuery) => ({
      orgId: q.orgId, ...(q.branchId ? { branchId: q.branchId } : {}), ...(q.ledgerId ? { ledgerId: q.ledgerId } : {}),
      ...(q.invoiceId ? { invoiceId: q.invoiceId } : {}), ...dateWhere(q.from, q.to),
      ...(q.excludeVoucherTypes?.length ? { voucherType: { [Op.notIn]: q.excludeVoucherTypes } } : {}),
    });
    const ledgerEntries: LedgerEntryRepo = {
      async insertMany(entries) {
        await m.LedgerEntry!.bulkCreate(entries.map((e) => clean(e as any)), t);
      },
      async deleteByVoucher(voucherId) {
        return m.LedgerEntry!.destroy({ where: { voucherId }, ...t });
      },
      async list(q, o = {}) {
        const rows = await m.LedgerEntry!.findAll({ where: entryWhere(q), order: [["date", "ASC"], ["voucherNo", "ASC"], ["id", "ASC"]], limit: o.limit, offset: o.offset, ...t });
        return rows.map((r) => toEntity<any>(r, "LedgerEntry"));
      },
      async totals(q) {
        const rows: any[] = await m.LedgerEntry!.findAll({
          attributes: ["ledgerId", [sequelize.fn("SUM", sequelize.col("debit_paise")), "debitPaise"], [sequelize.fn("SUM", sequelize.col("credit_paise")), "creditPaise"]],
          where: entryWhere(q),
          group: ["ledger_id"],
          raw: true,
          ...t,
        });
        // SUM() is NUMERIC in PostgreSQL and arrives as a string
        return rows.map((r) => ({ ledgerId: r.ledgerId, debitPaise: Number(r.debitPaise), creditPaise: Number(r.creditPaise) }));
      },
    };
    const audit: AuditRepo = {
      async log(entry) {
        return toEntity<any>(await m.AuditEntry!.create(clean(entry as any), t), "AuditEntry");
      },
      find: repo<any>(m.AuditEntry!, transaction).find,
    };
    const counters: CounterRepo = {
      async next(key) {
        const rows = await sequelize.query<{ seq: number }>(
          `INSERT INTO counters (key, seq) VALUES (:key, 1)
           ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET seq = counters.seq + 1
           RETURNING seq`,
          { replacements: { key }, type: QueryTypes.SELECT, ...t },
        );
        return Number(rows[0]!.seq);
      },
      async peek(key) {
        const row: any = await m.Counter!.findByPk(key, t);
        return row ? Number(row.seq) : 0;
      },
    };

    const self: Repositories = {
      backend: "pg",
      orgs: repo(m.Organization!, transaction),
      branches: repo(m.Branch!, transaction),
      users,
      roles: repo(m.Role!, transaction),
      patients,
      doctors: repo(m.Doctor!, transaction),
      bookings: repo(m.Booking!, transaction),
      samples: repo(m.Sample!, transaction),
      reports: repo(m.Report!, transaction),
      invoices,
      payments: repo(m.Payment!, transaction),
      audit,
      counters,
      accountGroups: repo(m.AccountGroup!, transaction),
      ledgers,
      vouchers,
      ledgerEntries,
      taxRules: repo(m.TaxRule!, transaction),
      customers: lockable(m.Customer!, transaction),
      partners: repo(m.Partner!, transaction),
      partnerAgreements: repo(m.PartnerAgreement!, transaction),
      settlements: lockable(m.Settlement!, transaction),
      cashClosings: repo(m.CashClosing!, transaction),
      bankStatements: repo(m.BankStatement!, transaction),
      bankLines: repo(m.BankLine!, transaction),
      periodLocks,
      creditNotes,
      posting: opts.posting,
      async transaction(fn) {
        if (transaction) return fn(self); // already inside one: join it
        const attempts = (opts.retries ?? 3) + 1;
        for (let i = 1; ; i++) {
          try {
            return await sequelize.transaction({ isolationLevel: opts.isolationLevel }, (tx) => fn(build(tx)));
          } catch (e) {
            if (i >= attempts || !RETRYABLE.has(sqlState(e) ?? "")) throw e;
            await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 20 * 2 ** i + Math.random() * 20));
          }
        }
      },
      async sync() {
        await sequelize.sync();
        // fast "contains" search on patient names when pg_trgm is available (best effort)
        try {
          await sequelize.query("CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm");
          await sequelize.query("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS patients_name_trgm ON patients USING gin (name gin_trgm_ops)");
        } catch {
          /* extension not permitted: plain btree indexes still apply */
        }
      },
      async close() {
        if (owned) await sequelize.close();
      },
    };
    return self;
  }

  return build();
}
```


---

## File: src/pg/models.ts

```ts
import { DataTypes, type ModelAttributes, type ModelStatic, type Model, type Sequelize } from "sequelize";

/**
 * Sequelize models for PostgreSQL. camelCase attributes, snake_case columns (underscored),
 * UUID primary keys, real foreign keys, JSONB for nested values. Money is INTEGER paise
 * (≤ ₹2.1 crore per row; BIGINT would come back as strings).
 */

const { UUID, UUIDV4, STRING, TEXT, BOOLEAN, INTEGER, DATE, JSONB, ARRAY } = DataTypes;

// Factories, not shared objects: Sequelize mutates each attribute definition it receives (it sets the
// column name on it), so one object reused for several columns makes them all write to one column.
const id = () => ({ type: UUID, defaultValue: UUIDV4, primaryKey: true });
const ref = (table: string, allowNull = false) => ({ type: UUID, allowNull, references: { model: table, key: "id" }, onDelete: "RESTRICT", onUpdate: "CASCADE" });
const oneOf = (...values: string[]) => ({ type: STRING(32), allowNull: false, validate: { isIn: [values] } });
const nullable = (type: any) => ({ type, allowNull: true, defaultValue: null });
const money = () => ({ type: INTEGER, allowNull: false, defaultValue: 0 });

interface Def {
  table: string;
  attributes: ModelAttributes;
  indexes?: { fields: string[]; unique?: boolean; name?: string }[];
  timestamps?: boolean;
}

export const definitions: Record<string, Def> = {
  Organization: {
    table: "organizations",
    attributes: {
      id: id(), name: { type: STRING, allowNull: false }, legalName: STRING, gstin: STRING(15), phone: STRING(20), email: STRING,
      address: JSONB, code: { type: STRING(16), allowNull: false, unique: true }, settings: { type: JSONB, allowNull: false, defaultValue: {} },
    },
  },
  Branch: {
    table: "branches",
    attributes: {
      id: id(), orgId: ref("organizations"), code: { type: STRING(16), allowNull: false }, name: { type: STRING, allowNull: false },
      kind: { ...oneOf("lab", "collection_center"), defaultValue: "lab" }, phone: STRING(20), gstin: STRING(15), stateCode: STRING(2), address: JSONB,
      active: { type: BOOLEAN, allowNull: false, defaultValue: true },
    },
    indexes: [{ fields: ["org_id", "code"], unique: true }],
  },
  User: {
    table: "users",
    attributes: {
      id: id(), orgId: ref("organizations"), name: { type: STRING, allowNull: false }, email: { type: STRING, allowNull: false }, phone: STRING(20),
      passwordHash: { type: STRING, allowNull: false }, status: { ...oneOf("active", "disabled", "invited"), defaultValue: "active" },
      roles: { type: JSONB, allowNull: false, defaultValue: [] }, lastLoginAt: nullable(DATE),
    },
    indexes: [{ fields: ["org_id", "email"], unique: true }, { fields: ["email"] }],
  },
  Role: {
    table: "roles",
    attributes: {
      id: id(), orgId: ref("organizations"), key: { type: STRING(64), allowNull: false }, name: { type: STRING, allowNull: false },
      permissions: { type: ARRAY(TEXT), allowNull: false, defaultValue: [] }, system: { type: BOOLEAN, allowNull: false, defaultValue: false },
    },
    indexes: [{ fields: ["org_id", "key"], unique: true }],
  },
  Patient: {
    table: "patients",
    attributes: {
      id: id(), orgId: ref("organizations"), branchId: ref("branches"), uhid: { type: STRING(32), allowNull: false }, title: STRING(16),
      name: { type: STRING, allowNull: false }, sex: oneOf("male", "female", "other"), dob: nullable(DATE), ageYears: nullable(INTEGER),
      phone: STRING(20), email: STRING, address: JSONB,
    },
    indexes: [{ fields: ["org_id", "uhid"], unique: true }, { fields: ["org_id", "phone"] }, { fields: ["org_id", "name"] }],
  },
  Doctor: {
    table: "doctors",
    attributes: {
      id: id(), orgId: ref("organizations"), name: { type: STRING, allowNull: false }, qualification: STRING, phone: STRING(20), clinic: STRING,
      active: { type: BOOLEAN, allowNull: false, defaultValue: true },
    },
    indexes: [{ fields: ["org_id", "name"] }],
  },
  Booking: {
    table: "bookings",
    attributes: {

      patientId: ref("patients"), doctorId: { ...ref("doctors", true), defaultValue: null }, tests: { type: JSONB, allowNull: false, defaultValue: [] },
      sampleCollection: { type: JSONB, allowNull: false, defaultValue: { type: "walk_in" } },
      status: { ...oneOf("booked", "sample_collected", "in_process", "completed", "cancelled"), defaultValue: "booked" },
      invoiceId: nullable(UUID), createdBy: nullable(UUID), notes: TEXT,
    },
    indexes: [{ fields: ["org_id", "booking_no"], unique: true }, { fields: ["branch_id", "created_at"] }, { fields: ["patient_id"] }, { fields: ["org_id", "status"] }],
  },
  Sample: {
    table: "samples",
    attributes: {
      id: id(), orgId: ref("organizations"), branchId: ref("branches"), bookingId: ref("bookings"), barcode: { type: STRING(32), allowNull: false },
      sampleType: { type: STRING(64), allowNull: false }, status: { ...oneOf("pending", "collected", "received", "rejected"), defaultValue: "pending" },
      collectedAt: nullable(DATE), collectedBy: nullable(UUID), receivedAt: nullable(DATE), rejectReason: nullable(TEXT),

      status: { ...oneOf("draft", "entered", "verified", "released", "amended"), defaultValue: "draft" },
      enteredBy: nullable(UUID), verifiedBy: nullable(UUID), verifiedAt: nullable(DATE), releasedAt: nullable(DATE),
      version: { type: INTEGER, allowNull: false, defaultValue: 1 },
    },
    indexes: [{ fields: ["booking_id"] }, { fields: ["patient_id", "created_at"] }, { fields: ["org_id", "status"] }],
  },
  Customer: {
    table: "customers",
    attributes: {

      kind: { ...oneOf("hospital", "insurer", "tpa", "corporate", "other"), defaultValue: "other" }, legalName: STRING, gstin: STRING(15), stateCode: STRING(2),
      pan: STRING(10), phone: STRING(20), email: STRING, address: JSONB, creditLimitPaise: { type: INTEGER, allowNull: true, defaultValue: null },
      creditDays: { type: INTEGER, allowNull: false, defaultValue: 0, validate: { min: 0 } }, ledgerId: ref("ledgers"),
      active: { type: BOOLEAN, allowNull: false, defaultValue: true },
    },
    indexes: [{ fields: ["org_id", "code"], unique: true }, { fields: ["org_id", "name"] }],
  },
  Invoice: {
    table: "invoices",
    attributes: {
      id: id(), orgId: ref("organizations"), branchId: ref("branches"), invoiceNo: { type: STRING(48), allowNull: false },
      patientId: ref("patients"), bookingId: { ...ref("bookings", true), defaultValue: null },
      customerId: { ...ref("customers", true), defaultValue: null }, placeOfSupply: nullable(STRING(2)), buyerGstin: nullable(STRING(15)),
      items: { type: JSONB, allowNull: false, defaultValue: [] },
      subtotalPaise: money(), discountPaise: money(), taxPaise: money(), roundOffPaise: money(), totalPaise: money(), paidPaise: money(), creditedPaise: money(), duePaise: money(),
      status: { ...oneOf("draft", "issued", "partially_paid", "paid", "cancelled", "refunded", "credited"), defaultValue: "issued" },
      issuedAt: nullable(DATE), createdBy: nullable(UUID), cancelReason: nullable(TEXT),
    },
    indexes: [
      { fields: ["org_id", "invoice_no"], unique: true }, { fields: ["patient_id"] }, { fields: ["branch_id", "issued_at"] }, { fields: ["org_id", "status"] },
      { fields: ["org_id", "issued_at"] }, { fields: ["customer_id", "issued_at"] },
    ],
  },
  Payment: {
    table: "payments",
    attributes: {
      id: id(), orgId: ref("organizations"), branchId: ref("branches"), invoiceId: ref("invoices"),
      kind: { ...oneOf("payment", "refund"), defaultValue: "payment" }, amountPaise: { type: INTEGER, allowNull: false, validate: { min: 1 } },
      mode: oneOf("cash", "upi", "card", "netbanking", "wallet", "cheque", "insurance"), reference: STRING,
      receivedBy: nullable(UUID), receivedAt: { type: DATE, allowNull: false, defaultValue: DataTypes.NOW },
    },
    indexes: [{ fields: ["invoice_id"] }, { fields: ["branch_id", "received_at"] }],
  },
  AuditEntry: {
    table: "audit_log",
    timestamps: false,
    attributes: {
      id: id(), orgId: ref("organizations"), branchId: nullable(UUID), userId: nullable(UUID), action: { type: STRING(64), allowNull: false },
      entity: STRING(32), entityId: nullable(UUID), ip: STRING(64), data: JSONB, at: { type: DATE, allowNull: false, defaultValue: DataTypes.NOW },
    },
    indexes: [{ fields: ["org_id", "at"] }, { fields: ["entity", "entity_id"] }],
  },
  // ---- accounting (Tally-style)
  AccountGroup: {
    table: "account_groups",
    attributes: {
      id: id(), orgId: ref("organizations"), name: { type: STRING, allowNull: false }, parentId: { ...ref("account_groups", true), defaultValue: null },
      nature: oneOf("assets", "liabilities", "income", "expenses"), affectsGrossProfit: { type: BOOLEAN, allowNull: false, defaultValue: false },

  Ledger: {

    },

    indexes: [{ fields: ["org_id", "name"], unique: true }, { fields: ["org_id", "system_key"], unique: true }],

  Voucher: {

      createdBy: nullable(UUID),
    },

  },
  LedgerEntry: {
    table: "ledger_entries",
    timestamps: false,
    attributes: {
      id: id(), orgId: ref("organizations"), branchId: ref("branches"), voucherId: ref("vouchers"), voucherType: { type: STRING(16), allowNull: false },
      voucherNo: { type: STRING(48), allowNull: false }, ledgerId: ref("ledgers"), date: { type: DATE, allowNull: false },
      debitPaise: { type: INTEGER, allowNull: false, defaultValue: 0, validate: { min: 0 } },
      creditPaise: { type: INTEGER, allowNull: false, defaultValue: 0, validate: { min: 0 } },
      invoiceId: nullable(UUID),
    },
    indexes: [{ fields: ["org_id", "ledger_id", "date"] }, { fields: ["org_id", "date"] }, { fields: ["voucher_id"] }, { fields: ["invoice_id"] }],

      pan: STRING(10), gstin: STRING(15), stateCode: STRING(2), phone: STRING(20), email: STRING, address: JSONB, ledgerId: ref("ledgers"),

    },
    indexes: [{ fields: ["org_id", "code"], unique: true }, { fields: ["branch_id"] }],
  },
  PartnerAgreement: {
    table: "partner_agreements",
    attributes: {
      id: id(), orgId: ref("organizations"), partnerId: ref("partners"), kind: oneOf("revenue_share", "fixed_rate"),

      noteNo: { type: STRING(48), allowNull: false }, date: { type: DATE, allowNull: false }, reason: { type: TEXT, allowNull: false },
      lines: { type: JSONB, allowNull: false, defaultValue: [] }, taxablePaise: money(), taxPaise: money(), cgstPaise: money(), sgstPaise: money(), igstPaise: money(),

      voucherId: { ...ref("vouchers", true), defaultValue: null }, status: { ...oneOf("issued", "cancelled"), defaultValue: "issued" }, createdBy: nullable(UUID),
    },

  },
};

export type PgModelName = keyof typeof definitions;

/** Defines every model on a Sequelize instance (idempotent), in foreign-key order. */
export function defineModels(sequelize: Sequelize): Record<string, ModelStatic<Model>> {
  const out: Record<string, ModelStatic<Model>> = {};
  for (const [name, d] of Object.entries(definitions)) {
    out[name] = sequelize.models[name] ?? sequelize.define(name, d.attributes, {
      tableName: d.table,
      underscored: true,
      timestamps: d.timestamps ?? true,
      indexes: d.indexes,
    });
  }
  return out;
}
```
